original: kaścid bhavyaḥ pratyāsannaniṣṭhaḥ prajñāvān svahitam upalipsur vivivkte paramaramye bhavyasattvaviśrāmāspade kvacid āśramapade munipariṣan madye saṃniṣaṇṇaṃ mūrttam iva mokṣamārgam avāgvisargaṃ vapuṣā nirūpayantaṃ yuktyāgamakuśalaṃ parahitapratipādanaikakāryam āryaniṣevyaṃ nirgranthācāryavaryam upasadya savinayaṃ paripṛcchati sma.
bhagavan, kiṃ nu khalu ātmane hitaṃ syād iti ? sa āha mokṣa iti.

sa eva punaḥ pratyāha — kiṃ svarūpo ’sau mokṣaḥ kaścāsya prāptyupāya iti? ācārya āha — niravaśeṣanirākṛtakarmamalakalaṃkasyāśarīrasyātmano ’cintyasvābhāvikajñānādiguṇam avyābādhasukham ātyantikam avasthāntaraṃ mokṣa iti.

tasyātyantaparokṣatvāc chadmasthāḥ pravādinas tīrthakaraṃ manyās tasya svarūpam aspṛśantībhir vāgbhir yuktyābhāsanibandhanābhir anyathaiva parikalpayanti caitanyaṃ puruṣasya svarūpam, tacca jñeyākāraparicchedaparāṅmukham iti.
tat sad apy asad eva nirākāratvād iti.
tad api parikalpanam asad eva, viśeṣalakṣaṇaśūnyasyāvastutvāt.
tatprāptyupāyaṃ praty api te visaṃvadante — jñānād eva cāritranirapekṣāt tatprāptiḥ, śraddhānamātrād eva vā, jñānanirapekṣāc cāritramātrād eva iti ca.
vyādhyabhibhūtasya tadvinivṛttyupāyabhūtabheṣajaviṣayavyastajñānādisādhanatvābhāvavad vyastaṃ jñānādir mokṣaprātyupāyo na bhavati.
kiṃ tarhi? tat tritayaṃ samuditam ity āha —
samyag ity avyutpannaḥ śabdo vyutpanno vā.
eteṣāṃ svarūpaṃ lakṣaṇato vidhānataś ca purastād vistareṇa nirdekṣyāmaḥ.
uddeśamātraṃ tv idam ucyate — padārthānāṃ yāthātmyapratipattiviṣayaśraddhānasaṃgrahārthaṃ darśanasya samyagviśeṣaṇam.
yena yena prakāreṇa jīvādayaḥ padarthā vyavasthitās tena tenāvagamaḥ samyagjñānam.
nanv evaṃ sa eva kartā sa eva karaṇam ity āyātam.
uktaḥ kartrādisādhanabhāvaḥ paryāyaparyāyiṇor ekatvānekatvaṃ pratyanekāntopapattau svātantryapāratantryavivakṣopapatter ekasminn apy arthe na virudhyate.
jñānagrahaṇam ādau nyāyyaṃ, darśanasya tatpūrvakatvāt alpāctaratvāc ca.

yadāsya darśanamohasyopaśamāt kṣayāt kṣayopaśamād vā ātmā samyagdarśanaparyāyeṇāvirbhavati tadaiva tasya matyajñānaśrutājnānanivṛttipūrvakaṃ matijñānaṃ śrutajñānaṃ cāvirbhavati ghanapaṭalavigame savituḥ pratāpaprakāśābhivyaktivat.
cāritrāt pūrvaṃ jñānaṃ prayuktaṃ, tatpūrvakatvāc cāritrasya.
mārga iti caikavacananirdeśaḥ samas tasya mārgabhāvajñāpanārthaḥ.
ataḥ samyagdarśanaṃ samyagjñānaṃ samyakcāritram ity etat tritayaṃ samuditaṃ mokṣasya sākṣān mārgo veditavyaḥ.
tatrādāv uddiṣṭasya samyagdarśanasya lakṣaṇanirdeśārtham idam ucyate —
tasya kasya? yo ’rtho yathāvasthitas tathā tasya bhavanam ity arthaḥ.
aryata ity artho niścīyata iti yāvat.
dṛśer ālokārthatvāt śraddhānārthagatir nopapadyate? dhātunām anekārthatatvād adoṣaḥ.
tattvārthaśraddhānaṃ hy ātmapariṇāmo mokṣasādhanaṃ yujyate, bhavyajīvaviṣayatvāt.
ālokakas tu cakṣurādinimittaḥ sarvasaṃsārijīvasādhāraṇatvān na mokṣamārgo yuktaḥ.
‘puruṣa evedaṃ sarvam’ ity ādi kaiścit kalpyata iti.
athaitat samyagdarśanaṃ jīvādipadārthaviṣayaṃ katham utpadyata ity ata āha —
kā ca kriyā? utpadyata ity adhyāhriyate, sopaskāratvāt sūtrāṇām.
tad etat samyagdarśanaṃ nisargād adhigamād votpadyata iti.
atrāha — nisargaje samyagdarśane ’rthādhigamaḥ syād vā na vā.
yady asti, tad api adhigamajam eva nārthāntaram.
atha nāsti, katham anavabuddhatattvasyārthaśraddhānām iti? naiṣa doṣaḥ, ubhayatra samyagdarśane antaraṅgo hetus tulyo darśanamohasyopaśamaḥ kṣayaḥ kṣayopaśamo vā.
tasmin sati yad bāhyopadeśāvṛte prādur bhavati tan naisargikam.
yat paropadeśapūrvakaṃ jīvādy adhigamanimittaṃ tad uttaram.
nanu ca ‘anantarasya vidhir vā bhavati pratiṣedho vā’ ity anantarasya samyagdarśanasya grahaṇaṃ siddham iti cet? na, ‘pratyāsatteḥ pradhānaṃ balīyaḥ’ iti mokṣamārga eva saṃbadyeta.
atha kiṃ tattvam ity ata idam āha —
yady evam āsravādigrahaṇam anarthakam, jīvājīvayor antarbhāvāt.
dṛśyate hi sāmānye ’ntarbhūtasyāpi viśeṣasya pṛthagupādānaṃ prayojanārtham.
sa kathaṃ jīvādibhir dravyavacanaiḥ sāmānādhikaraṇyaṃ pratipadyate? avyatirekāt tadbhāvādhyāropāc ca sāmānādhikaraṇyaṃ bhavati.
yady evaṃ tattalliṅgasaṃkhyānuvṛttiḥ prāpnoti? ‘viśeṣaṇaviśeṣyasaṃbande saty api śabdaśaktivyapekṣayā upāttaliṅgasaṃkhyāvyatikramo na bhavati.’ ayaṃ krama ādisūtre ’pi yojyaḥ.
evam eṣām uddiṣṭāṇāṃ samyagdarśanādīnām jīvādīnāṃ ca saṃvyavahāraviśeṣavyabhicāranivṛtttyartham āha —
atadguṇe vastuni saṃvyavahārārthaṃ puruṣakārān niyujyamānaṃ saṃjñākarma nāma.
guṇair guṇān vā drutaṃ gataṃ guṇair droṣyate guṇān droṣyatīti vā dravyam.
tad yathā, nāmajīvaḥ sthāpanājīvo dravyajīvo bhāvajīva iti caturdhā jīvaśabdārtho nyasyate.
jīvanaguṇam anapekṣya yasya kasyacin nāma kriyamāṇaṃ nāma jīvaḥ.
akṣanikṣepādiṣu jīva iti vā manuṣyajīva iti va vyavasthāpyamānaḥ sthāpanājīvaḥ.
tatra jīvaprābhṛtajñāyī manuṣyajīvaprābhṛtajñāyī vā anupayukta ātmā āgamadravyajīvaḥ.
tatra jñātur yac charīraṃ trikālagocaraṃ taj jñāyakaśarīraṃ.
sāmānyāpekṣayā noāgamabhāvijīvo nāsti, jīvanasāmānyasya sadāpi vidyamānatvāt.
gatyantare jīvo vyavasthito manuṣyabhavaprāptiṃ pratyabhimukho manuṣyabhāvijīvaḥ.
tatra jīvaprābhṛtaviṣayopayogāviṣṭo manuṣyajīvaprābhṛtaviṣayopayogayukto vā ātmā āgamabhāvajīvaḥ.
jīvanaparyāyeṇa manuṣyajīvatvaparyāyeṇa vā samāviṣṭa ātmā noāgamabhāvajīvaḥ.
evam itareṣām api padārthānāṃ nāmādinikṣepavidhir niyojyaḥ.
sa kim arthaḥ? aprakṛtanirākaraṇāya prakṛtanirūpaṇāya ca.
asati hi tacchabde samyagdarśanādīnāṃ pradhānānām eva nyāsenābhisaṃbandhaḥ syāt, tadviṣayabhāvenopagṛhītānāṃ jīvādīnāṃ apradhānānāṃ na syāt.
tacchabdagrahaṇe punaḥ kriyamāṇe sati sāmarthyāt pradhānānām apradhānānāṃ ca grahaṇaṃ siddhaṃ bhavati.
evaṃ nāmādibhiḥ prastīrṇānām adhikṛtānāṃ tattvādhigamaḥ kutaḥ ity ata idam ucyate —
nāmādinikṣepavidhinopakṣiptānāṃ jīvādīnāṃ tattvaṃ pramāṇābhyāṃ nayaīś cādhigamyate.
tatra pramāṇaṃ dvividhaṃ svārthaṃ parārthaṃ ca.
śrutaṃ punaḥ svārthaṃ bhavati parārthaṃ ca.
evaṃ hy uktaṃ pragṛhya pramāṇataḥ pariṇativiśeṣād arthāvadhāraṇaṃ nayaḥ iti.
tathā coktaṃ sakalādeśaḥ pramānādhīno vikalādeśo nayādhīnaḥ iti.
dravyam arthaḥ prayojanam asyety asau dravyārthikaḥ.
evaṃ pramāṇanayair adhigatānāṃ jīvādīnāṃ punar apy adhigamopāyāntarapradarśanārtham āha —
tatra samyagdarśanaṃ kim iti praśne tattvārthaśraddhānām iti nirdeśo nāmādir vā.
viśeṣeṇa gatyanuvādena narakagatau sarvāsu pṛthivīṣu nārakāṇām paryāptakānām aupaśamikaṃ kṣāyopaśamikaṃ cāsti.
prathamāyāṃ pṛthivyāṃ paryāptāparyāptakānāṃ kṣāyikaṃ kṣāyopaśamikaṃ cāsti.
aupaśamikaṃ kṣāyopaśamikaṃ ca paryāptikānām eva nāparyāptikānām.
manuṣyagatau manuṣyāṇāṃ paryāptāparyāptakānāṃ kṣāyikaṃ kṣāyopaśamikaṃ cāsti.
mānuṣīṇāṃ tritayam apy asti paryāptikānām eva nāparyāptikānām.
devagatau devānāṃ paryāptāparyāptakānāṃ tritayam apy asti.
aupaśamikam aparyāptakānāṃ katham iti cec cāritramohopaśamena saha mṛtān prati.
bhavanavāsivyantarajyotiṣkāṇāṃ devānāṃ devīnāṃ ca saudharmaiśānakalpavāsinīnāṃ ca kṣāyikaṃ nāsti.
indriyānuvādena pañcendriyāṇāṃ saṃjñināṃ tritayam apy asti netareṣām.
kāyānuvādena trasakāyikānāṃ tritayam apy asti netareṣām.
yogānuvādena trayāṇāṃ yogānāṃ tritayam apy asti.
parihāraviśuddhisaṃyatānām aupaśamikaṃ nāsti, itarad dvitayam apy asti, sūkṣmasāṃparāyayathākhyātasaṃyatānām aupaśamikaṃ kṣāyikaṃ cāsti, saṃyatāsaṃyatānām asaṃyatānām ca tritayam apy asti.
darśanānuvādena cakṣurdarśanācakṣurdarśanāvadhidarśanināṃ tritayam apy asti, kevaladarśanināṃ kṣāyikam eva.
leśyānuvādena ṣaḍleśyānāṃ tritayam apy asti, aleśyānāṃ kṣāyikam eva.
bhavyānuvādena bhavyānāṃ tritayam apy asti, nābhavyānām.
samyaktvānuvādena yatra yat samyagdarśanaṃ tatra tad eva jñeyam.
saṃjñānuvādena saṃjñināṃ tritayam apy asti, nāsaṃjñinām, tadubhayavyapadeśarahitānāṃ kṣāyikam eva.
āhārānuvādena āhārakāṇāṃ tritayam apy asti, anāhārakāṇāṃ chadmasthānāṃ tritayam apy asti, kevalināṃ samudghātagatānāṃ kṣāyikam eva.
bāhyaṃ nārakāṇāṃ prakcaturthyāḥ samyagdarśanasya sādhanaṃ keṣāṃcij jātismaraṇaṃ keṣāṃcid dharmaśravaṇaṃ keṣāṃcid vedanābhibhavaḥ.
caturthīm ārabhya ā saptamyā nārakāṇām jātismaraṇaṃ vedanābhibhavaś ca.
tiraścāṃ keṣāṃcij jātismaraṇaṃ keṣāṃcid dharmaśravaṇaṃ keṣāṃcij jinabimbadarśanam.
devānāṃ keṣaṃcij jātismaraṇaṃ keṣāṃcid dharmaśravaṇaṃ keṣāṃcij jinamahimadarśanaṃ keṣāṃcid devardhidarśanam.
ānataprāṇatāraṇācyutadevānāṃ devardhidarśanaṃ muktvānyat tritayam apy asti.
anudiśānuttaravimānavāsinām iyaṃ kalpanā na saṃbhavati; prāgeva gṛhītasamyaktvānāṃ tatrotpatteḥ.
abhyantaraṃ svasvāmisaṃbandhārha eva ātmā, vivakṣātaḥ kārakapravṛtteh.
evam ayaṃ nirdeśādividdhir jñānacāritrayor jīvājīvādiṣu cāgamānusāreṇa yojayitavyaḥ.
kim etair eva jīvādīnām adhigamo bhavati uta anyo ’py adhigamopāyo ’stīti paridṛṣṭo ’stīty āha —
etaiś ca samyagdarśanādīnāṃ jīvādīnāṃ cādhigamo veditavyaḥ.
nanu ca nirdeśād eva sadgrahaṇaṃ siddham.
punar eṣāṃ kim arthaṃ grahaṇam iti.
sarvasattvānugrahārtho hi satāṃ prayāsa iti adhigamābhyupāyabhedoddeśah kṛtaḥ.
itarathā hi pramāṇanayair adhigamaḥ ity anenaiva siddhatvād itareṣāṃ grahaṇam anarthakaṃ syāt.

mithyādṛṣṭiḥ sāsādanasamyagdṛṣṭiḥ samyaṅmithyādṛṣṭiḥ asaṃyatasamyagdṛṣṭiḥ saṃyatāsamyataḥ pramattasaṃyataḥ apramattasaṃyattaḥ apūrvakaraṇasthāne upaśamakaḥ kṣapakaḥ anivṛttibādarasāṃparāyasthāne upaśamakaḥ kṣapakaḥ sūkṣmasāmparāyasthāne upaśamakaḥ kṣapakaḥ upaśāntakaṣāyavītarāgachadmasthaḥ kṣīṇakaṣāyavītarāgachadmasthaḥ sayogakevalī ayogakevalī ceti.
eteṣām eva jīvasamāsānāṃ nirūpaṇārthaṃ caturdaśa mārgaṇāsthānāni jñeyāni.
tatra satprarūpaṇā dvividhā sāmānyena viśeṣeṇa ca.
sāmānyena asti mithyādṛṣṭiḥ sāsādanasamyagdṛṣṭir ity evam ādi.
viśeṣeṇa gatyanuvādena narakagatau sarvāsu pṛthivīṣu ādyāni catvāri guṇasthānāni santi.
indriyānuvādena ekendriyādiṣu caturindriyaparyanteṣu ekam eva mithyādṛṣṭisthānam.
yogānuvādena triṣu yogeṣu trayodaśa guṇasthānāni bhavanti.
akaṣāyaḥ upaśāntakaṣāyaḥ kṣīṇakaṣāyaḥ sayogakevalī ayogakevalī ceti.
parihāraviśuddhisaṃyatāḥ pramattāś ca pramattāś ca. sūkṣmasāṃparāyaśuddhisaṃyatā ekasminn eva sūkṣmasāṃparāyasthāne.
sāsādanasamyagdṛṣṭiḥ samyaṅmithyādṛṣṭir mithyādṛṣṭiś ca sve sve sthāne.
anāhārakeṣu vigrahagatyāpanneṣu trīṇi guṇasthānāni mithyādṛṣṭiḥ sāsādanasamyagdṛṣṭir asaṃyatasamyagdṛṣṭiś ca.
pṛthaktvam ity āgamasaṃjñā tisṝṇāṃ koṭīnāmam upari navānām adhaḥ. apramattasaṃyatāḥ saṃkhyeyāḥ.
catvāra upaśamakāḥ praveśena eko vā dvau vā trayo vā.
catvāraḥ kṣapakā ayogakevalinaś ca praveśena eko vā dvau vā trayo vā.
sayogakevalinaḥ praveśena eko vā dvau vā trayo vā.
viśeṣeṇa gatyanuvādena narakagatau prathamāyāṃ pṛthivyāṃ nārakā mithyādṛṣṭayo ’saṃkhyeyāḥ śreṇayaḥ pratarāsaṃkhyeyabhāgapramitāḥ.
sarvāsu pṛthivīṣu sāsādanasamyagdṛṣṭayaḥ samyaṅmithyādṛṣṭayo ’samyatasamyagdṛṣṭayaś ca palyopmāsaṃkyeyabhḡapramitāḥ.
dvīndriyās trīndriyāś caturindriyā asaṃkhyeyāḥ śreṇayaḥ pratarāsaṃkhyeyabhāgamitāḥ. pañcendriyeṣu mithyādṛṣṭayo ’saṃkhyeyāḥ śreṇayaḥ pratarāsaṃkhyeyabhāgapramitāḥ.
kāyānuvādena pṛthivīkāyikā apkāyikās tejaḥkāyikā vāyukāyikā asaṃkhyeyā lokāḥ.
yogānuvādena manoyogino vāgyoginaś ca mithyādṛṣṭayo ’saṃkhyeyāḥ śreṇayaḥ pratarāsaṃkhyeyabhāgapramitāḥ.
trayānām api yogināṃ sāsādanasamyagdṛṣṭyādayaḥ saṃyatāsaṃyatāntāḥ palyopamāsaṃkhyeyabhāgapramitāḥ.
vedānuvādena strīvedāḥ puṃvedāś ca mithyādṛṣṭayo ’saṃkhyeyāḥ śreṇayaḥ pratarāsaṃkhyeyabhāgapramitāḥ.
strīvedā napuṃsakavedāś ca sāsādanasamyagdṛṣṭyādayaḥ saṃyatāsaṃyatāntāḥ sāmānyoktasaṃkhyāḥ.
jñānānuvādena matyajñāninaḥ śrutājñāninaś ca mithyādṛṣṭisāsādanasamyagdṛṣṭayaḥ sāmānyoktasaṃkhyāḥ.
sūkṣmasāṃparāyaśuddhisaṃyatā yathākhyātavihāraśuddhisaṃyatāḥ saṃyatāsaṃyatā asaṃyatāś ca sāmānyoktasaṃkhyāḥ.
viśeṣeṇa gatyanuvādena narakagatau sarvāsu pṛthivīṣu nārakāṇāṃ caturṣu guṇasthāneṣu lokasyāsaṃkhyeyabhāgaḥ.
sayogakevalināṃ sāmānyoktaṃ kṣetram devagatau devānāṃ sarveṣāṃ caturṣu guṇasthāneṣu lokasyāsaṃkhyeyabhāgaḥ.
kāyayoginām mithyādṛṣṭyādisayogakevalyantānām ayogakevalināṃ ca sāmānyoktaṃ kṣetram.
napuṃsakavedānāṃ mithyādṛṣṭyādyanivṛttibādarāntānām apagatavedānāṃ ca sāmānyoktaṃ kṣetram.
kaṣāyānuvādena krodhamānamāyākaṣāyāṇāṃ lobhakaṣāyāṇāṃ ca mithyādṛṣṭyādyanivṛttibādarāntānāṃ sūkṣmasāṃparāyāṇām akaṣāyāṇāṃ ca sāmānyoktaṃ kṣetram.
ābhinibodhikaśrutāvadhijñāninām asaṃyatasamyagdṛṣṭyādīnāṃ kṣīṇakaṣāyāntānāṃ manaḥparyayajñānināṃ ca pramattādīnāṃ kṣīṇakaṣāyāntānāṃ kevalajñānināṃ sayogānām ayogānāṃ ca sāmānyoktaṃ kṣetram.

saṃyamānuvādena sāmāyikacchedopasthāpanāśuddhisaṃyatānāṃ caturṇāṃ parihāraviśuddhisaṃyatānāṃ pramattāpramattānāṃ sụkṣmasāṃparāyaśuddhisaṃyatānāṃ yathākhyātavihāraśuddhisaṃyatānāṃ caturṇāṃ saṃyatāsaṃyatānām asaṃyatānāṃ ca caturṇāṃ sāmānyoktaṃ kṣetram.

samyaktvānuvādena kṣāyikasamyagdṛṣṭīnām asaṃyatasamyagdṛṣṭyādyayogakevalyantānāṃ kṣāyopaśamikasamyagdṛṣṭīnām asaṃyatasamyagdṛṣṭyādyapramattāntānām aupaśamikasamyagdṛṣṭīnām asaṃyatasamyagdṛṣṭyādyupaśāntakaṣāyāntānāṃ sāsādanasamyagdṛṣṭīnāṃ samyaṅmithyādṛṣṭīnāṃ mithyādṛṣṭīnāṃ ca sāmānyoktaṃ kṣetram.
sāsādanasamyagdṛṣṭibhir lokasyāsaṃkhyeyabhāgaḥ aṣṭau dvādaśa caturdaśabhāgā vā deśonāḥ.

kathaṃ punar indriyapratiṣedhena indraliṃge eva manasi anindriyaśabdasya vṛtti.
na tathā manaḥ indrasya liṃgam api satpratiniyatadeśaviṣayaṃ kālāntarāvasthāyi ca.
guṇadoṣavicārasmaraṇādivyāpare indriyānapekṣatvāc cakṣurādivad bahiranupabdheś ca antargataṃ karaṇam antaḥakaraṇam ity ucyate.
nanu ca tadanantaraṃ ‘anantarasya vidhir vā bhavati pratiṣedho vā’ iti tasyaiva grahaṇaṃ bhavati.
ihārtham uttarārthaṃ ca tad ity ucyate.
itarathā hi prathamaṃ matyādiśabdavācyaṃ jñānam ity uktvā indriyānindriyanimittaṃ śrutam.
evaṃ nirjñātotpattinimittam anirṇītabhedam iti tadbhedapratipattyartham āha —
yathā — cakṣuṣā śuklaṃ rūpam iti grahaṇam avagrahaḥ.
yathā śuklaṃ rūpaṃ kiṃ valākā patākā veti.
yathā saiveyaṃ balākā pūrvāhṇe yām aham adrākṣam iti.
saṃkhyāvācī yathā, eko dvau bahava iti.
vaipulyavācī yathā, bahur odano bahuḥ sūpa iti.

bahūnām avagrahaḥ alpasyāvagrahaḥ bahuvidhasyāvagrahaḥ ekavidhasyāvagraḥ kṣipram avagrahaḥ cireṇāvagrahaḥ aniḥsṛtasyāvagrahaḥ niḥsṛtasyāvagrahaḥ anuktasyāvagrahaḥ uktasyāvagrahaḥ dhruvasyāvagrahaḥ adhruvasyāvagrahaś ceti avagraho dvādaśavikalpaḥ.
ta ete pañcabhir indriyadvārair manasā ca pratyekaṃ pradurbhāvyante.
tatra bahvavagrhādayaḥ matijñānāvaraṇakṣayopaśamaprakarṣāt prabhavanti netare iti.
bahubahuvidhayoḥ kaḥ prativiśeṣaḥ; yāvatā bahuṣv api bahutvam asti bahuvidheṣv api bahutvam asti? ekaprakāranānāprakārakṛto viśeṣaḥ.
uktaniḥsṛtayoḥ kaḥ prativiśeṣaḥ; yāvatā sakalaniḥsaraṇān niḥsṛtam.
uktam apy evaṃ vidham eva? ayam asti viśeṣaḥ; anyopadeśapūrvakaṃ grahaṇam uktam.
ta evaṃ varṇayanti śrotrendriyeṇa śabdam avagṛhyamāṇaṃ mayūrasya vā kurarasya veti kaścit pratipadyate.

dhruvāvagrahasya dhāraṇāyāś ca kaḥ prativiśeṣaḥ? ucyate, kṣayopaśamaprāptikāle viśuddhapariṇāmasaṃtatyā prāptāt kṣayopaśamāt prathamasamaye yathāvagrahas tathaiva dvitīyādiṣv api samayeṣu nono nābhyadhika iti dhruvāvagraha ity ucyate.

yadā punarviśuddhapariṇāmasya saṃkleśapariṇāmasya ca miśraṇāt kṣayopaśamo bhavati tata utpadyamāno ’vagrahaḥ kadācit bahūnāṃ kadācid alpasya kadācid bahuvidhasya kadācid ekavidhasya veti nyūnādhikabhāvād adhruvāvagraha ity ucyate.
dharaṇā punargṛhītārthāvismaraṇakāraṇam iti mahad anayor antaram.
yady avagrahādayo bahvādīnāṃ karmaṇām ākṣeptāraḥ, bahvādīni punarviśeṣaṇāni kasyety ata āha —
tasya bahvādiviśeṣaṇaviśiṣṭasya avagrahādayo bhavantīty abhisaṃbandhaḥ kriyate.
kim artham idam ucyate yāvatā bahvādir artha eva? satyam evam, kintu pravādiparikalpanānivṛttyarthaṃ ‘arthasya’ ity ucyate.
kecit pravādino manyante rūpādayo guṇā eva indriyaiḥ saṃnikṛṣyante tenaiteṣām eva grahaṇam iti.
tad ayuktam; na hi te rūpādayo guṇā amūrtā indriyasaṃnikarṣam āpadyante.
na tarhi idānīm idaṃ bhavati ‘rūpaṃ mayā dṛṣṭaṃ, gandho vā ghrāta’ iti.
katham? iyarti paryāyāṃs tair vā ’ryata ity artho dravyaṃ, tasminn indriyaiḥ saṃnikṛṣṇyamāṇe tadavyatirekād rūpādiṣv api saṃvyavahāro yujyate.
§ 199 kim ime avagrahādayaḥ sarvasyendriyānindriyasya bhavanti uta kaścid viṣayaviśeṣo ’stīty ata āha —
vyañjanam avyaktaṃ śabdādijātaṃ tasyāvagraho bhavati nehādayaḥ.
kim artham idam? niyamārtham, avagraha eva nehādaya iti.
sa tarhi evakāraḥ kartavyaḥ? na kartavyaḥ, ‘siddhe vidhir ārabhyamāno niyamārtha’ iti antareṇaivakāraṃ niyamārtho bhaviṣyati.
nanu avagrahagrahaṇam ubhayatra tulyam tatra kiṃ kṛto ’yaṃ viśeṣaḥ? arthāvagrahavyañjanāvagrahayor vyaktāvyaktakṛto viśeṣaḥ.

katham? abhinavaśarāvādrīkaraṇavat. yathā jalakaṇadvitrāsiktaḥ sarāvo ’bhinavo nādrībhavati, sa eva punaḥ punaḥ sicyamānaḥ śanais timyati, evaṃ śrotrādiṣv indriyeṣu śabdādipariṇatāḥ pudgalā dvitrādiṣu samayeṣu gṛhyamānā na vyaktībhavanti, punaḥ punar avagrahe sati vyaktībhavanti.
sarvendriyāṇām aviśeṣeṇa vyañjanāvagrahaprasaṅge yatrāsaṃbhavas tadarthapratiṣedam āha —
cakṣuṣā anindriyena ca vyañjanāvagraho na bhavati.
yato ’prāptam artham avidikkaṃ yuktaṃ saṃnikarṣaviṣaye ’vasthitaṃ bāhyaprakāśābhivyaktam upalabhate cakṣuḥ manaś cāprāptam ity anayor vyañjanāvagraho nāsti.
cakṣuṣo ’prāpyakāritvaṃ katham adhyavasīyate? āgamato yuktitaś ca.
yadi prāpyakāri syāt tvagindriyavat spṛṣṭam añjanaṃ gṛhṇīyāt, na tu gṛhṇāty ato manovadaprāpyakārīty avaseyam.
tataś cakṣurmanasī varjayitvā śeṣāṇām indriyāṇāṃ vyañjanāvagrahaḥ.
āha nirdiṣṭaṃ matijñānaṃ lakṣaṇato vikalpataś ca; tadanantaram uddhiṣṭaṃ yat śrutaṃ tasyedānīṃ lakṣaṇaṃ vikalpaś ca vaktavya ity ata āha —
śrutaśabdo ’yaṃ śravaṇam upādāya vyutpādito ’pi rūḍhivaśāt kasmiṃś cij jñānaviśeṣe vartate.
yathā kuśalavanakarma pratītya vyutpādito ’pi kuśalaśabdo rūḍhivaśāt paryavadāte vartate.
kaḥ punar asau jñānaviśeṣa iti? ata āha ‘śrutaṃ matipūrvam’ iti.
śrutasya pramāṇatvaṃ pūrayatīti pūrvaṃ nimittaṃ kāraṇam ity anarthāntaram.
matiḥ pūrvam asya matipūrvaṃ matikāraṇam ity arthaḥ.
yadi matipūrvaṃ śrutaṃ tadapi matyātmakaṃ prāpnoti ‘kāraṇasadṛśaṃ hi loke kāryaṃ dṛṣṭam’ iti.
saty api matijñāne bāhyaśrutajñānanimittasaṃnidhāne ’pi prabalaśrutāvaraṇodayasya śrutābhāvaḥ.
śrutāvaraṇakṣayopaśamaprakarṣe tu sati śrutjañānam utpadyata iti matijñānaṃ nimttamātraṃ jñeyam.
tataś ca puruṣakṛtitvād aprāmāṇyam iti? naiṣa doṣaḥ; dravyādisāmānyārpaṇāt śrutam anādinidhanam iṣyate.
na hi kenacit puruṣeṇa kvacit kadācit kathaṃcid utprekṣitam iti.
teṣām eva viśeṣāpekṣayā ādir antaś ca saṃbhavatīti ‘matipūrvam’ ity ucyate.
yathāṅkuro bījapūrvakaḥ sa ca saṃtānāpekṣayā anādinidhana iti.
anityasya ca pratyakṣādeḥ prāmāṇye ko virodhaḥ.
āha, prathamasamyaktvotpattau yugapaj jñānapariṇāmān matipūrvakatvaṃ śrutasya nopapadyata iti? tad ayuktam; samyaktvasya tadapekṣatvāt.
āha, matipūrvaṃ śrutam ity etal lakṣaṇam avyāpi śrutapūrvam api śrutam iṣyate.

tadyathā — śabdapariṇatapudgalaskandhād āhitavarṇapadavākyādibhāvāc cakṣurādiviṣayāc ca ādyaśrutaviṣayabhāvam āpannād avyabhicāriṇaḥ kṛtasaṃgītir jano ghaṭāj jaladhāraṇādi kāryaṃ saṃbandhyantaraṃ pratipadyate, dhūmāder vāgnyādidravyaṃ, tadā śrutāt śrutapratipattir iti? naiṣa doṣaḥ; tasyāpi matipūrvakatvam upacārataḥ.
śrutam api kvacin matir ity upacaryate, matipūrvakatvād iti.
bhedaśabdaḥ pratyekaṃ parisamāpyate — dvibhedam anekabhedaṃ dvādaśabhedam iti.
dvi bhedaṃ tāvat — aṅgabāhyam aṅgapraviṣṭam iti.
tadyathā, ācāraḥ sūtrakṛtaṃ sthānaṃ samavāyaḥ vyākhyāprajñaptiḥ jñātṛdharmakathā upāsakādhyayanaṃ antakṛddaśaṃ anuttaraupapādikadaśaṃ praśnavyākaraṇaṃ vipākasūtraṃ dṛṣṭivāda iti.
dṛṣṭivādaḥ pañcavidhaḥ — parikarma sūtraṃ prathamānuyogaḥ pūrvagataṃ cūlikā ceti.

tatra pūrvagataṃ caturdaśavidham — utpādapūrvam agrāyaṇīyaṃ vīryānupravādam astināstipravādaṃ jñānapravādaṃ satyapravādam ātmapravādaṃ karmapravādaṃ pratyākhyānanāmadheyaṃ vidyānupravādaṃ kalyāṇanāmadheyaṃ prāṇāvāyaṃ kriyāviśālaṃ lokabindusāram iti.
tadetat śrutaṃ dvibhedam anekabhedaṃ dvādaśabhedam iti.
trayo vaktāraḥ — sarvajñas tīrthakara itaro vā śrutakevalī ārātīyaś ceti.
tatra sarvajñena paramarṣiṇā paramācintyakevalajñānavibhūtiviśeṣeṇa arthata āgama uddiṣṭaḥ.
tasya sākṣāc chiṣyair buddhyatiśayarddhiyuktair gaṇadharaiḥ śrutakevalibhir anusmṛtagrantharacanam aṅgapūrvalakṣaṇam.
ārātīyair punar ācāryaiḥ kāladoṣāt saṃkṣiptāyurmatibalaśiṣyānugrahārthaṃ daśavaikālikādyupanibaddham.
tatpramāṇam arthatas tadevedam iti kṣīrārṇavajalaṃ ghaṭagṛhītam iva.
yady evam idam eva tāvad avidhijñānaṃ triḥprakārasya pratyakṣasyādyaṃ vyākriyatām ity atrocyate — dvividho ’vadhir bhavapratyayaḥ kṣayopaśamanimittaś ceti.
ko bhavaḥ? āyurnāmakarmodayanimitta ātmanaḥ paryāyo bhavaḥ.
yady evaṃ tatra kṣayopaśamanimittatvaṃ na prāpnoti? naiṣa dośaḥ; tadāśrayāt tatsiddheh.
bhavaṃ pratītya kṣayopaśamaḥ saṃjāyata iti kṛtvā bhavaḥ pradhānakāraṇam ity upadiśyate.
yathā patatriṇo gamanam ākāśe bhavanimittam, na śikṣāguṇaviśeṣaḥ tathā devanārakāṇāṃ vrataniyamādyabhāve ’pi jāyata ‘iti bhavapratyayaḥ’ ity ucyate.
itarathā hi bhavaḥ sādhāraṇa iti kṛtvā sarveṣām aviśeṣaḥ syāt.
yadi bhavapratyayo ’vadhir devanārakāṇām, atha kṣayopaśamahetukaḥ keṣām ity āha —
avadhijñānāvaraṇasya deśaghātisparddhakānām udaye sati sarvaghātisparddhakānām udayābhāvaḥ kṣayaḥ teṣām evānudayaprāptānāṃ sadavasthā upaśamaḥ.
teṣv api yatra sāmarthyam asti tatraiva veditavyaḥ.
na hy asaṃjñinām aparyāptakānāṃ ca tatsāmarthyam asti.
keṣāṃ tarhi? yathoktasamyagdarśanādinimttasaṃnidhāne sati śāntakṣīṇakarmaṇāṃ tasyopalabdhir bhavati.
sarvasya kṣayopaśamanimittatve kṣayopaśam agrahaṇaṃ niyamārthaṃ kṣayopaśama eva nimittaṃ na bhava iti.
aparo ’vadhiḥ araṇinirmathanotpannaśuṣkaparṇopacīyamānendhananicayasamiddhapāvakavatsamyagdarśanādiguṇaviśuddhipariṇāmasaṃnidhānād yat -parimāṇa utpannas tato varddhate ā asaṃkhyeyalokebhyaḥ.
aparo ’vadhiḥ paricchinnopādānasaṃtatyagniśikhāvatsamyagdarśanādiguṇahānisaṃkleśapariṇāmavṛddhiyogād yat- parimānā utpannas tato hīyate ā aṅgulasyāsaṃkhyeyabhāgāt.
itaro ’vadhiḥ samyagdarśanādiguṇāvasthānād yat parimāṇa utpannas tat primāṇā evāvasthiṣṭhate; na hīyate nāpi vardhate liṅgavat ā bhavakṣayād ā kevalajñānotpatter vā.
anyo ’vadhiḥ samyagdarśanādiguṇavṛddhihāniyogād yatparimāṇa utpannas tato vardhate yāvad anena vardhitavyaṃ hīyate ca yāvad anena hātavyaṃ vāyuvegapreritajalormivat.
evaṃ vyākhyātam avadhijñānaṃ, tadantaram idānīṃ manaḥparyayajñānaṃ vaktavyam.
tasya bhedaḥ puraḥsaraṃ lakṣaṇaṃ vyācikhyāsur idam āha —
athavā ṛjuś ca vipulā ca ṛjuvipule.
ṛjuvipule matī yayos tau ṛjuvipulamatī iti.
sa eṣa manaḥparyayo dvividhaḥ ṛjumatir vipulamatir iti.

āha, ukto bhedaḥ, lakṣaṇam idānīṃ vaktavyam ity atrocyate — vīryāntarāyamanaḥparyayajñānāvaraṇakṣayopaśamāṅgopāṅganāmalābhāvaṣṭambhād ātmanaḥ parakīyamanaḥsaṃbandena labdhavṛttir upayogo manaḥparyayaḥ.
parakīyamanasi vyavasthito ’rthaḥ anena jñāyate ity etāvad atrāpekṣyate.
tatra ṛjumatir manaḥparyayaḥ kālato jaghanyena jīvānām ātmanaś ca dvitrāṇi bhavagrahaṇāni, utkarṣeṇa saptāṣṭau gatyāgatyādibhiḥ prarūpayati.
kṣetrato jaghanyena gavyūtipṛthaktvaṃ, utkarṣeṇa yojanapṛthaktvasyābhyantaraṃ, na bahiḥ.
dvitīyaḥ kālato jaghanyena saptāṣṭau bhavagrahaṇāni, utkarṣeṇāsaṃkhyeyāni gatyāgatyādibhiḥ prarūpayati.
kṣetrato jaghanyena yojanapṛthaktvaṃ, utkarṣeṇa mānuṣottaraśailasyābhyantaraṃ, na bahiḥ.
uktayor anayoḥ punar api viśeṣapratipattyartham āha —
tatra viśuddhyā tāvat — ṛjumater vipulamatir dravyakṣetrakālabhāvair viśuddhataraḥ.
katham? iha yaḥ kārmaṇadravyānantabhāgo ’ntyaḥ sarvāvadhinā jñātas tasya punar anantabhāgīkṛtasyāntyo bhāga ṛjumater viṣayaḥ.
bhāvato viśuddhiḥ sūkṣmataradravyaviṣayatvād eva veditavyā, prakṛṣṭakṣayopaśamaviśuddhiyogāt.
ṛjumatiḥ punaḥ pratipātī; svāmināṃ kaṣāyodrekād dhīyamānacāritrodayatvāt.
yady asya manaḥparyayasya pratyātmamayaṃ viśeṣaḥ, athānayor avadhimanaḥparyayayoḥ kuto viśeṣaḥ ity ata āha —
ity asyāyaṃ svāmiviśeṣo viśiṣṭasaṃyamagrahaṇaṃ vā vākye prakṛtam.
avadhiḥ punaś cāturgatikeṣv iti svāmibhedād apy anayor viśeṣaḥ.
kutaḥ? tasya ‘mohakṣayāj jñānadarśanāvaraṇāntarāyakṣayāc ca kevalam’ ity atra vakṣyamānatvāt.
yady evam ādyayor eva tāvan matiśrutayor viṣayanibandha ucyatām ity ata āha —
atas tasyārthavaśād vibhaktipariṇāmo bhavatīti ‘viṣayasya’ ity abhisaṃbadhyate.
tāni dravyāṇi matiśrutayor viṣayabhāvam āpadyamānāni katipayair eva paryāyair viṣayabhāvam āskandanti na sarvaparyāyair anantair apīti.
atrāha — dharmāstikāyādīny atīndriyaṇi teṣu matijñānaṃ na pravartate.
ataḥ sarvadravyeṣu matijñānaṃ vartata ity ayuktam? naiṣa doṣaḥ; anindriyākhyaṃ karaṇam asti tadālambano noindriyāvaraṇakṣayopaśamalabdhipūrvaka upayogo ’vagrahādirūpaḥ pragevopajāyate.
tatas tatpūrvaṃ śrutajñānaṃ tadviṣayeṣu svayogyeṣu vyāpriyate.
atha matiśrutayor anantaranirdeśārhasyāvadheḥ ko viṣayanibandha ity ata āha —
‘rūpiṣu’ ity anena pudgalāḥ pudgaladravyasaṃbandhāś ca jīvāḥ parigṛhyante.
rūpiṣv evāvadher viṣayanibandho nārūpiṣv iti niyamaḥ kriyate.
rūpiṣv api bhavan na sarvaparyāyeṣu, svayogyeṣv evety avadhāraṇārtham asarvaparyāyeṣv ity abhisaṃbadhyate.
atha tadanantaranirdeśabhājo manaḥparyayasya ko viṣayanibandha ity ata āha —
yad etad rūpi dravyaṃ sarvāvadhijñānaviṣayatvena samarthitaṃ tasyānantabhāgīkṛtasyaikasmin bhāge manaḥparyayaḥ pravartate.
athānte yan nirdiṣṭaṃ kevalajñānaṃ tasya ko viṣayanibandha ity ata āha —
dravyāṇi ca paryāyāś ca dravyaparyāyā iti itaretarayogalakṣaṇo dvandvaḥ.
tadviśeṣaṇaṃ ‘sarva’ grahaṇaṃ pratyekam abhisaṃbadhyate, sarveṣu dravyeṣu sarveṣu paryāyeṣv iti.

jīvadravyāṇi tāvad anantānantāni tato ’py anantānantāni pudgaladravyāṇi ca aṇuskandhabhedabhinnāni, dharmādharmākāśāni trīṇi, kālaś cāsaṃkhyeyas teṣāṃ paryāyāś ca trikālabhuvaḥ pratyekam anantānantās teṣu.
dravyaṃ paryāyajātaṃ vā na kiṃcit kevalajñānasya viṣayabhāvam atikrāntam asti.
aparimitamāhātmyaṃ hi tad iti jñāpanārthaṃ ‘sarvadravyaparyāyeṣu’ ity ucyate.
idaṃ tu na nirjñātam ekasminn ātmani svanimittasaṃnidhānopajanitavṛttīni jñānāni yaugapadyena kati bhavantīty ucyate —
ekādīni bhājyāni yugapad ekasminn ā caturbhyaḥ
eka ādir yeṣāṃ tāni imāny ekādīni.
tadyathā ekaṃ tāvat kevalajñānaṃ, na tena sahānyāni kṣāyopaśamikāni yugapadavatiṣṭhante.
atha yathoktāni matyādīni jñānavyapadeśam eva labhante utānyathāpīty ata āha —
kutaḥ punar eṣāṃ viparyayaḥ? mithyādarśanena sahaikārthasamavāyāt sarajaskakaṭukālābugatadugdhavat.
nanu ca tatrādhāradoṣād dugdasya rasaviparyayo bhavati.
na ca tathā matyajñānādīnāṃ viṣayagrahaṇe viparyayaḥ.
tathā hi, samyagdṛṣṭir yathā cakṣurādibhī rūpādīn upalabhate tathā mityādṛṣṭir api matyajñānena.
yathā ca samyagdṛṣṭiḥ śrutena rūpādin jānāti nirūpayati ca tathā mithyādṛṣṭir api śrutājñānena.
yathā cāvadhijñānena samyagdṛṣṭiḥ rūpiṇo ’rthānavagacchati tathā mithyādṛṣṭir vibhaṅgajñāneneti.
sad vidyamānam asad avidyamānam ity arthaḥ.
tayor aviśeṣeṇa yadṛchhayā upalabder viparyayo bhavati.
kadācid rūpādi sad apy asad iti pratipadyate, asad api sad iti, kadācit sat sad eva, asad apy asad eveti mithyādarśanodayād adhyavasyati.
yathā pittodayākulitabuddhir mātaraṃ bhāryeti, bhāryām api māteti manyate.
yadṛcchayā yadāpi mātaraṃ mātaiveti bhāryam api bhāryeveti ca tadāpi na tatsamyagjñānam. evaṃ matyādīnām api rūpādiṣu viparyayo veditavyaḥ.
tathā hi, kaścin mityādarśanapariṇāma ātmany avasthito rūpādyupalabdhau satyām api kāraṇaviparyāsaṃ bhedābhedaviparyāsaṃ svarūpaviparyāsaṃ ca janayati.
kāraṇaviparyāsas tāvad — rūpādīnām ekaṃ kāraṇam amūrtaṃ nityam iti kecit kalpayanti.
apare pṛthivyādijātibhinnāḥ paramāṇavaś catustridvyeka guṇās tulyajātīyānāṃ kāryāṇām ārambhakā iti.
anye varṇayanti — pṛthivyādīni catvāri bhūtāni, bhautikadharmā varṇagandharasasparśāḥ, eteṣāṃ samudāyo rūpaparamāṇur aṣṭaka ity ādi.
itare varṇayanti — pṛthivyaptejovāyavaḥ kāṭhinyādidravatvādyuṣṇatvādīraṇatvādiguṇā jātibhinnāḥ paramāṇavaḥ kāryasyārambhakāḥ.
bhedābhedaviparyāsaḥ kāraṇāt kāryam arthāntarabhūtam eveti anarthāntarabhūtam eveti ca parikalpanā.
svarūpaviparyāso rūpādiyo nirvikalpāḥ santi na santy eva vā.
na ca tadālambanaṃ vastu bāhyam iti.
evam anyān api parikalpanābhedān dṛṣṭeṣṭaviruddhān mithyādarśanodayāt kalpayanti tatra ca śraddhānam utpādayanti.
tatas tanmatyajñānaṃ śrutājñānam vibhaṅgajñānaṃ ca bhavati.
tatas tanmatijñānaṃ śrutajñām avadhijñānānaṃ ca bhavati.
pramāṇaikadeśāś ca nayās tadanantaroddeśabhājo nirdeṣṭavyā ity ata āha —
sāmānyalakṣaṇaṃ tāvad vastuny anekāntātmany avirodhena hetvarpaṇāt sādhyaviśeṣasya yathātmyaprāpaṇapravaṇaḥ prayogo nayaḥ.
dravyaṃ sāmānyam utsargaḥ anuvṛttir ity arthaḥ.
kaṃcit puruṣaṃ parigṛhītaparaśuṃ gacchantam avalokya kaścit pṛcchati kim arthaṃ bhavān gacchatīti.
tathā edhodakādyāharaṇe vyāpriyamāṇaṃ kaścit pṛcchati kiṃ karoti bhavān iti.
na tadaudanaparyāyaḥ, saṃnihitaḥ, tadarthe vyāpāre sa prayujyate.
evaṃ prakāro lokasaṃvyavahāraḥ anabhinirvṛttārthasaṃkalpamātraviṣayo naigamasya gocaraḥ.
svajātyavirodhenaikadhyam upānīya paryāyān ākrāntabhedān aviśeṣeṇa samastagrahaṇāt saṃgrahaḥ.
sad ity ukte sad iti vāgvijñanānupravṛttiliṅgānumitasattādhārabhūtānām aviśeṣeṇa sarveṣāṃ saṃgrahaḥ.
dravyam ity ukte ’pi dravati gacchati tāṃs tān paryāyān ity upalakṣitānāṃ jīvājīvatadbhedaprabhedānāṃ saṃgrahaḥ.
ko vidhiḥ? yaḥ saṃgrahagṛhīto ’rthas tadānupūrveṇaiva vyavahāraḥ pravartata ity ayaṃ vidhiḥ.
tad yathā — sarvasaṃgraheṇa yat sattvaṃ gṛhītaṃ tac cānapekṣitaviśeṣaṃ nālaṃ saṃvyavahārāyeti vyavahāranaya āśrīyate.
yat sat tad dravyaṃ guṇo veti.
dravyeṇāpi saṃgrahākṣiptena jīvājīvaviśeṣānapekṣeṇa na śakyaḥ saṃvyavahāra iti jīvadravyam ajīvadravyam iti vā vyavahāra āśrīyate.
jīvājīvāv api ca saṃgrahākṣiptau nālaṃ saṃvyavahārāyeti pratyekaṃ devanārakādir ghaṭādiś ca vyavahāreṇāśrīyate.
evam ayaṃ nayas tāvad vartate yāvat punar nāsti vibhāgaḥ.
ṛjuṃ praguṇaṃ sūtrayati tan trayatīti ṛjusūtraḥ.
pūrvāparāṃs trikālaviṣayān atiśayya vartamānakālaviṣayān ādatte atītānāgatayor vinaṣṭānutpannatvena vyavahārābhāvāt.
nanu saṃvyavahāralopaprasaṅga iti ced? na; asya nayasya viṣayamātrapradarśanaṃ kriyate.
tatra liṅgavyabhicāraḥ — puṣyas tārakā nakṣatram iti.
saṃkhyāvyabhicṝaḥ — jalam āpaḥ, varṣā ṛtuḥ, āmrā vanam, varaṇā nagaram iti.
puruṣavyabhicāraḥ — ehi manye rathena yāsyasi, na hi yāsyasi, yātas te piteti.
evaṃ prakāraṃ vyavahāramanyāyyaṃ manyate; anyārthasyānyārthena saṃbandhābhāvāt.
tattvam iha mīmāṃsyate, na bhaiṣajyam āturecchānuvarti.
yato nānārthān samatīty aikam artham ābhimukhyena rūḍhaḥ samabhirūḍhaḥ.
gaur ity ayaṃ śabdo vāgādiṣv artheṣu vartamānaḥ paśāv abhirūḍhaḥ.
śabdabhedāś ced asti arthabhedenāpy avaśyaṃ bhavitavyam iti.
indanād indraḥ śakanāc chakraḥ pūrdāranāt puradara ity evaṃ sarvatra.
athavā yo yatrābhirūḍhaḥ sa tatra sametyābhimukhenārohaṇāt samabhirūḍhaḥ.
yady anyasyānyatra vṛttiḥ syāt, jñānādīnāṃ rūpādīnāṃ cākaśe vṛttiḥ syāt.
svābhipretakriyāpariṇatikṣaṇe eva sa śabdo yukto nānyadeti.
yadaivendati tadaivendro nābhiṣecako na pūjaka iti.
yadaiva gacchati tadaiva gaur na sthito na śayita iti.
athavā yenātmanā yena jñānena bhūtaḥ pariṇatas tenaivādhyavasāyayati.
evam ete nayāḥ pūrvapūrvaviruddhamahāviṣayā uttarottarānukūlālpaviṣayā dravyasyānantaśakteḥ pratiśakti vibhidyamānā bahuvikalpā jāyante.
ta ete guṇapradhānatayā parasparatantrāḥ samyagdarśanahetavaḥ puruṣārthakriyāsādhanasāmarthyāt tantvādaya iva yathopāyaṃ viniveśyamānāḥ paṭādisaṃjñāḥ svatantrāś cāsamarthāḥ.
tantvādayo nirapekṣā api kāṃcid arthamātrāṃ janayanti.
bhavati hi kaścit pratyekaṃ tantus tvaktrāṇe samarthaḥ.
ime punar nayā nirapekṣāḥ santo na kāṃcid api samyagdarśanamātrāṃ prādur bhāvayantīti? naiṣa doṣaḥ; abhihitānavabodhāt.
etad uktaṃ, nirapekṣeṣu tantvādiṣu paṭādikāryaṃ nāstīti.
yat tu tenopadarśitaṃ na tat paṭādikāryam.
tantvādikaryam api tantvādyavayaveṣu nirapekṣeṣu nāsty eva ity asmatpakṣasiddhir eva.
atha tantvādiṣu paṭādikāryaṃ śaktyapekṣayā astīty ucyate.
nayeṣv api nirapekṣeṣu buddhyabhidhānarūpeṣu kāraṇavaśāt samyagdarśanahetutvavipariṇatisadbhāvāt.
āha, samyagdarśanasya viṣayabhāvenopadiṣṭeṣu jīvādiṣv ādāv upanyas tasya jīvasya kiṃ svatattvam ity ucyate —
aupaśamikakṣāyikau bhāvau miśraś ca jīvasya svatattvam audayikapāriṇāmikau ca
ātmani karmaṇaḥ svaśakteḥ kāraṇavaśād anudbhūtir upaśamaḥ.
yathā tasminn evāmbhasi katakādidravyasaṃbandhāt paṃkasya kṣīṇākṣīṇavṛttiḥ.
evaṃ kṣāyikaḥ kṣāyopaśamikaḥ audayikaḥ pariṇāmikaś ca.
ta ete pañca bhāvā asādharaṇā jīvasya svatattvam ity ucyante.
samyagdarśanasya prakṛtatvāt tasya triṣu vikalpeṣu aupaśamikam ādau labhyata iti tasyādau grahaṇaṃ kriyate.
tadanantaraṃ kṣāyikagrahaṇam; tasya pratiyogitvāt saṃsāry apekṣayā dravyatas tato ’saṃkyeyaguṇatvāc ca.
tata uttaraṃ miśragrahaṇam; tadubhayātmakatvāt tato ’saṃkyeyaguṇatvāc ca.
teṣāṃ sarveṣām anantaguṇatvād audayikapāriṇāmikagrahaṇam ante kriyate.
tathā sati dviḥ ‘ca’ śabdo na kartavyo bhavati.
vākye punaḥ sati ‘ca’ sabdena prakṛtobhayānukarṣaḥ kṛto bhavati.
tarhi kṣāyopaśamikagrahaṇam eva kartavyam iti cet.
miśraḥ punar abhavyasyāpi bhavati, audayikapāriṇāmikābhyāṃ saha bhavyasyāpīti.
bhāvāpekṣayā talliṅgasaṃkhyāprasaṅgaḥ svatattvasyeti cet? na; upāttaliṃgasaṃkhyatvāt.
atrāha tasyaikasyātmano ye bhāvā aupaśamkādayas te kiṃ bhedavanta utābhedā iti.
yady evaṃ, bhedā ucyantām ity ata āha —
dvyādīnāṃ saṃkhyāśabdānāṃ kṛtadvandvānāṃ bhedaśabdena saha svapadārthe ’nyapadārthe vā vṛttir veditavyā.
dvau ca nava ca aṣṭādaśa ca ekaviṃśatiś ca trayaś ca dvinavāṣṭādaśaikaviṃśatitrayaḥ.
te ca te bhedās ca, ta eva bhedā yeṣām iti vā vṛttir dvinavāṣṭādaśaikaviṃśatitribhedā ity.
yadā svapadārthe vṛttis tadā aupaśamikādīnā bhāvānāṃ dvinavāṣṭādaśaikaviṃśatitrrayo bhedā ity abhisaṃbandhaḥ kriyate; arthavaśād vibhaktipariṇāma iti.
yadānyapadārthe vṛttis tadā nirdiṣṭavibhaktyantā evābhisaṃbadhyante, aupaśamikādayo bhāvā dvinavāṣṭādaśaikaviṃśatitribhedā iti.
yady evam aupaśamikasya kau dvau bhedāv ity ata āha —
aupaśamikatvaṃ katham iti cet? ucyate — cāritramoho dvividaḥ kaṣāyavedanīyo nokaṣāyavedanīyaś ceti.
tatra kaṣāyavedanīyasya bhedā anantānubandhinaḥ krodhamānamāyālobhāś catvāraḥ.
darśanamohasya trayo bhedāḥ samyaktvaṃ mithyātvaṃ samyagmithyātvam iti.
anādimithyādṛṣṭer bhavyasya karmodayāpāditakāluṣye sati kutas tadupaśamaḥ? kālalabdhyādinimittatvāt.
tatra kālalabdhis tāvat — karmāviṣṭa ātmā bhavyaḥ kāle ’rddhapudgalaparivarttanākhye ’vaśiṣṭe prathamasamyaktvagrahaṇasya yogyo bhavati nādhike iti.
utkṛṣṭasthitikeṣu karmasu jaghanyasthitikeṣu ca prathamasamyaktvalābho na bhavati.

kva tarhi bhavati? antaḥkoṭīkoṭīsāgaropamasthitikeṣu karmasu bandham āpadhyamāneṣu viśuddhapariṇāmavaśāt satkarmasu ca tataḥ saṃkheyasāgaropamasahasronāyām antaḥkoṭīkoṭīsāgaropamasthitau sthāpiteṣu prathamasamyaktvayogyo bhavati.
bhavyaḥ pañcendriyaḥ saṃjñī paryāptikaḥ sarvaviśuddhaḥ prathamasamyaktvam utpādayati.
yaḥ kṣāyiko bhāvo navavidha uddiṣṭas tasya bhedasvarūpapratipādanārtham āha —

lābhāntarāyasyāśeṣasya nirāsāt parityaktakavalāhārakriyāṇāṃ kevalināṃ yataḥ śarīrabalādhānahetavo ’nyam anujāsādhāraṇāḥ paramaśubhāḥ sukṣmāḥ anantāḥ pratisamayaṃ pudgalāḥ saṃbandham upayānti sa kṣāyiko lābhaḥ.
kṛtsnasya bhogāntarāyasya tirobhāvād āvirbhūto ’tiśayavān ananto bhogaḥ kṣāyikaḥ.
pūrvoktānāṃ saptānāṃ prakṛtīnām atyantakṣayāt kṣāyikaṃ samyaktvam.
yadi kṣāyikadānādibhāvakṛtam abhayadānādi, siddheṣv api tatprasaṅgaḥ? naiṣa doṣaḥ; śarīranāmatīrthakaranāmakarmodayādyapekṣatvāt.
kathaṃ tarhi teṣāṃ siddheṣu vṛttiḥ? paramānandāvyābādharūpeṇaiva teṣāṃ tatra vṛttiḥ.
ya uktaḥ kṣāyopaśamiko bhāvo ’ṣṭādaśavikalpas tadbhedanirūpaṇārtham āha —
catvāraś ca trayaś ca trayaś ca pañca ca catustritripañca.
catvāri jñānāni, trīṇy ajñānāni, trīṇi darśanāni, pañca labdhaya iti.
sarvaghātisparddhakānām udayakṣayāt teṣām eva sadupaśamād deśaghātisparddhakānām udaye kṣāyopaśamiko bhāvo bhavati.
anantānubandhikaṣāyacatuṣtayasya mithyātvasamyaṅmithyātvayoś codayakṣayāt sadupaśamāc ca samyaktvasya deśaghātisparddhakasyodaye tattvārthaśraddhānaṃ kṣayopaśamikaṃ samyaktvam.

anantānubandhyapratyākhyānapratyākhyānadvādaśakaṣāyodayakṣayāt sadupaśamāc ca saṃjvalanakaṣāyacatuṣṭayānyatamadeśaghātisparddhakodaye nokaṣāyanavakasya yathāsaṃbhavodaye ca nivṛttipariṇāma ātmanaḥ kṣāyopaśamikaṃ cāritram.

anantānubandhyapratyākhyānakaṣāyāṣṭakodakṣayāt sadupaśamāc ca pratyākhyānakaṣāyodaye saṃjvalanakaṣāyasya deśaghātisparddhakodaye nokaṣāyanavakasya yathāsaṃbhavodaye ca viratāviratapariṇāmaḥ kṣāyopaśamikaḥ saṃyamāsaṃyama ity ākhyāyate.
ya ekaviṃśativikalpa audayiko bhāva uddiṣṭas tasya bhedasaṃjñāsaṃkīrtanārtham idam ucyate —
yathākramam ity anuvartate, tenābhisaṃbandhād gatiś caturbhedā, narakagatis tiryagatir manuṣyagtir devagatir iti.
tatra narakagatināmakarmodayān nārako bhāvo bhavatīti narakagatir audayikī.
kaṣāyaś caturbhedaḥ, krodho māno māyā lobha iti.
tatra krodhanirvartanasya karmaṇa udayāt krodhaḥ audayikaḥ.
liṅgaṃ tribhedaṃ, srtīvedaḥ puṃvedo napuṃsakaveda iti.
jñānāvaraṇakarmaṇa udayāt padārthānavabodho bhavati tadajñānam audayikam.
bhāvaleśyā kaṣāyodayarañjitā yogapravṛttir iti kṛtvā audayikīty ucyate.
sā ṣaḍvidhā — kṛṣṇaleśyā nīlaleśyā kāpotaleśyā tejoleśyā padmaleśyā śuklaleśyā ceti.
nanu ca upaśāntkaṣāye kṣīṇakaṣāye sayogakevalini ca śuklaleśyā ’stīty āgamaḥ.
naiṣa doṣaḥ; pūrvabhāvaprajñāpananayāpekṣayā yāsau yogapravṛttiḥ kaṣāyānurañjitā saivety upacārād audayikīty ucyate.
yaḥ pāriṇāmiko bhāvas tribheda uktas tadbhedasvarūpapratipādanārtham āha —
jīvatvaṃ bhavyatvam abhavyatvam iti trayo bhāvāḥ pāriṇāmikā anyadravyāsādhāraṇā ātmano veditavyāḥ.
ta ete trayo bhāvā jīvasya pāriṇāmikā.
nanu cāstitvanityatvapradeśavattvādayo ’pi bhāvāḥ pāriṇāmikāḥ santi, teṣām iha grahaṇaṃ kartavyam.
yady evaṃ traya iti saṃkhyā virudhyate.
na virudhyate, asādharaṇā jīvasya bhāvāḥ pāriṇāmikās traya eva.
astitvādayaḥ punar jīvājīvaviṣayatvāt sādhāraṇā iti ‘ca’ śabdena pṛthaggṛhyante.
āha, aupaśmikādibhāvānupapattir amūrtatvād ātmanaḥ karmabandhāpekṣā hi te bhāvāḥ.
na cāmūrteḥ karmaṇāṃ bandho yujyata iti.
yady evaṃ karmabandhāveśād asyaikatve saty avivekaḥ prāpnoti.
naiṣa doṣaḥ; bandhaṃ pratyekatve saty api lakṣaṇabhedād asya nānātvam avasīyate.
uktaṃ ca — baṃdhaṃ paḍi eyattaṃ lakkhaṇado havai tassa ṇāṇattaṃ
baṃdhaṃ paḍi eyattaṃ lakkhaṇado havai tassa ṇāṇattaṃ
§ 270.yady evaṃ tadeva lakṣaṇam ucyatāṃ yena nānātvam avasīyate ity ata āha —
tena bandhaṃ pratyekatve saty apy ātmā lakṣyate suvarṇarajatayor bandhaṃ pratyekatve saty api varṇādibhedavat.
sa upayogo dvividhaḥ — jñānopayogo darśanopayogaś ceti.
jñānopayogo ’ṣṭabhedaḥ — matijñānaṃ śrutajñānaṃ avadhijñānaṃ manaḥparyayajñānaṃ kevalajñānaṃ matyajñānaṃ śrutājñānaṃ vibhaṅgajñānaṃ ceti.
darśanopayogaś caturvidhaḥ — cakṣurdarśanam acakṣurdarśanam avadhidarśanaṃ kevaldarśanaṃ ceti.
nirāvaraṇeṣu yugapat pūrvakālabhāvino ’pi darśanāj jñānasya prāgupanyāsaḥ; abhyarhitatvāt.
iha punar upayogagrahaṇād viparyayo ’pi gṛhyate ity aṣṭavidha iti ucyate.
yathoktenānenābhihitapariṇāmena sarvātmasādhāraneṇopayogena ye upalakṣitā upayoginas te dvividhāḥ —
tatparivartanaṃ pañcavidham — dravyaparivartanaṃ kṣetraparivartanaṃ kālaparivartanaṃ bhavaparivartanaṃ bhāvaparivartanaṃ ceti.
tatra dravyaparivartanaṃ dvividham — nokarmadravyaparivartanaṃ karmadravyaparivartanaṃ ceti.

tatra nokarmadravyaparivartanaṃ nāma trayāṇāṃ śarīrāṇāṃ ṣaṇṇāṃ paryāptīnāṃ ca yogyā ye pudgalā ekena jīvena ekasmin samaye gṛhītāḥ snigdharūkṣavarṇagandhādibhis tīvramandamadhyamabhāvena ca yathāvasthitā dvitīyādiṣu samayeṣu nirjīrṇā agṛhītān anantavārān atītya miśrakāṃś cānantavārān atītya madhye gṛhītāṃś cānantavārān atītya ta eva tenaiva prakāṛeṇa tasyaiva jīvasya norkarmabhāvam āpadyante yāvat tāvat samuditaṃ nokarmadravyaparivartanam.

karmadravyaparivartanaṃ ucyate — ekasmin samaye ekena jīvenāṣṭavidhakarmabhāvena ye gṛhītāḥ pudgalāḥ samayādhikām āvalikām atītya dvitīyādiṣu samayeṣu nirjīrṇāḥ, pūrvoktenaiva krameṇa ta eva tenaiva prakāreṇa tasya jīvasya karmabhāvam āpadyante yāvat tāvat karmadravyaparivartanam.
kṣetraparivartanam ucyate — sūkṣmanigodajīvo ’paryāptikaḥ sarvajaghanyapradeśaśarīro lokasyāṣṭamadhyapradeśān svaśarīramadhye kṛtvotpannaḥ kṣudrabhavagrahaṇaṃ jīvitvā mṛtaḥ.

sa eva punas tenaivāvaghāhena dvir utpannas tathā tris tathā catur ity evaṃ yāvad ghanāṃgulasyāsaṃkheyabhāgapramitākāśapradeśās tāvat kṛtvas tatraiva janitvā punar ekaikapradeśādhikabhāvena sarvo loka ātmano jamakṣetrabhāvam upanīto bhavati yāvat tāvat kṣetraparivartanam.
kālaparivartanam ucyate — utsarpiṇyāḥ prathamasamaye jātaḥ kaścij jīvaḥ svāyuṣaḥ parisamāptau mṛtaḥ.
sa eva punar dvitīyāyā utsarpiṇyā dvitīyasamaye jātaḥ svāyuṣaḥ kṣayān mṛtaḥ.
sa eva punas tṛtīyāyā utsarpiṇyās tṛtīyasamaye jātaḥ.
tenāyuṣā tatrotpannaḥ punaḥ paribhramya tenaivāyuṣā jātaḥ.
evaṃ daśavarṣasahasrāṇāṃ yāvantaḥ samayās tāvat kṛtvas tatraiva jāto mṛtaḥ.
pūrvoktenaiva krameṇa trīṇi palyopamāni tena parisamāpitāni.
ayaṃ tu viśeṣaḥ — ekatriṃśatsāgaropamāṇi parisamāpitāni yāvat tāvad bhavaparivartanam.
bhāvaparivartanam ucyate — pañcendriyaḥ saṃjñī paryāptako mithyādṛṣṭiḥ kaścij jīvaḥ sa sarvajaghanyāṃ svayogyāṃ jñānāvaraṇaprakṛteḥ sthitim antaḥkoṭīkoṭīsaṃjñikām āpadyate.
evaṃ sarvajaghanyāṃ sthitiṃ sarvajaghanyaṃ ca kaṣāyādhyavasāyasthānaṃ sarvajaghanyam evānubhāgabandhasthānam āskandatas tadyogyaṃ sarvajaghanyaṃ yogasthānaṃ bhavati.
teṣām eva sthitikaṣāyānubhāgasthānānāṃ dvitīyam asaṃkhyeyabhāgavṛddhiyuktaṃ yogasthānaṃ bhavati.
evaṃ ca tritīyādiṣu catuḥsthānapatitāni śreṇyasaṃkhyeyabhāgapramitāni yogasthānāni bhavanti.
tathā tām eva sthitiṃ tad eva kaṣāyādhyavasāyasthānaṃ ca pratipadyamānasya dvitīyam anubhavādhyavasāyasthānaṃ bhavati.
evaṃ tritīyādiṣv api anubhavādhyavasāyasthāneṣu ā asaṃkhyeyalokaparisamāpteḥ.
evaṃ tām eva sthitim āpadyamānasya dvitīyaṃ kaṣāyādhyavasāyasthānaṃ bhavati.
evaṃ tritīyādiṣv api kaṣāyādhyavasāyasthāneṣu ā asaṃkyeyalokaparisamāpter vṛddhikramo veditavyaḥ.
uktāyā jaghanyāyāḥ sthiteḥ samayādhikāyāḥ kaṣāyādisthānāni pūrvavat.
evaṃ samayādhikakrameṇa ā utkṛṣṭasthites triṃśatsāgaropamakoṭīkoṭīparimitāyāḥ kaṣāyādisthānāni veditavyāni.
anantabhāgavṛddhiḥ asaṃkhyeyabhāgavṛddhiḥ saṃkhyeyabhāgavṛddhiḥ saṃkhyeyaguṇavṛddhiḥ asaṃkhyeyaguṇavṛddhiḥ anantaguṇavṛddhiḥ imāni ṣaṭ vṛddhisthānāni.
evaṃ sarveṣāṃ karmaṇāṃ mūlaprakṛtīnām uttaraprakṛtīnāṃ ca parivatanakramo veditavyaḥ.
uktāt pañcavidhāt saṃsārān nivṛttā ye te muktāḥ.
tena manasā saha vartanta iti samanaskāḥ.
na vidyate mano yeṣāṃ ta ime amanaskāḥ.
evaṃ manaso bhāvābhāvābhyāṃ samsāriṇo dvividhā vibhajyante.
nānarthakam, pūrvāpekṣārtham, ye uktāḥ samanaskā amanaskās te saṃsāriṇa iti.
yadi hi pūrvasya viśeṣạṇaṃ na syāt, samanaskāmanaskagrahaṇaṃ saṃsāriṇo muktāś cety anena yathāsaṃkhyam abhisaṃbadhyeta.
evaṃ ca kṛtvā ‘saṃsāri’ grahaṇam adau kriyamāṇam upapannaṃ bhavati.
te saṃsāriṇo dvividhāḥ — trasāḥ sthāvarā iti.
trasyantīti trasāḥ, sthānaśīlāḥ sthāvara iti cet? na; āgamavirodhāt.
āgame hi kāyānuvādena trasā dvīndriyād ārabhya ā ayogakevalina iti.
trasagrahaṇam ādau kriyate; alpāctaratvād abhyarhitatvāc ca.
eṣāṃ pṛthivyādīnām ārṣe cāturvidhyam uktaṃ pratyekam.
tatkatham iti cet? ucyate — pṛthivī pṛthivīkāyaḥ pṛthivīkāyikaḥ pṛthivījīva ity ādi.
samavāptapṛthivīkāyanāmakarmodayaḥ kārmaṇakāyayogastho yo na tāvat pṛthivīṃ kāyatvena gṛhṇāti sa pṛthivījīvaḥ.
ete mañcavidhāḥ prāṇinaḥ sthāvarāḥ. kati punar eṣāṃ prāṇāḥ? catvāraḥ — sparśanendriyaprāṇāḥ kāyabalaprāṇāḥ ucchvāsaniśvāsaprāṇaḥ āyuḥprānaś ceti.
atha trasāḥ ke te, ity atrocyate —
dvīndriṣa ādir yeyāṃ te dvīndriyādayaḥ. ‘ādi’ śabdo vyavasthāvācī.
katham? dvīndriyas trīndriyaś caturindriyaḥ pañcendriyaś ceti.
kati punar eṣāṃ prāṇāh? dvīndriyasya tāvat ṣaṭ prāṇāḥ, pūrvoktā eva rasanavākprāṇādhikāḥ.
pañcendriyasya tiraśco ’saṃjñino nava ta eva śrotraprāṇādhikāḥ.
‘ādi’ śabdena nirdiṣṭānām anirjñātasaṃkhyānām iyattāvadhāraṇaṃ karttavyām ity ata āha —
karmendriyāṇāṃ vāgādinām iha grahaṇaṃ kartavyam? na kartavyam; upayogaprakaraṇāt.
upayogasādhanānām iha grahaṇaṃ, na kriyāsādhanānām; anavasthānāc ca.
kriyāsādhanānām aṅgopāṅganāmakarmanivartitānāṃ sarveṣām api kriyāsādhanatvam astīti na paṃcaiva karmendriyāṇi.
dvau vidhau yeṣāṃ tāni dvividhāni, dviprakārāṇīty arthaḥ.
kau punas tau dvau prakārau? dravyendriyaṃ bhāvendriyam iti.
utsedhāṅgulāsaṃkhyeyabhāgapramitānāṃ śuddhānām ātmapradeśānāṃ pratiniyatacakṣurādīndriyasaṃsthānenāvasthitānāṃ vṛttir ābhyantarā nirvṛttiḥ.
teṣv ātmapradeśeṣv indriyavyapadeśabhākṣu yaḥ pratiniyatasaṃsthāno nāmakarmodayāpāditāvasthāviśeṣaḥ pudgalapracayaḥ sā bāhyā nirvṛttiḥ.
yat saṃnidhānād ātmā dravyendriyanirvṛttiṃ prati vyāpriyate tan nimitta ātmanaḥ pariṇāma upayogaḥ.
indriyaphalam upayogaḥ, tasya katham indriyatvam? kāraṇadharmasya kārye darśanāt.
indrasya liṅgam indriyam iti yaḥ svārthaḥ sa upayoge mukhyaḥ, ‘upayogalakṣaṇo jīva’ iti vacanāt.
anenākṣaṇā suṣṭhu paśyāmi, anena karṇena suṣṭhu śṛṇomīti.
cakṣer anekārthatvād darśanārthavivakṣāyāṃ caṣṭe arthān paśyaty aneneti cakṣuḥ.
atrāha, yat tāvan mano ’navasthānād indriyaṃ na bhavatīti pratyākhyātaṃ tat kim upayogasyopakāri uta neti.
kiñcāsyaiṣāṃ sahakāritvamātram eva prayojanam utānyad apīty ata āha —
athavā śrutajñānaṃ śrutam, tadanindriyasyārthaḥ prayojanam iti yāvat.
uktānām indriyānāṃ pratiniyataviṣayāṇāṃ svāmitvanirdeśe kartavye yat prathamaṃ gṛhītaṃ sparśanaṃ tasya tāvat svāmitvāvadhāraṇārtham āha —

tasyotpattikāraṇam ucyate — vīryāntarāyasparśanendriyāvaraṇakṣayopaśame sati śeṣendriyasarvaghātispardhakodaye ca śarīranāmalābhāvaṣṭambhe ekendriyajātinamodayavaśartitāyāṃ ca satyāṃ sparśanam ekam indriyam āvirbhavati.
kṛimim ādiṃ kṛtvā, sparśanādhikārāt sparśanam ādiṃ kṛtvā ekaikavṛddhānīty abhisaṃbandhaḥ kriyate.

kṛmyādīnāṃ sparśanaṃ rasanādhikam, pipīlikādīnāṃ sparśanarasane ghrāṇadhike, bhramarādīnāṃ sparśanarasanaghrāṇāni cakṣuradhkāni, manuṣyādīnāṃ tāny eva śrotrādhikānīti yathāsaṃkhyenābhisaṃbandho vyākhyātaḥ.
evam eteṣu saṃsāriṣu dvibhedeṣu indriyabhedāt pañcavidheṣu ye pañcendriyās tadbhedasyānuktasya pratipādanārtham āha —
saha tena ye vartante te samanaskāḥ.
pāriśeṣyād itare saṃsāriṇaḥ prāṇino ’saṃjñina iti siddham.
nanu ca saṃjñina ity anenaiva gatārthatvāt samanaskā iti viśeṣaṇam anarthakam.
saṃjñā jñānam iti cet; sarveṣām prāṇiṇāṃ jñānātmakatvād atiprasaṅgaḥ.
evaṃ ca kṛtvā garbhāṇḍajamūrcchitasuṣuptyādyavasthāsu hitāhitaparīkṣābhāve’ pi manaḥsaṃnidhānāt saṃjñitvam upapannaṃ bhavati.
athābhi–navaśarīragrahaṇaṃ pratyāgūrṇasya viśīrṇapūrvamūrter nirmanaskasya yatkarma tatkuta ity ucyate —
karmaṇā kṛto yogaḥ karmayogo vigrahagatau bhavatīty arthaḥ.
āha jīvapudgalānāṃ gatim āskandatāṃ deśāntarasaṃkramaḥ kim ākāśapradeśakramavṛtyā bhavati, utāviśeṣeṇety ata āha —
lokamadhyād ārabhya ūrdhvam adhas tiryak ca ākāśāpradeśānāṃ kramasaṃniviṣṭānāṃ paṅktiḥ śreṇiḥ ity ucyate.
‘anu’ śabdasyānupurvyeṇa vṛttiḥ. śreṇer ānupūrvyeṇānuśreṇīti jīvānāṃ pudgalānāṃ ca gatir bhavatīty arthaḥ.
anadhikṛtānāṃ pudglānāṃ kathaṃ grahaṇam iti cet.
yadi jīvānām eva gatir iṣṭā syād gatigrahaṇam anarthakam; adhikārāt tatsiddheḥ.
nanu candrādīnāṃ jyotiṣkāṇāṃ merupradakṣiṇākāle vidyādharādīnāṃ ca viśreṇigatir api dṛśyate, tatra kim ucyate, ‘anuśreṇi gatiḥ’ iti.
tatra kālaniyamas tāvaj jīvānāṃ maraṇakāle bhavāntarasaṃkrame muktānāṃ cordhvagamanakāle anuśreṇy eva gatiḥ.
deśaniyamo ’pi ūrdhvalokād adho gatiḥ, adho lokād ūrdhvagatiḥ, tiryaglokād adho gatir ūrdhvā vā tatrānuśreṇy eva.
pudgalānāṃ ca yā lokāntaprāpiṇī sā niyamād anuśreṇy eva.
sa yasyāṃ na vidyate ’sāv avigrahā gatiḥ.
kathaṃ gamyate muktasyeti? uttarasūtre saṃsārigrahaṇād iha muktasyeti vijñāyate.
nanu ca ‘anuśreṇi gatiḥ’ ity anenaiva śreṇyantarasaṃkramābhāvo vyākhyātaḥ.
pūrvasūtre viśreṇi gatir api kvacid astīti jñāpanārtham idaṃ vacanam.
yady asaṅgasyātmano ’pratibandhena gatir ālokāntād avadhṛtakālā pratijñāyate, sadehasya punar gatiḥ kiṃ pratibandhinī uta muktātmavad ity ata āha —
‘prāg’ ity vacanaṃ maryādārtham, caturthāt samayāt prag vigrahavatī gatir bhavati na caturthe iti.

kuta iti cet? sarvotkṛṣṭavigrahanimittaniṣkuṭakṣetre utpitsuḥ prāṇī niṣkuṭakṣetrānupūrvyanuśreṇyabhāvādiṣu gatyabhāve niṣkuṭakṣetraprāpaṇanimittāṃ trivigrahāṃ gatim ārabhate nordhvām; tathāvidhopapādakṣetrābhāvāt.
na vidyate vigraho yasyāḥ sā avigrahā.
gatimatāṃ hi jīvapudgalānām avyāghātenaikasamayikī gatir ālokāntād apīti.
anādikarmabandhasaṃtatau mithyādarśanādipratyayavaśāt karmāṇyād adāno vigrahagatāv atyāhārakaḥ prasaktas tato niyamārtham idam ucyate —
ekaṃ vā dvau vā trīn vā samayān anāhārako bhavitīty arthaḥ.
trayāṇāṃ śarīrāṇāṃ ṣaṣṇām paryāptīnāṃ yogyapudgalagrahaṇam āhāraḥ. tadabhāvād anāhārakaḥ.
triṣu lokeṣūrdhvam adhas tiryak ca dehasya samantato mūrcchanaṃ saṃmūrcchanaṃ avayavaprakalpanam.
striyā udare śukraśoṇitayor garaṇaṃ miśraṇaṃ garbhaḥ.
athādhikṛtasya saṃsāraviṣayopabhogopalabdhyadhiṣṭhānapravaṇasya janmano yogivikalpā vaktavyā ity ata āha —
śīta iti sparśaviśeṣaḥ; śuklādivad ubhayavacanatvād tadyuktaṃ dravyam apy āha.
‘ca’ śabdaḥ samuccayārthaḥ miśrāś ca yonayo bhavantīti.
itarathā hi pūvoktānām eva viśeṣaṇaṃ syāt.
yathaivaṃ vijñāyeta — sacittaś ca acittaś ca, śītaś ca uṣṇaś ca, saṃvṛtaś ca vivṛtaś ceti.
maivaṃ vijñāyi — sacittaś ca śītaś cety ādi.
yonijanmanor aviśeṣa iti cet? na; ādhārādheyabhedāt tadbhedaḥ.
yataḥ sacittādiyonyadhiṣṭhāne ātmā saṃmūrcchanādinā janmanā śarīrāhārendriyādiyogyān pudgalān upādatte.
teṣāṃ hi mātur udare śukraśoṇitam acittam, tadātmanā cittavatā miśraṇān miśrayoniḥ.
teṣāṃ hi upapādasthānāni kānicic chītāni kānicid uṣṇānīti.
uktaṃ ca — ṇiccidaradhādu satta ya taru dasa viyaliṃdiesu chacceva
ṇiccidaradhādu satta ya taru dasa viyaliṃdiesu chacceva
evam etasmin navayonibhedasaṃkaṭe trividhajanmani sarvaprāṇabhṛtām aniyamena prasakte tadavadhāraṇārtham āha —
yan nakhatvaksadṛśam upāttakāṭhinyaṃ śukraśoṇitaparivaraṇaṃ parimaṇḍalaṃ tad aṇḍam.
kiṃcit parivaraṇam antareṇa paripūrṇāvayavo yoninirgatamātra eva parispandādisāmarthyopetaḥ potaḥ.
jarāyujāś ca aṇḍajāś ca potāś ca jarāyujāṇḍajapotā garbhayonayaḥ.
yady amīṣāṃ jarāyujāṇḍajapotānāṃ garbho ’vadhriyate, athopapādaḥ keṣāṃ bhavatīty ata āha —
teṣāṃ punaḥ saṃsāriṇāṃ trividhajanmanāmāhitabahuvikalpanavayonibhedānāṃ śubhāśubhanāmakarmavipākanirvartitāni bandhaphalānubhavanādhiṣṭhānāni śarīrāṇi kānīty ata āha —
udāre bhavaṃ udāraṃ prayojanam asyeti vā, audārikam.
aṣṭaguṇaiśvaryayogād ekānekāṇumahac charīravidhikaraṇaṃ vikriyā, sā prayojanam asyeti vaikriyikam.
sūkṣmapadārthanirjñānārtham asaṃyamaparijihīrṣayā vā pramattasaṃyatenāhriyate nirvartyate tad ity āhārakam.
yat tejor nimittaṃ tejasi vā bhavaṃ tat taijasam.
sarveṣāṃ karmanimittattve ’pi rūḍhivaśāt viśiṣṭaviṣaye vṛttir avaseyā.
yathaudārikasyendriyair upalabdhis tathetareṣāṃ kasmān na bhavatīty ata āha —
pṛthagbhūtānāṃ śarīrāṇāṃ sūkṣmaguṇena vīpsānirdeśaḥ kriyate paramparam iti.
audārikaṃ sthūlam, tataḥ sūkṣmaṃ vaikriyikam, tataḥ sūkṣmam āhārakaṃ tataḥ sūkṣmaṃ taijasam, taijasāt kārmaṇaṃ sūkṣmam iti.
yadi paramparaṃ sūkṣmam, pradeśato ’pi nyūnaṃ paramparaṃ hīnam iti viparītapratipattinivṛttyartham āha —
paramparam ity anuvṛtter ā kārmaṇāt prasaṅge tannivṛttyartham āha prāktaijasād iti.
yady evam, paramparaṃ mahāparimāṇaṃ prāpnoti? naivam; bandhaviśeṣāt parimāṇabhedābhāvas tūlanicayāyaḥpiṇḍavat.
athottarayoḥ kiṃ samapradeśatvam utāsti kaścid viśeṣa ity ata āha —
pradeśata ity anuvartate, tenaivam abhisaṃbandhaḥ kriyate — āhārakāt taijasaṃ pradeśato ’nantaguṇam, taijasāt kārmaṇaṃ pradeśato ’nantaguṇam iti.
ko guṇakāraḥ? abhavyānām anantaguṇaḥ siddhānām anantabhāgaḥ.
tatraitat syāc chalyakavanmūrtimaddravyopacitatvāt saṃsāriṇo jīvasyābhipretagatinirodhaprasaṅga iti? tan na; kiṃ kāraṇam.
sa nāsty anayor ity apratīghāte; sūkṣmapariṇāmāt ayaḥpiṇḍe tejo ’nupraveśavattaijasakārmaṇayor nāsti vajrapaṭalādiṣu vyāghātaḥ.
nanu ca vaikriyikāhārakayor api nāsti pratīghātaḥ? sarvatrāpratīghāto ’tra vivakṣitaḥ.
yathā taijasakārmaṇāyor ā lokāntāt sarvatra nāsti pratīghātaḥ, na tathā vaikriyikāhārakayoḥ.
āha kim etāvān eva viśeṣa uta kaścid anyo ’apy astīty āha —
kāryakāraṇabhāvasaṃtatyā anādisaṃbandhe, viśeṣāpekṣayā sādisaṃbandhe ca bījavṛkṣavat.
yathaudārikavaikriyikāhārakāṇi jīvasya kadācit kāni, na tathā taijasakārmaṇe.
ta ete taijasakārmaṇe kiṃ kasyacid eva bhavata utāviśeṣeṇety ata āha —
niravaśeṣasya saṃsāriṇo jīvasya te dve api śarīre bhavata ity arhaḥ.
aviśeṣābhidhānāt tair audārikādibhiḥ sarvasya saṃsāriṇo yaugapadyena saṃbandhaprasaṃge saṃbhaviśarīrapradarśanārtham idam ucyate —
te taijasakārmaṇe ādir yeṣāṃ tāni tadādini.
vigrahagatau satyām api indriyalabdhau dravyendriyanirvṛttyabhāvāc chabdādyupabhogābhāva iti.
nanu taijasam api nirupabhogam tatra kim ucyate nirupabhogam antyam iti? taijasaṃ śarīraṃ yoganimittam api na bhavati, tato ’syopabhogavicāre ’nadhikāraḥ.
evaṃ tatroktalakṣaṇeṣu janmasu amūni śarīrāṇi prādurbhāvam āpadyamānāni kim aviśeṣeṇa bhavanti, uta kaścid asti prativiśeṣa ity ata āha —
yad garbhajaṃ yac ca saṃmūrcchanajaṃ tat sarvam audārikaṃ draṣṭavyam.
tadantaraṃ yan nirdiṣṭaṃ tat kasmin janmanīty ata āha —
upapāde bhavam aupapādikam, tatsarvaṃ vaikriyikaṃ veditavyam.
yady aupapādikaṃ vaikriyikam, anaupapādikasya vaikriyikatvābhāva ity ata āha —
kim etad eva labdhyapekṣam utānyad apy astīty ata āha —
vaikriyikānantaraṃ yad upadiṣṭaṃ tasya svarūpanirdhāraṇārthaṃ svāminirdeśārthaṃ cāha —
śubhakarmaṇa āhārakakāyayogasya kāraṇatvāc chubham ity ucyate annasya prāṇavyapadeśavat.
viśuddhasya puṇyakarmaṇaḥ aśabalasya niravadyasya kāryatvād viśuddham ity ucyate tantūnāṃ kārpāsavyapadeśavat.
tasya prayojanasamucyārthaḥ ‘ca’ śabdaḥ kriyate. tad yathā — kadācil labdhiviśeṣasadbhāvajñāpanārthaṃ kadācit sūkṣmapadārthanirdhāraṇārthaṃ saṃyamaparipālanārthaṃ ca.
yadāhārakaśarīraṃ nirvartayitum ārabhate tadā pramatto bhavatīti ‘pramattasaṃyatasya’ ity ucyate.
evaṃ vibhaktāni śarīrāṇi bibhratāṃ saṃsāriṇāṃ pratigati kiṃ triliṅgasaṃnidhānaṃ uta liṅganiyamaḥ kaścid astīty ata āha —
saṃmūrcchanaṃ saṃmūrcchaḥ sa yeṣām asti te saṃmūrcchinaḥ.
cāritramohavikalpanokaṣāyabhedasya napuṃsakavedasyāśubhanāmnaś codayān na striyo na pumāṃsa iti napuṃsakāni bhavanti.
yady evam avaghriyate, arthād āpannam etad uktebhyo ’nye saṃsāriṇas triliṅgā iti yatrātyantaṃ napuṃsakaliṅgasyābhāvas tatpratipādanārtham āha —
straiṇaṃ pauṃsnaṃ ca yan niratiśayasukhaṃ śubhagatināmodayāpekṣaṃ tad devā anubhavantīti na teṣu napuṃsakāni santi.
athetare kiyal liṅgā ity ata āha —
ke punas te vedāḥ? strītvaṃ puṃstvaṃ napuṃsakatvam iti.
kathaṃ teṣāṃ siddhiḥ? vedyata iti vedaḥ.
itarathā hi garbhadhāraṇādikriyāprādhānye bālavṛddhānāṃ tiryaṅmanuṣyāṇāṃ devānāṃ kārmaṇakāyayogasthānāṃ ca tadabhāvāt strītvādivyapadeśo na syāt.
ta ete trayo vedāḥ śeṣāṇāṃ garbhajānāṃ bhavanti.

ya ime janmayoniśarīraliṃgasaṃbandhāhitaviśeṣāḥ prāṇino nirdiśyante devādayo vicitradharmādharmavaśīkṛtāś catasṛṣu gatiṣu śarīrāṇi dhārayantas te kiṃ yathākālam upabhuktāyuṣo mūrtyantarāṇy āskandanti utāyathākālam apīty ata āha —
carama uttamo deho yeṣāṃ te caramottamadehāḥ.
asaṃkhyeyam atītasaṃkhyānam upamāpramāṇena palyādinā gamyam āyur yeṣāṃ ta ime asaṃkhyeyavarṣāyuṣas tiryaṅmanuṣyā uttarakurvādiṣu prasūtāḥ.
aupapādikāś ca caramottamadehāś ca asaṃkhyeyavarṣāyuṣaś ca aupapādikacaramottamadehāsaṃkhyeyavarṣāyuṣaḥ.
bāhyasyopaghātanimittasya viṣaśastrādeḥ sati saṃnidhāne hrasvaṃ bhavatīty apavartyam.
apavartyam āyur yeṣāṃ ta ime apavartyāyuṣaḥ.
na hy eṣām aupapādikādīnāṃ bāhyanimittavaśād āyur apavartyate, ity ayaṃ niyamaḥ.
‘bhavapratyayo ’vadhir devanārakāṇām’ ity evam ādiṣu nārakāḥ śrutās tataḥ pṛcchati ke te nārakā iti.
ratnaṃ ca śarkarā ca vālukā ca paṅkaś ca dhūmaś ca tamaś ca mahātamaś ca ratnaśarkarāvālukāpaṅkadhūmatamomahātamāṃsi.

citrādiratnaprabhāsahacaritā bhūmiḥ ratnaprabhā, śarkarāprabhāsahacaritā bhūmiḥ śarkarāprabhā, vālukāprabhāsahacaritā bhūmir vālukāprabhā, paṅkaprabhāsahacaritā bhūmiḥ pańkaprabhā, dhūmaprabhāsahacaritā bhūmir dhūmaprabhā, tamaḥprabhāsahacaritā bhūmis tamaḥprabhā, mahātamaḥprabhāsahacaritā bhūmir mahātamaḥprabhā iti.
yathā svargapaṭalāni bhūmim anāśritya vyavasthitāni na tathā nārakāvāsāḥ.
ghanāmbu ca vātaś ca ākāśaṃ ca ghanāmbuvātākāśāni.
tani pratiṣṭhā āśrayo yāsāṃ tā ghanāmbuvātākāśapratiṣṭhāḥ.
trīṇy apy etāni valayāni pratyekaṃ viṃśatiyojanasahasrabāhulyāni.
sapta bhūmayo nāṣṭau na nava ceti.
kiṃ tā bhūmayo nārakāṇāṃ sarvatrāvāsā āhosvit kvacit kvacid iti prannirdhāraṇārtham āha —
tāsu ratnaprabhādiṣu bhūmiṣu narakāṇy anena saṃkhyāyante yathākramam.

ratnaprabhāyāṃ triṃśannarakaśatasahasrāṇi, śarkarāprabhāyāṃ pañcaviṃśatir narakaśatasahasrāṇi, vālukāprabhāyāṃ pañcadaśa narakaśatasahasrāṇi, paṃkaprabhāyāṃ daśa narakaśatasahasrāṇi, dhūmaprabhāyāṃ trīṇi narakaśatasahasrāṇi, tamaḥprabhāyāṃ pañconam ekaṃ narakaśatasahasraṃ, mahātamaḥprabhāyāṃ pañca narakāni.
tato ’dha ā saptamyā dvau dvau narakaprastārau hīnau.
atha tāsu bhūmiṣu nārakānāṃ kaḥ prativiśeṣa ity ata āha —
aśubhatarā iti prakarṣanirdeśaḥ tiryaggativiṣayāśubhaleśyādyapekṣayā adho ’dhaḥ svagatyapekṣayā ca veditavyaḥ.
nityam aśubhatarā leśyādayo yeṣāṃ te nityāśubhataraleśyāpariṇāmadehavedanāvikriyā nārakāḥ.
prathamādvitīyayoḥ kāpotī leśyā, tṛtīyāyam upariṣṭāt kāpotī adho nīlā, caturthyāṃ nīlā, pañcamyām upari nīlā adhaḥ kṛṣṇā, ṣaṣṭhyāṃ kṛṣṇā, saptamyāṃ paramakṛṣṇā.
dehāś ca teṣām aśubhanāmakarmodayād atyantāśubhatarā vikṛtākṛtayo huṇḍasaṃsthānā durdarśanāḥ.
teṣām utsedhaḥ prathamāyāṃ sapta dhanūṃṣi trayo hastāḥ ṣaḍaṃgulayaḥ.
abhyantarāsadvedyodaye sati anādipāriṇāmikaśītoṣṇabāhyanimittajanitā atitīvrā vedanā bhavanti nārakāṇām.
śubhaṃ vikariṣyāma iti aśubhataram eva vikurvanti, sukhahetūn utpādayāma iti duḥkhahetūn evotpādayanti.
kim eteṣāṃ nārakāṇāṃ śītoṣṇajanitam eva duḥkham utānyathāpi bhavatīty ata āha —

kathaṃ parasparodīrītaduḥkhatvam? nārakāḥ bhavapratyayenāvadhinā mithyādarśanodayād vibhaṅgavyapadeśabhājā ca dūrād eva duḥkhahetūn avagamyotpannaduḥkhāḥ pratyāsattau parasparālokanāc ca prajvalitakopāgnayaḥ pūrvabhavānusmaraṇāc cātitīvrānubaddhavairāś ca śvaśṛgālādivatsvābhighāte pravartamānāḥ svavikriyākṛtāsivāsīparaśubhiṇḍimālaśaktitomarakuntāyodhanādibhir āyudhaiḥ svakaracaraṇadaśanaiś ca chedanabhedanatakṣaṇadaṃśanādibhiḥ parasparasyātitīvraṃ duḥkham utpādayanti.
kim etāvān eva duḥkhotpattikāraṇaprakāra utānyo ’pi kaścid astīty ata āha —
devagatināmakarmavikalpasyāsuratvasaṃvartanasya karmaṇa udayād asyanti parān ity asurāḥ.
pūrvajanmani bhāvitenātitīvreṇa saṃkleśapariṇāmena yad upārjitaṃ pāpakarma tasyodayāt satataṃ kliṣṭāḥ saṃkliṣṭāḥ, saṃvikliṣṭā asurāḥ saṃvikliṣṭāsurāḥ.
saṃkliṣṭā iti viśeṣaṇān na sarve asurā nārakāṇāṃ duḥkham utpādayanti.
upari tisṛṣu pṛthvīṣu saṃkliṣṭāsurā bādhāhetavo nātaḥ param iti pradarśanārtham.
evaṃ chedanabhedanādibhiḥ śakalīkṛtamūrtīnām api teṣāṃ na maraṇam akāle bhavati.
yady evaṃ, tad eva tāvad ucyatāṃ nārakāṇām āyuḥparimāṇam ity ata āha —
teṣu narakeṣu bhūmikrameṇa yathāsaṃkhyam ekādayaḥ sthitayo ’bhisaṃbadhyante.
bhūmiṣu sattvānām iyaṃ sthitiḥ, na bhūmīnām iti.
yatho ’saṃkhyeyāḥ svayaṃbhūramaṇaparyantās tiryakpracayaviśeṣeṇāvasthitā dvīpasamudrās tatas tiryagloka iti.
ke punas tiryagvyavasthitā ity ata āha —
yāni loke śubhāni nāmāni tan nāmānas te.
ity evam asaṃkhyeyā dvīpasamudrāḥ svayambhūramaṇaparyantā veditavyāḥ.
dvir dvir iti vīpsābhyāvṛttivacanaṃ viṣkambhadviguṇatvavyārpttham. ādyasya dvīpasya yo viṣkambhaḥ tad dviguṇaviṣkambho lavaṇajaladhiḥ.
dvir dvir viṣkambho yeṣāṃ te dvir dvir viṣkambhāḥ.
atrāha, jambūdvīpasya pradeśasaṃsthānaviṣkambhā vaktavyās tanmūlatvāditaraviṣkambhādivijñānasyety ucyate —
uttarakurūṇāṃ madhye jambūvṛkṣo ’nādinidhanaḥ pṛthivīpariṇāmo ’kṛtrimaḥ saparivāras tadupalakṣito ’yaṃ dvīpaḥ.
tatra jambūdvīpe ṣaḍabhiḥ kalaparvatair vibhaktāni sapta kṣetrāṇi kāni tānīty ata āha —
bharatādayaḥ saṃjñā anādikālapravṛttā amimittāḥ. tatra bharatavarṣaḥ kva saṃniviṣṭaḥ? dakṣiṇadigbhāge himavato ’dres trayāṇāṃ samudrāṇāṃ madhye āropitacāpākāro bharatavarsaḥ.
vijayārddhena gaṅgāsindhubhyāṃ ca vibhaktaḥ sa ṣaṭkhaṇḍaḥ.
kṣudrahimavantam uttareṇa dakṣiṇena mahāhimavantaṃ pūrvāparasamudrayor madhye haimavatavarṣaḥ.
niṣadhasya dakṣiṇato mahāhimavata uttarataḥ pūrvāparasamudrayor antarāle harivarṣaḥ.
niṣadhasyottarān nīlato dakṣiṇataḥ pūrvāparasamudrayor antare videhasya saṃniveśo draṣṭavyaḥ.
nīlata uttarāt (d) rukmiṇo dakṣiṇāt pūrvāparasamudrayor madhye ramyakavarṣaḥ.
rukmiṇa uttarāc chikhariṇo dakṣiṇāt pūrvāparasamudrayor madhye saṃniveśī hairaṇyavatavarṣaḥ.
śikhariṇa uttaratas trayāṇāṃ samudrāṇāṃ madhye airāvatavarṣaḥ.
vijayārddhena raktāraktodābhyāṃ ca vibhaktaḥ sa ṣaṭkhaṇḍaḥ.
ṣaṭ kulaparvatā ity uktaṃ ke punas te kathaṃ vā vyavasthitā ity ata āha —
tāni kṣetrāṇi vibhajanta ity evaṃ śīlās tadvibhājinaḥ.
pūrvāparāyatā iti pūrvāparakoṭibhyāṃ lavaṇajaladhisparśina ity arthaḥ.
himavadādayo ’nādikālapravṛttā animittasaṃjñā varṣavibhāgahetutvād varṣadharaparvatā ity ucyante.
tatra kva himavān? bharatasya haimavatasya ca sīmani vyavasthitaḥ.
haimavatasya harivarṣasya ca vibhāgakaro mahāhimavān dviyojanaśatocchrāyaḥ.
videhasya dakṣiṇato harivarṣasyottarato niṣadho nāma parvataś caturyojanaśatocchrāyaḥ.
ucchrāyaś ca teṣāṃ catvāri dve ekaṃ ca yojanaśataṃ veditavyam.
ta ete himavadādayaḥ parvatā hemādimayā viditavyā yathākramam.
nānavarṇaprabhādiguṇopetair maṇibhir vicitrāṇi pārśvāṇi yeṣāṃ te maṇivicitrapārśvāḥ.
ya eṣāṃ mūle vistāraḥ sa upari madhye ca tulyaḥ.
padmo mahāpadmas tigiñchaḥ kesarī mahāpuṇḍarīkaḥ puṇḍarīka iti teṣāṃ himavadādīnām upari yathākramam ete hradā veditavyāḥ.
prākpratyag yojanasahasrāyām udagavāk pañcayojanaśatavistāro vajramayatalo vividhamaṇikanakavicitritataṭaḥ padmanāmāhradaḥ.
yojanapramāṇam yojanam, krośāyāmapatratvāt krośadvayaviṣkambhakarṇikatvāc ca yojanāyāmaviṣkambham.
jalatalāt krośadvayocchrāyanālaṃ yāvad bahulapatrapracayaṃ puṣkaram avagantavyam.
sa ca tacca te, tayor dviguṇā dviguṇās taddviguṇadviguṇā iti dvitvaṃ vyāptijñā–panārtham.
teṣu puṣkareṣu karṇikāmadhyadeśaniveśinaḥ śaradvimalapūrṇacandradyutiharāḥ krośāyāmāḥ krośārddhaviṣkambhā deśonakrośotsedāḥ prāsādāḥ.
teṣu nivasantīty evaṃ śīlās tannivāsinyaḥ, devyaḥ śrīhrīdhṛtikīrtibuddhilakṣmīsaṃjñikās teṣu padmādiṣu yathākramaṃ veditavyāḥ.
tasya padmasya parivārapadmeṣu prāsādānām upari sāmānikāḥ pariṣadaś ca vasanti.
yakābhiḥ saridbhis tāni kṣetrāṇi pravibhaktāni tā ucyate —
tāḥ kim antarā uta samīpā iti? āha — tanmadhyagāḥ teṣāṃ kṣetrāṇām madhyaṃ tanmadhyam.
dvayor dvayoḥ saritor ekaikaṃ kṣetraṃ viṣaya iti vākyaśeṣābhisaṃbandhād ekatra sarvāsāṃ prasaṃganivṛttiḥ kṛtā.
tatra pūrvā yāḥ saritas tāḥ pūrvagāḥ.
yady evaṃ gaṅgāsindhvādayaḥ sapta pūvagā iti prāptam? naiṣa doṣaḥ; dvayor dvayor ity abhisaṃbandhāt.
dvayor dvayoḥ pūvāḥ pūrvagā iti veditavyāḥ.
dvayor dvayor yā avaśiṣṭās tā aparagāḥ pratyetavyāḥ.
prakṛtās tā abhisaṃbhadyante? naivaṃ śaṃkyam; ‘anantarasya vidhir vā bhavati pratiṣedho vā’ iti aparagāṇām eva grahaṇaṃ syāt.
gaṅgādigrahaṇam evāstīti cet? pūrvagāṇām eva grahaṇaṃ syāt.
‘nadī’ grahaṇaṃ dviguṇā dviguṇā ity abhisaṃbandhārtham, gaṅgā caturdaśanadīsahasraparivṛtā.
evam uttarā api nadyaḥ pratikṣetraṃ taddviguṇadviguṇā bhavanti; ā videhāntāt.
ṣaḍviṃśāni pañcayojanaśatāni vistāro yasya ṣaḍviṃśapañcayojanaśatavistāro bharataḥ.
kim etāvān eva? na; ity āha ṣaṭ caikonaviṃśatibhāgā yojanasya vistāro ’syety abhisaṃbadhyate.
tato bharatād dviguṇo dviguṇo vistāro yesāṃ ta ime taddviguṇadviguṇavistārāḥ.
kiṃ sarve? na; ity āha videhāntā iti.
uttarā airāvatādayo nīlāntā bharatādibhir dakṣiṇais tulyā draṣṭavyāḥ.
attrāha, uktesu bharatādiṣu kṣetreṣu manuṣyāṇāṃ kiṃ tulyo ’nubhavādiḥ, āho svid asti kaścit prativiśeṣa ity atrocyate —
na tayoḥ kṣetrayor vṛddhihrāsau staḥ; asaṃbhavāt.
bharate airāvate ca manuṣyāṇāṃ vṛddhihrāsāv iti.
anubhava upabhogaḥ, āyurjīvitaparimāṇam, pramāṇaṃ śarīrotsedha ity evam ādibhir vṛddhihrāsau manuṣyāṇāṃ bhavataḥ.
sa ca kālo dvividhaḥ — utsarpiṇī avasarpiṇī ceti.
tatrāvasarpiṇī ṣaḍvidhā — suṣamasuṣamā suṣamā suṣamaduṣṣamā duṣṣamasuṣamā duṣṣamā atiduṣṣamā ceti.
tataḥ krameṇa hānau satyāṃ suṣamā bhavati tisraḥ sāgaropamakoṭīkoṭyaḥ.
tataḥ krameṇa hānau satyāṃ suṣamaduṣṣamā bhavati dve sāgaropamakoṭīkoṭyau.
tataḥ krameṇa hānau satyāṃ duṣṣamasuṣamā bhavati ekasāgaropamakoṭīkoṭī dvi catvāriṃśadvarṣasahasronā.
tataḥ krameṇa hānau satyāṃ duṣṣamā bhavati ekoviṃśativarṣasahasrāṇi.
tataḥ krameṇa hanau satyām atiduṣṣamā bhavati ekaviṃśativarṣasahasrāṇi.
kiṃ tāsu bhūmiṣu manuṣyās tulyāyuṣa āho svit kaścid asti prativiśeṣa ity ata āha —
haimavate bhavā haimavatakā ity evaṃ ‘vuñi’ sati manuṣyasaṃpratyayo bhavati.
tatra manuṣyā ekapalyopamāyuṣo dvidhanuḥsahasrocchratāś caturthabhaktāhārā nīlotpalavarṇāḥ.
tatra manuṣyā dvipalyopamāyuś cāpasahasrotsedhāḥ ṣaṣṭhabhaktāhārāḥ śaṃkhavarṇāḥ.
tatra manuṣyās tripalyopamāyuṣaḥ ṣaḍdhanuḥsahasrocchrāyā aṣṭamabhaktāhārāḥ kanakavarṇā.
atha videheṣv avasthiteṣu kā sthitir ity atrocyate —
tasyāś ca saṃbandhe gāthāṃ paṭhanti — puvassa du parimāṇaṃ sadariṃ khalu koḍisadasahassāiṃ
puvassa du parimāṇaṃ sadariṃ khalu koḍisadasahassāiṃ
jambūdvīpaviṣkambhasya yojanaśatasahasrasya navatiśatabhāgīkṛtasyaiko bhāgo bharatasya viṣkambhaḥ.
uktaṃ jambūdvīpaṃ parivṛtya vedikā sthitā, tataḥ paro lavaṇodaḥ samudro dviyojanaśatasahasravalayaviṣkambhaḥ.
yathā dvistāvān ayaṃ prāsado mīyata iti.
evaṃ dvir dhātakīkhaṇḍe bharatādayo mīyante iti.
tad yathā — dvābhyām iṣvākāraparvatābhyāṃ dakṣiṇottarāyatābhyāṃ lavaṇodakālodavedikāspṛṣṭakoṭibhyāṃ vibhakto dhātakīkhaṇḍaḥ pūrvāpara iti.
tatra pūrvasya aparasya ca madhye dvau mandarau.
tayor ubhayato bharatādīni kṣetrāṇi himavadādayaś ca varṣadharaparvatāḥ.
evaṃ dvau bharatau dvau himavantau ity evam ādi saṃkhyānaṃ dviguṇaṃ veditavyam.
jambūdvīpahimavadādīnāṃ varṣadharāṇāṃ yo viṣkambhas taddviguṇo dhātakīkhaṇḍe himavadādīnāṃ varṣadharāṇām.
jambūdvīpe yatra jambūvṛkṣaḥ sthitaḥ tatra dhātakīkhaṇḍe dhātkīvṛkṣaḥ saparivāraḥ.
tadyogād dhātakīkhaṇḍa iti dvīpasya nāma pratītam.
tatparikṣepī kālodaḥ samudraḥ ṭaṃkacchinnatīrthaḥ aṣṭayojanaśatasahasravalayavikambhaḥ. kālodaparikṣepī puṣkaradvīpaḥ ṣodaśayojanaśatasahasravalayaviṣkambhaḥ.
kim apekṣā dvir āvṛttiḥ? jambūdīpabharatahimavadādyapekṣayaiva. kutaḥ? vyākhyānataḥ.
yathā dhātakīkhaṇḍe himavadādīnāṃ viṣkambhas tathā puṣkarārdhe himavadādīnāṃ viṣkambho dviguṇa iti vyākhyāyate.
nāmāni tāny eva, iṣvākarau mandarau ca pūrvavat.
tata eva tasya dvipasya nāma rūḍhaṃ puṣkaradvīpa iti.
atrāha kim arthaṃ jambūdvīpahimavadādisaṃkhyā dvir āvṛttā puṣḳarārdhe kathyate, na punaḥ kṛtsna eva puṣkaradvīpe.
tasmāt prāgeva manuṣyā na bahir iti.
nāsmād uttaraṃ kadācid api vidyādharā ṛddhiprāptā api manuṣya gacchanti anyatropapādasamudghātābhyām.
evaṃ jambūdvīpādiṣv ardhatṛtīyeṣu dvīpeṣu dvayoś ca samudrayor manuṣyā veditavyāḥ.
guṇair guṇavadbhir vā aryanta ity āryāḥ.
anṛddhiprāptāryāḥ paṃcavidhāḥ kṣetrāryā jātyāryāḥ karmāryāś cāritrāryā darśanāryāś ceti.
tatrāntardvīpā lavaṇodadher abhyantare pārśve ’ṣṭāsu dikṣv aṣṭau.
himavacchikhariṇor ubhayoś ca vijayārddhayor anteṣv aṣṭau.
tatra dikṣu dvīpā vedikāyās tiryak pañcayojanaśatāni praviśya bhavanti.
vidikṣv antareṣu ca dvīpāḥ pañcāśatpañcayojanaśateṣu gateṣu bhavanti.
te caturviṃśatir api dvīpā jalatalād ekayojanotsedhāḥ.
kāḥ punaḥ karmabhūmaya ity ata āha —
bharatā airāvatā videhāś ca paṃca, paṃca, etāḥ karmabhūmaya iti vyapadiśyante.
tatra ‘videha’ grahaṇād devakurūttarakurugrahaṇe prasakte tatpratiṣedhārtham āha — ‘anyatra devakurūttarakurubhyaḥ’ iti.
devakurava uttarakuravo haimavato harivarṣo ramyako hairanyavato ’ntardvīpāś ca bhogabhūmaya iti vyapadiśyante.
tata evaṃ prakarṣagatir vijñāsyate, prakarṣeṇa yatkarmaṇo ’dhiṣṭhānam iti.

tatrāśubhakarmaṇas tāvat saptamanarakaprāpaṇasya bharatādiṣv evārjanam, śubhasya ca sarvārthasiddhyādisthānaviśeṣaprāpaṇasya karmaṇa upārjanaṃ tatraiva, kṛṣyādilakṣaṇasya ṣaḍvidhasya karmaṇaḥ pātradānādisahitasya tatraivārambhāt karmabhūmivyapadeśo veditavyaḥ.
tatra palyaṃ trividham — vyavahārapalyam uddhārapalyam addhāpalyam iti.
tata uddhṛtair lomakacchedair dvīpasamudrāḥ saṃkhyāyanta iti.
tad yathā — pramāṇāṅgulaparimitayojanaviṣkambhāyāmāvagāhāni trīṇi palyāni kuśūlā ity arthaḥ.
ekādisaptāntāhorātrajātāvivālāgrāṇi tāvac chinnāni yāvad dvitīyaṃ kartaricchedaṃ nāvāpnuvanti, tādṛśair lomacchedaiḥ paripūrṇaṃ ghanīkṛtaṃ vyavahārapalyam ity ucyate.
tato varṣaśate varṣaśate gate ekaikalomāpakarṣaṇavidhinā yāvatā kālena tadriktaṃ bhavet tāvān kālo vyavahārapalyopamākhyaḥ.
tair eva lomacchedaiḥ pratyekam asaṃkhyeyavarṣakoṭīsamayamātracchinnais tatpūrṇam uddhārapalyam.
tataḥ samaye samaye ekaikasmin romacchede ’pakṛṣyamāṇe yāvatā kālena tadriktaṃ bhavati tāvan kāla uddhārapalyopmākhyaḥ.
tataḥ samaye samaye ekaikasmin romacchede ’pakṛṣyamāṇe yāvatā kālena tadriktaṃ bhavati tāvān kālo ’ddhāpalyopmākhyaḥ.
anenāddhāpalyena nārakatairyagyonijānāṃ devamanuṣyāṇāṃ ca karmasthitir bhavasthitir āyuḥsthitiḥ kāyasthitiś ca paricchettavyā.
‘bhavapratyayo ’vadhir devanārakāṇām’ ity evam ādiṣv asakṛd devaśabda uktas tatra na jñāyate ke devāḥ katividhā iti tannirṇayārtham āha —
devagatināmakarmodaye saty abhyantare hetau bāhyavibhūtir viśeṣaiḥ dvīpādrisamudrādipradeśeṣu yatheṣṭaṃ dīvyanti krīḍantīti devāḥ.
indrasāmānikādayo bahavo bhedāḥ santi sthityādikṛtāś ca tatsūcanārthaḥ.
devagatināmakarmodayasya svakarmaviśeṣāpāditabhedasya sāmarthyān nicīyanta iti nikāyāḥ saṃghatā ity arthaḥ.
ke punas te? bhavanavāsino vyantarā jyotiṣkā vaimānikāś ceti.
‘ādita’ ity ucyate, ante madhye anyathā vā grahaṇaṃ mā vijñāyīti.
dvayor ekasya ca nivṛttyarthaṃ ‘tri’ grahaṇaṃ kriyate.
atha caturṇṇāṃ nivṛttyarthaṃ kasmān na bhavati? ‘āditaḥ’ iti vacanāt.
tatra catasṛṇāṃ leśyānāṃ grahaṇārthaṃ ‘pītānta’ grahaṇaṃ kriyate.
etad uktaṃ bhavati — āditas triṣu nikāyeṣu bhavanavāsivyantarajyotiṣkanāmasu devānāṃ kṛṣṇā nīlā kāpotā pīteti catasro leśyā bhavanti.
caturṇṇāṃ devanikāyānāṃ daśādibhiḥ saṃkhyāśabdair yathāsaṃkhyam abhisaṃbandho veditavyaḥ.
sarvavaimānikānāṃ dvādaśavikalpāntaḥpātitve prasakte graiveyakādinivṛttyarthaṃ viśeṣaṇam upādīyate ‘kalpopapannaparyantāḥ’ iti.
atha kathaṃ kalpasaṃjñā? indrādayaḥ prakārā daśa eteṣu kalpyanta iti kalpāḥ.
bhavanavāsiṣu tatkalpanāsaṃbhave ’pi rūḍhivaśād vaimānikeṣv eva vartate kalpaśabdaḥ.
kalpeṣūpapannā kalpopapannāḥ. kalpopapannāḥ paryantā yeṣāṃ te kalpopapannaparyantāḥ.
ājñaiśvaryavarjitaṃ yatsthānāyurvīryaparivārabhogopabhogādi tatsamānaṃ, tasmin samāne bhavāḥ sāmānikā mahattarāḥ pitṛgurūpādhyāyatulyāḥ.
ekaikasya nikāyasya ekaśa ete indrādayo daśa vikalpāś caturṣu nikāyeṣūtsargeṇa prasaktās tato ’pavādārtham āha —
vyantareṣu jyotiṣkeṣu ca trāyastriṃśāṃl lokapālāṃś ca varjayitvā itare ’ṣtau vikalpā draṣṭavyāḥ.
atha teṣu nikāyeṣu kim ekaika indra utānyaḥ pratiniyamaḥ kaścid astīty ata āha —
kathaṃ dvitīyasya pūrvatvam? sāmīpyāt pūrvatvam upacaryoktam.
dvau dvau indrau yeṣāṃ te dvīndrā iti.
tad yathā — bhavanavāsiṣu tāvad asurakumārāṇāṃ dvāv indrau camaro vairocanaś ca.
vyantareṣv api kinnarāṇāṃ dvāv īndrau kinnaraḥ kimpuruṣaś ca.
mahoragāṇāṃ matikāyo mahākāyaś ca. gandharvāṇāṃ gītaratir gītayaśaś ca.
athaiṣāṃ devānāṃ sukhaṃ kīdṛśam ity ukte sukhāvabodhanārtham āha —
ete bhavanavāsyādaya aiśānāntāḥ saṃkliṣṭakarmatvān manuṣyavat strīviṣayasukham anubhavantīty arthaḥ.
sparśaś ca rūpaṃ ca śabdaś ca manaś ca sparśarūpaśabdamanāṃsi, teṣu pravīcāro yeṣāṃ te sparśarūpaśabdamanaḥpravīcārāḥ.
kaḥ punar iṣṭo ’bhisaṃbandhaḥ? ārṣāvirodhī — sānatkumāramāhendrayor devā devāṅganāṅgasparśamātrād eva parāṃ prītim upalabhante, tathā devyo ’pi.
brahmabrahmottaralāntavakāpiṣṭheṣu devā divyāṅganānāṃ śṛṅgārākāravilāsacaturamanojñaveṣarūpāvalokanamātrād eva paramasukham āpnuvanti.
śukramahāśukraśatārasahasrāreṣu devā devavanitānāṃ madhurasaṃgītamṛduhasitalalitakathitabhūṣaṇaravaśravaṇamātrād eva parāṃ prītimāskandanti.
ānataprāṇatāraṇācyutakalpeṣu devā svāṅganāmanaḥsaṃkalpamātrād eva paraṃ sukham āpnuvanti.
athottareṣāṃ kiṃ prakāraṃ sukham ity ukte tanniścayārtham āha —
uktā ye ādinikāyadevā daśavikalpā iti teṣāṃ sāmānyaviśeṣasaṃjñāvijñāpanārtham idam ucyate —

asurādayo viśeṣasaṃjñā viśiṣṭanāmakarmodayāpāditavṛttayaḥ sarveṣāṃ devānām avasthitavayaḥsvabhāvatve ’pi veṣabhūṣāyudhayānavāhanakrīḍanādikumaravad eṣām ābhāsata iti bhavanavāsiṣu kumāravyapadeśo rūḍhaḥ.
sa pratyekaṃ parisamāpyate asurakumārā ity evam ādi.
kharapṛthivībhāge upary adhaś ca ekaikayojanasahasraṃ varjayitvā śeṣanavānāṃ kumārāṇām āvāsāḥ.
vividhadeśāntarāṇi yeṣāṃ nivāsās te ‘vyantarāḥ’ ity anvarthā sāmānyasaṃjñeyam aṣṭānām api vikalpānām.
teṣāṃ vyantarāṇām aṣṭau vikalpāḥ kiṃnarādayo veditavyā nāmakarmodayaviśeṣāpāditāḥ.
kva punas teṣām āvāsa iti cet.
ucyate — asmāj jambūdvīpād asaṃkhyeyān dvīpasamudrān atītya upariṣṭe kharapṛthivībhāge saptānāṃ vyantarāṇām āvāsāḥ.
jyotis svabhāvatvād eṣāṃ pañcānām api ‘jyotiṣkāḥ’ iti sāmānyasaṃjñā anvarthā.
kva punas teṣām āvāsāḥ? ity attrocyate, asmāt samād bhūmibhāgād ūrdhvaṃ saptayojanaśatāni navatyuttarāṇi utpatya sarvajyotiṣām adhobhāgavinyastās tārakāś caranti.
tatas trīṇi yojanāny utpatya śanaiś carāś caranti.
sa eṣa jyotir gaṇagocaro nabho ’vakāśo daśādhikayojanaśatabahalas tiryagsaṃkhyātadvīpasamudrapramāṇo ghanodadhiparyantaḥ.
‘merupradakṣiṇāḥ’ iti vacanaṃ gativiśeṣapratipattyarthaṃ viparītā gatir mā vijñāyīti.
ardhatṛtīyeṣu dvīpeṣu dvayoś ca samudrayor jyotiṣkā nityagatayo nānyatreti.
na; asiddhatvāt, gatiratābhiyogyadevaprerita gatipariṇāmāt karmavipākasya vaicitryāt.
teṣāṃ hi gatimukhenaiva karma vipacyata iti.
ekādaśabhir yojanaśatair ekaviṃśair merum aprāpya jyotiṣkāḥ pradakṣiṇaś caranti.
na kevalayā gatyā nāpi kevalair jyotirbhiḥ kālaḥ paricchadyate; anupalabdher aparivartanāc ca.
vyāvahārikaḥ kālavibhāgas tatkṛtaḥ samayāvalikādiḥ kriyāviśeṣaparicchinno ’nyasyāparicchinnasya paricchedahetuḥ.
nanu ca nṛloke ‘nityagati’ vacanād anyatrāvasthānaṃ jyotiṣkāṇāṃ siddham.
ato bahir avasthitā iti vacanam anarthakam iti.
tan na; kiṃ kāraṇam? nṛlokād anyatra hi jyotiṣām astitvam avasthānāṃ cāsiddham.
atas tadubhayasiddhyarthaṃ bahir avasthitā ity ucyate.
ita uttaraṃ ye vakṣyante teṣāṃ vaimānikasaṃpratyayo yathā syād iti adhikāraḥ kriyate.
kalpeṣūpannāḥ kalpopapannāḥ — kalpātītāḥ kalpātītāś ceti dvividhā vaimānikāḥ.
yady evaṃ, kiyatsu kalpavimāneṣu te devā bhavantīty ata āha —

saudharmaiśānasānatkumāramāhendrabrahmabrahmottaralāntavakāpiṣṭhaśukramahāśukraśatārasahasrāreṣv ānataprāṇatayor āraṇācyutayor navasu graiveyakeṣu vijayavaijayantajayantāparājiteṣu sarvārthasiddhau ca
katham eṣāṃ saudharmādiśabdānāṃ kalpābhidhānam? cāturārthikenāṇā svabhāvato vā kalpasyābhidhānaṃ bhavati.
atha katham indrābhidhānam? svabhāvataḥ sāhacaryād vā.
tat katham iti cet? ucyate — sudharmā nāma sabhā, sā ’sminn astīti saudharmaḥ kalpaḥ.
āgamāpekṣayā vyavasthā bhavatīti ‘upary upari’ ity anena dvayor dvayor abhisaṃbandho veditavyaḥ.

prathamo saudharmaiśānakalpau, tayor upari sānatkumāramāhendrau, tayor upari brahmalokabrahmottarau, tayor upari lāntavakāpiṣṭau, tayor upari śukramahāśukrau, tayor upari śatārasāhasrārau, tayor upari ānataprāṇatau, tayor upari āraṇācyutau.
adha upari ca pratyekam indrasaṃbandho veditavyaḥ.
tasyā upari keśāntaramātre vyavasthitam ṛjuvimānam indrakaṃ saudharmasya.
‘navasu graiveyakeṣu’ iti navaśabdasya pṛthagvacanaṃ kim artham? anyāny api navavimānāni anudiśasaṃjñakāni santīti jñāpanārtham.
eṣām adhikṛtānāṃ vaimānikāṃ parasparato viśeṣapratipattyartham āha —
svopāttasyāyuṣa udayāt tasmin bhave śarīreṇa sahāvasthānaṃ sthitiḥ.
upary upari pratikalpaṃ pratiprastāram ca vaimānikāḥ sthityādibhir adhikā ity arthaḥ.
yathā sthityādibhir upary upary adhikā evaṃ gatyādhibhir apīty atiprasaṃge tannivṛttyartham āha —
parigrahaś ca vimānaparicchadādir upary upari hīnaḥ.
purastāt triṣu nikāyeṣu devānāṃ leśyāvidhir uktaḥ.
pītā ca padmā ca śuklā ca tāḥ pītapadmaśuklāḥ.
yathā — drutāyāṃ taparakaraṇe madhyamavilambitayor upasaṃkhyānam iti.
athavā pītaś ca padmaś ca śuklaś ca pītapadmaśuklā varṇavanto ’rthāḥ.
teṣām iva leśyā yeṣāṃ te pītapadmaśuklaleśyāḥ.
tad yathā — chatriṇo gacchanti iti acchatriṣu chatravyavahāraḥ.
ayam arthaḥ sūtrataḥ kathaṃ gamyate iti cet.
ucyate — evam abhisaṃbandhaḥ kriyate, dvayoḥ kalpayugalayoḥ pītaleśyā; sānatkumāramāhendrayoḥ padmaleśyāyā avivakṣātaḥ.
brahmalokādiṣu triṣu kalpayugaleṣu padmaleśyā; śukramahāśukrayoḥ śuklaleśyāyā avivakṣātaḥ.
āha kalpopapannā ity uktaṃ tattredaṃ na jñāyate ke kalpā ity attrocyate —
idaṃ na jñāyate ita ārabhya kalpā bhavantīti saudharmādigrahaṇam anuvartate.
tenāyam artho labhyate — saudharmādayaḥ prāggraiveyakebhyaḥ kalpā iti.
laukāntikā devā vaimānikāḥ santaḥ kva gṛhyante? kalpopapanneṣu.
etya tasmin līyanta iti ālaya āvāsaḥ.
brahmaloka ālayo yeṣām te brahmalokālayā laukāntikā devā veditavyāḥ.
yady evaṃ sarveṣāṃ brahmalokālayānāṃ devānāṃ laukāntikatvaṃ prasaktam.
brahmaloko lokaḥ, tasyānto lokāntaḥ, tasmin bhavā laukāntikā iti na sarveṣāṃ grahaṇam.
athavā janmajarāmaraṇākīrṇo lokaḥ saṃsāraḥ, tasyānto lokāntaḥ.
te sarve parītasaṃsārāḥ, tataś cyutā ekaṃ garbhāvāsaṃ prāpya parinirvāsyantīti.
kva ime sārasvatādayaḥ? aṣṭāsv api pūrvottarādiṣu dikṣu yathākramam ete sārasvatādayo devagaṇā veditavyāḥ.

tad yathā — pūrvottarakoṇe sārasvatavimānam, pūrvasyāṃ diśi ādityavimānam, pūrvadakṣiṇasyāṃ diśi vahnivimānam, dakṣiṇasyāṃ diśi aruṇavimānam, dakṣiṇāparakoṇe gardatoyavimānam, aparasyāṃ diśi tuṣitavimānam, uttarāparasyāṃ diśi avyābādhavimānam, uttarsyāṃ diśi ariṣṭavimānam.
sarve ete svatantrāḥ; hīnādhikatvābhāvāt, viṣayarativirahād devarṣayaḥ, itareṣāṃ devānām arcanīyāḥ, caturdaśapūrvadharāḥ tīrthakaraniṣkramaṇapratibodhanaparā veditavyāḥ.
āha, uktā laukāntikās tataś cyutā ekaṃ garbhavāsam avāpya nirvāsyantīty uktāḥ.
kim evam anyesv api nirvāṇaprāptikālavibhāgo vidyate.
‘ādi’ śabdaḥ prakārārthe vartate, tena vijayavaijantajayantāparājitānudiśavimānānām iṣṭānāṃ grahaṇaṃ siddhaṃ bhavati.
dvau caramau dehau yeṣām te dvicaramāḥ.
vijayādibhyaś cyutā apratipatitasamyaktvā manuṣyeṣūtpadya saṃyamam ārādya punar vijayādiṣūtpadya tataś cyutāḥ punar manuṣyabhavam avāpya siddyantīti dvicaramadehatvam.
āha, jivasyāudayikeṣu bhāveṣu tiryagyonigatir audayakīty uktaṃ, punaś ca sthitau ‘tiryagyonijānāṃ ca’ iti.
ebhyo ’nye saṃsāriṇo jīvāḥ śeṣās te tiryagyonayo veditavyāḥ.
teṣāṃ tiraścāṃ devādīnām iva kṣetravibhāgaḥ punar nirdeṣṭavyaḥ? sarvalokavyāpitvāt tesāṃ kṣetravibhāgo noktaḥ.
āha, sthitir uktā nārakāṇāṃ manuṣyāṇāṃ tiraścāṃ ca.
tasyāṃ vyaktavyāyām ādāv uddiṣṭānāṃ bhavanavāsināṃ sthitipratipādanārtham āha —
iyaṃ sthitir utkṛṣṭā jaghanyāpy uttaratra vakṣyate.
adyadevanikāyasthityabhidhānād anantaraṃ vyantarajyotiṣkasthitivacane kramaprāpte sati tadullaṅghya vaimānikānāṃ sthitir ucyate.
teṣu cādāv uddiṣṭayo kalpayoḥ sthitividhānārtham aha —
idaṃ tu kuto jñāyate? uttaratra ‘tu’ śabdagrahaṇāt.
tena saudharmaiśānayor devānāṃ dve sāgaropame sātireke pratyetvaye.
anayoḥ kalpayor devānāṃ saptasāgaropamāṇi sādhikāni utkṛṣṭā sthitiḥ.
sapta tribhir adhikāni, sapta saptabhir adhikānīty ādiḥ.
kiṃ viśinaṣṭi? ‘adhika’ śabdo ’nuvartamānaś caturbhir abhisaṃbadhyate nottarābhyām ity ayam artho viśiṣyate.
tenāyam artho bhavati — brahmalokabrahmottarayor daśasāgaropamāṇi sādhikāni.
āraṇācyutād ūrdhvam ekaikena navasu graiveyakeṣu vijayādiṣu sarvārthasiddhau ca
‘nava’ grahaṇaṃ kim artham? pratyekam ekaikam adhikam iti jñāpanārtham.
itarathā hi graiveyakeṣv ekam evādhikaṃ syāt.
vijayādiṣv iti ‘ādi’ śabdasya prakārārthatvād anudiśānām api grahaṇam.
tenāyam arthaḥ, adhograiveyakeṣu prathame trayoviṃśatiḥ, dvitīye caturviṃśatiḥ, tṛtīye pañcaviṃśatiḥ.
madhyamagraiveyakeṣu prathame ṣaḍviṃśatiḥ dvitīye saptaviṃśatiḥ tṛtīye ’ṣṭāviṃśatiḥ.
uparimagraiveyakeṣu prathame ekonatriṃśad dvitīye triṃśat tṛtīye ekatriṃśat.
vijayādiṣu trayas triṃśat sāgaropamāṇy utkṛṣṭā sthitiḥ.
kathaṃ gamyate? ‘parataḥ parataḥ’ ity uttaratra vakṣyamāṇātvāt.
tenaivam abhisaṃbandhaḥ kriyate — saudharmaiśānayor dve sāgaropame sādhike ukte, te sādhike sānatkumāramāhendrayor jaghanyā sthitiḥ.
sānatkumāramāhendrayoḥ parā sthitiḥ saptasāgaropamāṇi sādhikāni, tāni sādhikāni brahmabrahmottarayor jaghanyā sthitir ity ādi.
jaghanyāṃ sūtre ’nupāttām aprakṛtām api laghunopāyena pratipādayitum icchann āha —
kiṃ ca prakṛtam? ‘parataḥ parataḥ pūrvāpūrvā ’nantarā’ aparā sthitir iti.
tenāyam artho labhyate — ratnaprabhāyāṃ nārakāṇāṃ parā sthitir ekaṃ sāgaropamam.
atha bhavanavāsināṃ kā jaghanyā sthitir ity ata āha —
tena bhavanavāsināṃ aparā sthitir daśavarṣasahasrāṇīty abhisaṃbadhyate.
vyantarāṇāṃ tarhi kā jaghanyā sthitir ity ata āha —
tena vyantarāṇāṃ aparā sthitir daśavarṣasahasrāṇīty avagamyate.
athaiṣāṃ parā sthitiḥ kā ity atrocyate —
parā utkṛṣtā sthitir vyantarāṇāṃ palyopamam adhikam.
idānīṃ jyotiṣkāṇāṃ parā sthitir vaktavyety ata āha —
jyotiṣkāṇāṃ parā sthitiḥ palyopamam adhikam iti.
tasya palyopamasyāṣṭabhāgo jyotiṣkāṇāṃ aparā sthitir ity arthaḥ.
idānīṃ samyagdarśanasya viṣayabhāvenopakṣipteṣu jīvādiṣu jīvapadārtho vyākhyātaḥ.
kuta upacāraḥ? yathā śarīraṃ pudgaladravyapracayātmakaṃ tathā dharmādiṣv api pradeśpracāyāpekṣayā kāyā iva kāyā iti.
ajīvāś ca te kāyāś ca ajīvakāyāḥ viśeṣaṇaṃ viśeṣyeṇeti vṛttiḥ.
nanu ca nīlotpalādiṣu vyabhicāre sati viśeṣaṇaviśeṣyayogaḥ.
nanu ca ‘asaṃkhyeyāḥ pradeśā dharmādharmaikajīvānām’ ity anenaiva pradeśabahutvaṃ jñāpitam.
paraṃ kintv asmin vidhau sati tadavadhāraṇaṃ vijñāyate, asaṃkhyeyāḥ pradeśā na saṃkhyeyā nāpy anantā iti.
yathā ’ṇoḥ pradeśamatratvād dvitīyādayo ’sya pradeśā na santīty apradeśo ’ṇuḥ, tathā kālaparamāṇur apy ekapradeśatvād apradeśa iti.
teṣāṃ dharmādīnāṃ ‘ajīva’ iti sāmānyasaṃjñā jīvalakṣanābhāvamukhena pravṛttā.
atrāha, ‘sarvadravyaparyāyeṣu kevalasya’ ity evam ādiṣu dravyāny uktāni, kāni tānīty ucyate —
yathā svaṃ paryāyair drūyante dravanti vā tāni iti dravyāṇi.
yathā daṇḍadaṇḍinor yogo bhavati pṛthaksiddhayoḥ, na ca tathā dravyadravyatve pṛthaksiddhe staḥ.
yady apṛthaksiddhayor api yogaḥ syād ākāśakusumasya prakṛtapruṣasya dvitīyaśirasaś ca yogaḥ syād iti.
guṇasamudāyo dravyam iti cet? tatrāpi guṇānāṃ samudāyasya ca bhedābhāve tadvyapadeśo nopapadyate.
nanu guṇān dravanti guṇair vā drūyanta iti vigrahe ’pi sa eva doṣa iti cet? na; kathaṃcid bhedābhedopapattes tadvyapadeśasiddhiḥ.
naiṣa doṣaḥ; āviṣṭaliṅgāḥ śabdā na kadācil liṅgaṃ vyabhicaranti.
