anantaratvāc caturṇām eva dravyavyapadeśaprasaṃge ’dhyāropaṇārtham idam ucyate —
evam etāni vakṣyamāṇena kālena saha ṣaḍ dravyāṇi bhavanti.
nanu dravyasya lakṣaṇaṃ vakṣyate ‘guṇaparyayavad dravyam’ iti.
tallakṣaṇayogād dharmādīnāṃ dravyavyapadeśo bhavati, nārthaḥ parigaṇanena? parigaṇanam avadhāraṇārtham.
vāyumanaso rūpādiyogābhava iti cet? na; vāyus tāvad rūpādimān; sparśatvād ghaṭādivat.
cakṣurādikaraṇagrāhyatvābhāvād rūpādyabhāva iti cet? na; paramāṇvādiṣv atiprasaṅgaḥ syāt.
tatra bhāvamano jñānam; tasya jīvaguṇatvād ātmany antarbhāvaḥ.
nanu amūrte ’pi śabde jñānopayogakaraṇatvadarśanād vyabhicārī hetur iti cet? na; tasya paudgalikatvān mūrtimattvopapatteḥ.
nanu yathā paramāṇūnāṃ rūpādimatkāryadarśanād rūpādimattvaṃ na tathā vāyumanaso rūpādisatkāryaṃ dṛṣyate iti cet? na; teṣām api tadupapatteḥ.
na ca kecit pārthivādijātiviśeṣayuktāḥ paramāṇavaḥ santi; jātisaṃkareṇārambhadarśanāt.
diśo ’py ākāśe ’ntarbhāvaḥ, ādityodayādyapekṣayā ākāśapradeśapaṅktiṣu ita idam iti vyavahāropapatteḥ.
dharmādīni dravyāṇi gatihetutvādiviśeṣalakṣaṇadravyārthādeśād astitvādisāmānyalakṣaṇadravyārthādeśāc ca kadācid api na vyayantīti nityāni.
dharmādīni ṣaḍ api dravyāṇi kadācid api ṣaḍ iti iyattvaṃ nātivartante.
na vidyate rūpam eṣām ity arūpāṇi, rūpapratiṣedhe tatsahacāriṇāṃ rasādīnām api pratiṣedaḥ.
yathā sarveṣāṃ dravyāṇāṃ ‘nityāvasthitāni’ ity etat sādhāraṇaṃ lakṣaṇaṃ prāptaṃ tathā pudgalānām api arūpitvaṃ prāptam, atas tadapavādārtham āha —
rasādyagrahaṇam iti cet? na; tadavinābhāvāt tadantarbhāvaḥ.
yadi pradhānavad arūpitvam ekatvaṃ ceṣṭaṃ syāt, viśvarūpakāryadarśanavirodhaḥ syāt.
āha, kiṃ pudgalavad dharmādīny api dravyāṇi pratyekaṃ bhinnānīty atrocyate —
tena dravyaṃ viśiṣyate, ekaṃ dravyaṃ ekadravyam iti.
yady evaṃ bahuvacanam ayuktam? dharmādyapekṣayā bahutvasiddhir bhavati.
nanu ekasyānekārthapratyāyanaśaktiyogād ekaikam ity astu, laghutvād.
‘dravya’ grahaṇam anarthakam? (satyam;) tathāpi dravyāpekṣayā ekatvakhyāpanārthaṃ dravyagrahaṇam.
kṣetrabhāvādyapekṣayā asaṃkhyeyatvānantatvavikalpasyeṣṭatvān na jīvapudgalavad eṣāṃ bahutvam ity etad anena khyāpyate.
adhikṛtānām eva ekadravyāṇāṃ viśeṣapratipattyartham idam ucyate —
ubhayanimittavaśād utpadyamānaḥ paryāyo dravyasya deśāntaraprāptihetuḥ kriyā.
atra codyate — dharmādīni dravyāṇi yadi niṣkriyāṇi tatas teṣām utpādo na bavet.
tad yathā — dvividha utpādaḥ — svanimittaḥ parapratyayaś ca.
svanimittas tāvad anantānām agurulaghuguṇānām āgamaprāmāṇyād abhupagamyamānānāṃ ṣaṭ sthānapatitayā vṛddhyā hānyā ca pravartamānānāṃ svabhāvād eteṣām utpādo vyayaś ca.
parapratyayo ’pi aśvādigatisthityavagāhanahetutvāt kṣaṇe kṣaṇe teṣāṃ bhedāt taddhetutvam api bhinnam iti parapratyayāpekṣa utpādo vināśaś ca vyavahriyate.
nanu yadi niṣkriyāṇi dharmādīni, jīvapudgalānāṃ gatyādihetutvaṃ nopapadyate.
jalādīni hi kriyāvanti matsyādīnāṃ gatyādinimittāni dṛṣṭānīti? naiṣa doṣaḥ; balādhānanimittatvāc cakṣurvat.
yathā rūpopalabdhau cakṣur nimittam iti na vyākṣiptamanaskasyāpi bhavati.
adhikṛtānāṃ dharmādharmākāśānāṃ niṣkriyatve ’bhyupagate jīvapudgalānāṃ sakriyatvam arthād āpannam.
kālasyāpi sakriyatvam iti cet? na; anadhikārāt.
ajīvakāyā ity atra kāyagrahaṇena pradeśāstitvamātraṃ nirjñātaṃ na tv iyattāvadhāritā pradeśānām atas tannirdhāraṇārtham idam ucyate —
vakṣyamāṇalakṣaṇaḥ paramāṇuḥ sa yāvati kṣetre vyavatiṣṭhate sa pradeśa iti vyavahriyate.
tatra dharmādharmo niṣkriyau lokākāśaṃ vyāpya sthitau.
jīvas tāvat pradeśo ’pi san saṃharaṇavisarpaṇasvabhāvatvāt karmanirvartitaṃ śarīram aṇu mahad vā ’dhitiṣṭhaṃs tāvad avagāhya vartate.
yadā tu lokapūraṇaṃ bhavati tadā mandarasyādhaś citravajrapaṭalamadhye jīvasyāṣṭau madhyapradeśā vyavatiṣṭhante.
itare pradeśā ūrdhvam adhas tiryak ca kṛtsnaṃ lokākāśaṃ vyaśnuvate.
athākāśaya kati pradeśā ity ata āha —
idānīṃ mūrtānāṃ pudgalānāṃ pradeśaparimāṇaṃ nirjñātavyam ity ata āha —
kasyacit pudgaladravyasya dvyaṇukādeḥ saṃkhyeyāḥ pradeśāḥ kasyacid asaṃkhyeyā anantāś ca.
anantapramāṇaṃ trividham uktam parītānantaṃ yuktānantam anantānantaṃ ceti.
syād etat asaṃkhyāt apradeśo lokaḥ anantapradeśasyānantānantapradeśasya ca skandasyādhikaraṇam iti virodhas tato nānantyam iti? naiṣa doṣaḥ; sūkṣmapariṇāmāvagāhanaśaktiyogāt.
paramāṇvādayo hi sūkṣmabhāvena pariṇatā ekaikasminn apy ākāśapradeśe ’nantānantā avatiṣṭhante, avagāhanaśaktiś caiṣām avyāhatāsti.
tasmād ekasminn api pradeśe anantānantānām avasthānaṃ na virudhyate.
‘pudgalānām ity aviśeṣavacanāt paramāṇor api pradeśavattvaprasaṃge tatpratiṣedhārtham āha —
aṇoḥ ‘pradeśā na santi’ śti vākyaśeṣaḥ. kuto na santīti cet? pradeśamātratvāt.
yathā ākāśapradeśasyaikasya pradeśabhedābhāvād apradeśatvam evam aṇor api pradeśamātratvāt pradeśabhedābhāvaḥ.
na hy aṇor alpīyānanyo ’sti, yato ’sya pradeśā bhidyeran.
eṣām avadhṛtapradeśānāṃ dharmādīnām ādhārapratipattyartham idam ucyate —
uktānāṃ dharmādīnāṃ dravyāṇāṃ lokākāśe ’vagāho na bāhir ity arthaḥ.
yadi dharmādīnāṃ lokākāśam ādhāraḥ, ākāśasya ka ādhāra iti? ākāśasya nāsty anya ādhāraḥ.
yady ākāśaṃ svapratiṣtiṣṭham; dharmādīny api svapratiṣtiṣṭhāny eva.
atha dharmādīnāṃ anya ādhāraḥ kalpyate, ākāśasyāpy anya ādhāra kalpyaḥ.
tathā saty anavasthāprasaṅga ity cet? naiṣa doṣaḥ; nākāśad anyad adhikaparimāṇaṃ dravyam asti yatrākāśaṃ sthitam ity ucyate.
dharmādīnāṃ punar adhikaraṇam ākāśam ity ucyate vyavahāranayavaśāt.
evambhūtanayāpekṣayā tu sarvāṇi dravyāṇi svapratiṣtiṣṭhāny eva.
dharmādīni lokākāśān na bahiḥ santīty etāvad atrādhārādheyakalpanāsādhyaṃ phalam.
nanu ca loke pūrvottarakālabhāvinām ādhārādheyabhāvo dṛṣto yathā kuṇḍe badarādīnām.
na tathā ”kāśaṃ pūrvaṃ dharmādīny uttarakālabhāvīni; ato vyavahāranayāpekṣayā ’pi ādhārādheyakalpanān upapattir iti? naiṣa doṣaḥ, yugpadbhāvinām api ādhārādheyabhāvo dṛśyate.
ko lokaḥ? dharmādharmādīni dravyāṇi yatra lokyante sa loka iti.
ākāśaṃ dvidhā vibhaktaṃ — lokākāśam alokākāśaṃ ceti.
asati hi tasmin dharmāstikāye jīvapudgalānāṃ gatiniyamahetvabhāvād vibhāgo na syāt.
asati cādharmāstikāye sthiter āśrayanimittābhāvāt sthiter abhāvo lokālokavibhagābhāvo vā syāt.
agāre ’sthito ghaṭa iti yathā tathā dharmādharmayor lokākāśe ’vagāho na bhavati.
kiṃ tarhi? kṛtsne tilesu tailavad iti.
ato viparītānāṃ mūrtimatām apradeśasaṃkhyeyāsaṃkhyeyānantapradeśānāṃ pudgalānām avagāhaviśeṣapratipattyartham āha —
ekapradeśa ādir yeṣāṃ ta ime ekapradeśādayaḥ.
avayavena vigrahaḥ samudāyaḥ samāsārthaḥ iti ekapradeśo ’pi gṛhyate.
tad yathā — ekasminn akāśapradeśe paramāṇor avagāhaḥ.
dvayor ekatrobhayatra ca baddhayor abaddhayoś ca.
trayāṇām apy ekatra dvayos triṣu ca baddhānām abaddhānāṃ ca.
evaṃ saṃkhyeyāsaṃkhyeyānantapradeśānāṃ skandhānām ekasaṃkhyeyāsaṃkhyeyapradeśeṣu lokākāśe ’vasthānaṃ pratyetavyam.
nanu yuktaṃ tāvad amūrttayor dharmādharmayor ekatrāvirodhenāvarodha iti.
mūrtimatāṃ pudgalānāṃ katham? ity atrocyate — avagāhanasvabhāvatvāt sūkṣmapariṇāmāc ca mūrtimatām apy avagāho na virudhyate ekāpavarake anekadīpaprakāśāvasthānavat.
atha jīvānāṃ katham avagāhanam ity atrocyate —
tad yathā — ekasminn asaṃkhyeyabhāge eko jīvo ’vatiṣṭhate.
evaṃ dvitricaturādiṣv api asaṃkhyeyabhāgeṣu ā sarvalokād avagāhaḥ pratyetavyaḥ.
yady ekasminn asaṃkhyeyabhāge eko jīvo ’vatiṣṭhate, kathaṃ dravyapramāṇenānantānanto jīvarāśiḥ saśarīro ’vatiṣṭhate lokākāśe? sūkṣmabādarabhedād avasthānaṃ pratyetavyam.
sūkṣmās tu saśarīrā api sūkṣmabhāvād evaikanigodajīvāvagāhye ’pi pradeśe sādhāraṇaśarīrā anantānantā vasanti.
na te paraspareṇa bādaraiś ca vyāhanyanta iti nāsty avagāhavirodhaḥ.
atrāha lokākāśatulyapradeśa ekajīva ity uktam, tasya kathaṃ lokasyāsaṃkhyeyabhāgādiṣu vṛttiḥ.

amūrtasvabhāvasyātmano ’nādibandhaṃ pratyekatvāt kathaṃcin mūrtatāṃ vibhrataḥ kārmaṇaśarīravaśān mahad aṇu ca śarīram adhitiṣṭhatas tadvaśāt pradeśasaṃharaṇavisarpaṇasvabhāvasya tāvat pramāṇatāyāṃ satyām asaṃkhyeyabhāgādiṣu vṛttir upapadyate, pradīpavat.
atrāha dharmādīnām anyonyapradeśānupraveśāt saṃkare sati, ekatvaṃ prāpnotīti? tan na; parasparam atyantasaṃśleṣe saty api svabhāvaṃ na jahati.
yady evaṃ dharmādīnāṃ svabhāvabheda ucyatām ity ata āha —
kaḥ punar asau? gatyupagrahaḥ sthityupagrahaś ca.
naiṣa doṣaḥ; sāmānyena vyutpāditaḥ śabda upāttasaṃkhyaḥ śabdāntarasaṃbandhe saty api na pūrvopāttāṃ saṃkhyāṃ jahāti.
etad uktaṃ bhavati — gatipariṇāmināṃ jīvapudgalānāṃ gatyupagrahe kartavye dharmāstikāyaḥ sādhāraṇāśrayo jalavanmatsyagamane.
tathā sthitipariṇāmināṃ jīvapudgalānāṃ sthityupagrahe kartavye adharmāstikāyaḥ sādhāraṇāśrayaḥ pṛthivīdhatur ivāśvādisthitāv iti.
nanu ca ‘upagraha’ vacanam anarthakam ‘upakāraḥ’ ity evaṃ siddhatvāt.
dharmādharmayor gatisthityoś ca yathāsaṃkhyaṃ bhavati, evaṃ jīvapudgalānāṃ yathāsaṃkhyaṃ prāpnoti dharmasyopakāro jīvānāṃ gatiḥ adharmasyopakāraḥ pudgalānāṃ sthitir iti.
āha dharmādharmayor ya upakāraḥ sa ākāśasya yuktaḥ; sarvagatvād iti cet? tad ayuktam; tasyānyopakārasadbhāvāt.
bhūmijalādiny eva tatprayojanasamarthāni nārtho dharmādharmābhyām iti cet? na; sādhāraṇāśraya iti viśiṣyoktatvāt.
tulyabalatvāt tayor gatisthitipratibandha iti cet? na; aprerakatvāt.
anupalabdher na tau staḥ kharaviṣāṇavad iti cet? na; sarvapravādyavipratipatteḥ.
atrāha, yady atīndriyayor dharmādharmayor upakārasaṃbandhenāstitvam avadhriyate, tadanantaram uddiṣṭasya nabhaso ’tīndriyasyādhigame ka upakāra ity ucyate —
jīvapudgalādīnāṃ avagāhinām avakāśadānam avagāha ākāśasyopakāro veditavyaḥ.
āha, jīvapudgalānāṃ kriyāvatām avagāhinām avakāśadānaṃ yuktam.
dharmāstikāyādayaḥ punar niṣkriyā nityasaṃbandhās teṣāṃ katham avagāha iti cet? na; upacāratas tatsiddheḥ.

yathā gamanābhāve ’pi ‘sarvagatam ākāśam’ ity ucyate; sarvatra sadbhāvāt, evaṃ dharmādharmāv api avagāha kriyābhāve ’pi sarvatra vyāptidarśanād avagāhināv ity upacaryete. āha yady avakāśadānam asya svabhāvo vajrādibhir loṣṭādīnāṃ bhittyādibhir gavādīnāṃ ca vyāghāto na prāpnoti.
naiṣa doṣaḥ; vajraloṣṭādīnāṃ sthūlānāṃ parasparavyāghāta iti nāsyāvakāśadānasāmarthyaṃ hīyate; tatrāvagāhinām eva vyāghātāt.
vajrādayaḥ punaḥ sthūlatvāt parasparaṃ pratyavakāśadānaṃ kurvantīti nāsāv ākāśadoṣaḥ.
ye khalu pudgalāḥ sūkṣmās te parasparaṃ pratyavakāśadānaṃ kurvanti.
yady evaṃ nedam ākāśasyāsādhāraṇaṃ lakṣaṇam; itareṣām api tatsadbhāvād iti? tan na; sarvapadārthānāṃ sādhāraṇāvagāhanahetutvam asyāsādhāraṇaṃ lakṣaṇam iti nāsti doṣaḥ.
alokākāśe tadbhāvād abhāva iti cet? na; svabhāvāparityāgāt.
atha tadanantaroddiṣṭānāṃ pudgalānāṃ ka upakāra ity atrocyate —
kim atrāyuktam? pudgalānāṃ ka upakāra ity paripraśne pudgalānāṃ lakṣaṇam ucyate; śarīrādīni pudgalamayānīti? naitad ayuktam; pudgalānāṃ lakṣaṇam uttaratra vakṣyate.
idaṃ tu jīvān prati pudgalānām upakārapratipādanārtham eveti upakāraprakaraṇe ucyate.
tadudayāpāditavṛttīny upacayaśarīrāṇi kānicit pratyakṣāṇi kānicid apratyakṣāṇi.
eteṣāṃ kāraṇabhūtāni karmāny api śarīragrahaṇena gṛhyante.
etāni paudgalikānīti kṛtvā jīvānām upakāre pudgalāḥ pravartante.
ākāravatāṃ hi audārikādīni paudagalikatvaṃ yuktam iti? tan na; tad api paudagalikam eva; tadvipākasya mūrtimatsambandhanimittatvāt.
tathā kārmaṇam api guḍakaṇṭakādimūrtimaddravyopanipāte sati vipacyamānatvāt paudagalikaṃ ity avaseyam.
tatsāmarthyopetena kriyāvatātmanā preryamāṇāḥ pudgalā vāktvena vipariṇamanta iti dravyavāg api paudgalikī; śrotendriyaviṣayatvāt.
amūrtā vāg iti cet? na; mūrtimadgrahaṇāvarodhavyāghātābhibhavādidarśanān mūrtimattvasiddheḥ.
dravyamanaś ca, jñānāvaraṇavīryāntarāyakṣayopaśamāṅgopāṅganāmalābhapratyayā guṇadoṣavicārasmaraṇādipranidhānābhimukhasyātmano ’nugrāhakāḥ pudgalā manas tv ena pariṇatā iti paudagalikam.
kaścid āha mano dravyāntaraṃ rūpādipariṇāmarahitam aṇumātraṃ tasya paudagalikatvaṃ ayuktam iti? tad ayuktam.
katham? ucyate — tadindriyeṇātmanā ca saṃbaddhaṃ vā syād asaṃbaddham vā.
yady asaṃbaddham, tannātmana upakārakaṃ bhavitum arhati indriyasya ca sācivyaṃ na karoti.
atha saṃbaddham, ekasmin pradeśe saṃbaddhaṃ sat tad aṇu itareṣu pradeśeṣu upakāraṃ na kuryāt.
amūrtasyātmano niṣkriyasyādṛṣṭo guṇaḥ, sa niṣkriyaḥ sann anyatra kriyārambhe na samarthaḥ.
dṛṣṭo hi vāyudravyaviśeṣaḥ kriyāvān sparśavān prāptavanaspatau parispandahetus tadviparītalakṣaṇaś cāyam iti kriyāhetutvābhāvaḥ.
vīryāntrāyajñānāvaraṇakṣayopaśamāṅgopāṅganāmodayāpekṣiṇātmanā udasyamānaḥ koṣṭhyo vāyur ucchvāsalakṣaṇaḥ prāṇa ity ucyate.
tenaivātmanā bāhyo vāyur abhyantarīkriyamāṇo niḥsvāsalakṣaṇo ’pāna ity ākhyāyate.
yathā yantrapratimāceṣṭitaṃ prayoktur astitvaṃ gamayati tathā prāṇāpānādikarmāpi kriyāvantam ātmānaṃ sādhayati.
kim etāvān eva pudgalakṛta upakāra āhosvid anyo ’py astīty ata āha —
sadasadvedyodaye ’ntaraṅgahetau sati bāhyadravyādiparipākanimittavāśād utpadyamānaḥ prītiparitāparūpaḥ pariṇāmaḥ sukhaduḥkham ity ākhyāyate.
bhavadhāranakāraṇāyurākhyakarmodayāt bhavasthitim ādadhānasya jīvasya pūrvoktaprāṇāpānakriyāviśeṣāvyucchedo jīvitam ity ucyate.
etani sukhādīni jīvasya pudgalakṛta upakāraḥ; mūrtimaddhetusaṃnidhāne sati tadutpatteḥ.
tad yathā — kāṃsyādīnāṃ bhasmādibhir jalādīnāṃ katakādibhir ayaḥprabhṛtīnām udakādibhir upakāraḥ kriyate.
evam ādyam ajīvakṛtam upakāraṃ pradarśya jīvakṛtopakārapradarśanārtham āha —
kaḥ punar asau? svāmī bhṛtyaḥ, ācāryaḥ śiṣyaḥ, ity evam ādibhāvena vṛttiḥ parasparopagrahaḥ.
svāmī tāvad vittatyāgādinā bhṛtyānām upakare vartate.
ācārya ubhayalokaphalapradopadeśadarśanena tadupadeśavihitakriyānuṣṭhāpanena ca śiṣyāṇām anugrahe vartate.
upakārādhikāre punaḥ ‘upagraha’ vacanaṃ kim artham? pūrvoktasukhādicatuṣṭayapradarśanārthaṃ punaḥ ‘upagraha’ vacanaṃ kriyate.
sukhādīny api jīvānāṃ jīvakṛta upakāra iti.
āha, yady avaśyaṃ satopakāriṇā bhavitavyam; saṃś ca kālo ’bhimatas tasya ka upakāra ity atrocyate —
vṛtter ṇijatantāt karmaṇi bhāve vā yuṭi strīliṃge vartaneti bhavati.
dharmādīnāṃ dravyāṇāṃ svaparyāyanivṛttiṃ prati svātmanaiva vartamānānāṃ bāhyopagrahād vinā tadvṛttyabhāvāt tatpravartanopalakṣitaḥ kāla iti kṛtvā vartanā kālasyopakāraḥ.
ko nij arthaḥ? vartate dravyaparyāyas tasya vartayitā kālaḥ.
yathā śiṣyo ’dhīte, upādhyāyo ’dhyāpayatīti? naiṣa doṣaḥ; nimittamātre ’pi hetukartṛ vyapadeśo dṛṣṭaḥ.

sa kathaṃ kāla ity avasīyate? samayādīnāṃ kriyāviśeṣāṇāṃ samayādibhir nirvartyamānānāṃ ca pākādīnāṃ samayaḥ pāka ity evam ādi svasaṃjñārūḍhisadbhāve ’pi samayaḥ kālaḥ odanapākaḥ kāla iti adhyāropyamāṇaḥ kālavyapadeśas tadvyapadeśanimittasya kālasyāstitvaṃ gamayati.
ta ete vartanādaya upakārāḥ kālasyāstitvaṃ gamayanti.
nanu ‘vartanā’ grahaṇam evāstu, tadbhedāḥ pariṇāmādayas teṣāṃ pṛthaggrahaṇam anarthakam? nānarthakam; kāladvayasūchanārthatvat prapañcasya.
kālo hi dvividhaḥ paramārthakālo vyavahārakālaś ca.
anyena paricchinnaḥ anyasya paricchedahetuḥ kriyāviśeṣaḥ kāla iti vyavahriyate.
sa tridhā vyavatiṣṭhate — bhūto vartamāno bhaviṣyann iti.
lakṣaṇaṃ coktam ‘upayogo lakṣaṇam’ ity evam ādi.
ta ete mūlabhedāḥ pratyekaṃ saṃkheyāsaṃkhyeyānantabhedāś ca bhavanti.
sparśaś ca rasaś ca gandhaś ca varṇaś ca sparśarasagandhavarṇās ta eteṣāṃ santīti sparśarasagandhavarṇavanta iti.

nanu ca rūpiṇaḥ pudgalā ity atra pudgalānāṃ rūpavattvam uktaṃ tadavinābhāvinaś ca rasādayas tatraiva parigṛhītā iti vyākhyātaṃ tasmāt tenaiva pudgalānāṃ rūpādimattvasiddheḥ sūtram idam anarthakam iti? naiṣa doṣaḥ; ‘nityāvasthitāny arūpāṇi’ ity atra dharmādīnāṃ nityatvādinirūpaṇena pudgalānām arūpitvaprasaṃge tadapākaraṇārthaṃ taduktam.
puruṣaprayoganimittaḥ prāyogikaḥ ajīvaviṣayo jīvājīvaviṣayaś ceti dvidhā bhinnaḥ.
sthaulyam api dvividham antyam āpekṣikaṃ ceti.
ato ’nyan meghādīnāṃ saṃsthānam anekavidham ittham idam iti nirūpaṇābhāvād anitthaṃlakṣaṇam.
aṇucaṭanaṃ san taptāyaḥ piṇḍādiṣu ayoghanādibhir abhihanyamāneṣu sphuliṅganirgamaḥ.
‘ca’ śabdena nodanābhighātādayaḥ pudgalapariṇāmā āgame prasiddhāḥ samuccīyante.
uktaṃ ca — attādi attamajjhaṃ attaṃtaṃ ṇeva iṃdiye gejjhaṃ
jaṃ davvaṃ avibhāgī taṃ paramāṇuṃ viāṇāhi
rūḍhau kriyā kvacit satī upalakṣaṇatvenāśrīyate iti grahaṇādivyāpārāyogyeṣv api dvyaṇukādiṣu skandhākhyā pravartate.
anantabhedā api pudgalā aṇujātyā skandhajātyā ca dvaividhyam āpadyamānāḥ sarve gṛhyanta iti tajjātyādhārānantabhedasaṃsūcanārthaṃ bahuvacanaṃ kriyate.
attādi attamajjhaṃ attaṃtaṃ ṇeva iṃdiye gejjhaṃ
jaṃ davvaṃ avibhāgī taṃ paramāṇuṃ viāṇāhi
āha, kim eṣāṃ pudgalānām aṇuskandhalakṣaṇaḥ pariṇāmo ’nādir uta ādimān ity ucyate.
yady evaṃ tasmād abhidhīyatāṃ kasmān nimittād utpadyanta iti.
bhedāt saṃghātād bhedasaṃghātābhyām ca utpadyanta iti.
tad yathā — dvayoḥ paramāṇvoḥ saṃghātād dvipradeśaḥ skandha utpadyate.
dvipradeśasyāṇoś ca trayāṇām vā aṇūnāṃ saṃghātāt tripradeśaḥ.
dvayor dvipradeśayos tripradeśasyāṇoś ca caturṇāṃ vā aṇūnāṃ saṃghātāc catuḥpradeśaḥ.
evaṃ saṃkheyāsaṃkhyeyānantānām anantānantānāṃ ca saṃghātāt tāvat pradeśaḥ.
eṣām eva bhedāt tāvad dvipradeśaparyantāḥ skandhā utpadyante.
evaṃ bhedasaṃghātābhyām ekasamayikābhyāṃ dvipradeśādayaḥ skandhā utpadyante.
aṇor utpattir bhedād eva, na saṃghātān nāpi bhedasaṃghātābhyām iti.
āha, saṃghātād eva skandhānām ātmalābhe siddhe bhedasaṃghātagrahaṇam anarthakam iti tadgrahaṇaprayojanapratipādanārtham idam ucyate —
tatra yo ’cākṣuṣaḥ sa kathaṃ cākṣuṣo bhavatīti ced ucyate — bhedasaṃghātābhyāṃ cākṣuṣaḥ.
kātropapattir iti cet? brūmaḥ; sūkṣmapariṇāmasya skandhasya bhede saukṣmyāparityāgād acākṣuṣatvam eva.
saukṣmyapariṇataḥ punar aparaḥ saty api tadbhede ’nyasaṃghātāntarasaṃyogāt saukṣmyapariṇamoparame sthaulyotpattau cākṣuṣo bhavati.
āha, dharmādīnām dravyāṇāṃ viśeṣalakṣaṇāny uktāni, sāmānyalakṣaṇaṃ noktam, tadvaktavyam.
yat sat tad dravyam ity arthaḥ.
yady evaṃ tad eva tāvad vaktavyaṃ kiṃ sat.
cetanasyācetanasya vā dravyasya svāṃ jātim ajahata ubhayanimittavaśād bhāvāntarāvāptir utpādanam utpādaḥ mṛtpiṇḍasya ghaṭaparyāyavat.
tair utpādavyayadhrauvyair yuktaṃ utpādavyayadhrauvyayuktaṃ sad iti. āha, bhede sati yuktaśabdo dṛṣṭaḥ.
tathā sati teṣāṃ trayāṇāṃ tair yuktasya dravyasya cābhāvaḥ prāpnoti? naiṣa doṣaḥ; abhede ’pi kathaṃcid bhedanayāpekṣayā yuktaśabdo dṛṣṭaḥ.
tathā sati teṣām avinābhāvāt sadvyapadeśo yuktaḥ.
etad uktaṃ bhavati — utpādādīni dravyasya lakṣaṇāni.
āha ‘nityāvasthitāny arūpāṇi’ ity uktaṃ tatra na jñāyate kiṃ nityam ity ata āha —
tad akasmān na bhavatīti yo ’sya hetuḥ sa tadbhāvaḥ.
yenātmanā prāgdṛṣṭaṃ vastu tenaivātmanā punar api bhāvāt tad evedam iti pratyabhijñāyate.
yady atyantanirodho ’bhinavaprādurbhāvamātram eva vā syāt tataḥ smaraṇānupapattiḥ.
tatas tadabhāvenāvyayaṃ tadbhāvāvyayaṃ nityam iti niścīyate.
nanu idam eva viruddhaṃ tad eva nityaṃ tad evānityam iti.
athānityam eva sthityabhāvān nityatāvyāghāta iti? naitad viruddham.
anekāntātmakasya vastunaḥ prayojanavaśād yasya kasyacid dharmasya vivakṣayā prāpitaṃ prādhānyam arpitam upanītam iti yāvat.
prayojanābhāvāt sato ’py avivakṣā bhavatīty upasarjanībhūtam anarpitam ity ucyate.
tad yathā — ekasya devadattasya pitā putro bhrātā bhāgineya ity evam ādayaḥ saṃbandhā janakatvajanyatvādinimittā na virudhyante; arpaṇābhedāt.
putrāpekṣayā pitā, pitrapekṣayā putra ity evam ādiḥ.
tathā dravyam api sāmānyārpaṇayā nityam, viśeṣārpaṇayānityam iti nāsti virodhaḥ.
tau ca sāmānyaviśeṣau kathaṃcid bhedābhedābhyāṃ vyavahārahetū bhavataḥ.
atrāha, sato ’nekanayavyavahāratantratvāt upapannā bhedasaṃghātebhyaḥ satāṃ skandhātmanotpattiḥ.
idaṃ tu saṃdigdham, kiṃ saṃghātaḥ saṃyogād eva dvyaṇukādilakṣaṇo bhavati, uta kaścid viśeṣo ’vadhriyata iti? ucyate, ‘sati saṃyoge bandhād ekatvapariṇāmātmakāt saṃghāto niṣpadyate.

yady evam idam ucyatāṃ, kuto nu khalu pudgalajātyaparityāge saṃyoge ca sati bhavati keṣāṃcid bandho ’nyeṣāṃ ca neti? ucyate, yasmāt teṣāṃ pudgalātmāviśeṣe ’py anantaparyāyāṇāṃ parasparavilakṣaṇapariṇāmād āhitasāmartyād bhavanpratītaḥ —
dvayoḥ snigdharūkṣayor aṇvoḥ parasparaśleṣalakṣaṇe bandhe sati dvyaṇukaskandho bhavati.
tathā paramāṇuṣv api snigdharūkṣaguṇayor vṛttiḥ prakarṣāprakarśeṇānumīyate.
snigdharūkṣatvaguṇanimitte bandhe aviśeṣeṇa prasakte aniṣṭaguṇanivṛttyartham āha —
tad yathā — ekaguṇasnigdhasyaikaguṇasnigdhena dvyādisaṃkhyeyāsaṃkheyānantaguṇasnigdhena vā nāsti bandhaḥ.
tasyaivaikaguṇasnigdhasya ekaguṇarūkṣeṇa dvyādisaṃkhyeyāsaṃkheyānantaguṇarūkśeṇa vā nāsti bandhaḥ.
etau jaghanyaguṇasnigdharūkṣau varjayitvā anyeṣāṃ snigdhānāṃ rūkṣāṇāṃ ca paraspareṇa bandho bhavatīty aviśeṣeṇa prasaṃge tatrāpi pratiṣedhaviṣayakhyāpanārtham āha —
etad uktaṃ bhavati — dviguṇasnigdhānāṃ dviguṇarūkṣaiḥ triguṇasnigdhānāṃ dviguṇarūkṣaiḥ dviguṇasnigdhānāṃ dviguṇasnigdhaiḥ dviguṇarūkṣāṇāṃ dviguṇarūkṣaiś caityevam ādiṣu nāsti bandha iti.
yady evaṃ ‘sadṛśa’ grahaṇaṃ kim artham? guṇavaiṣamye sadṛśānām api bandhapratipattyarthaṃ ‘sadṛśa’ grahaṇaṃ kriyate.
ato viṣamaguṇānāṃ tulyajātīyānām atulyajātīyānām cāniyamena bandhaprasaktau iṣṭārthasaṃpratyayārtham idam ucyate —
tena dvyadhikādiguṇānāṃ tulyajātīyānām atulyajātīyānām ca bandha ukto bhavati netareṣām.
tad yathā — dviguṇasnigdhasya paramāṇor ekaguṇasnigdhena dviguṇasnigdhena triguṇasnigdhena vā nāsti bandhaḥ.
tasyaiva punar dviguṇasnigdhasya pañcaguṇasnigdhena ṣaṭsaptāṣṭasaṃkhyeyānantaguṇasnigdhena vā bandho nāsti.
tasyaiva dviguṇarūkṣasya pañcaguṇarūkṣādibhir uttariar nāsti bandhaḥ.
evaṃ triguṇarūkṣādīnām api dviguṇādhikair bandho yojyaḥ.
uktaṃ ca — ṇiddhassa ṇiddhe ṇa durādhieṇa lukkhassa lukkheṇa durādhieṇa
ṇiddhassa lukkheṇa havei baṃdho jahaṇṇavajjo visame same vā
ṇiddhassa ṇiddhe ṇa durādhieṇa lukkhassa lukkheṇa durādhieṇa
ṇiddhassa lukkheṇa havei baṃdho jahaṇṇavajjo visame same vā
kim artham adhikaguṇaviṣayo bandho vyākhyāto na samaguṇaviṣaya ity ata āha —
yathā klinno guḍo ’dhikamadhurarasaḥ parītānāṃ reṇvādīnāṃ svaguṇāpādanāt pāriṇāmikaḥ.
tathānyo ’py adhikaguṇa alpīyasaḥ pāriṇāmika iti kṛtvā dviguṇādisnigdharūkṣasya caturguṇādisnigdharūkṣaḥ pāriṇāmiko bhavati.
tataḥ pūrvāvasthāpracyavanapūrvakaṃ tārtīyikam avasthāntaraṃ prādurbhavatīty ekatvam upapadyate.
itarathā hi śuklakṛṣṇatantuvat saṃyoge saty apy apāriṇāmikatvāt sarvaṃ viviktarūpeṇaivāvatiṣṭheta.
uktena vidhinā bandhe punaḥ sati jñānāvaraṇādīnāṃ karmaṇāṃ triṃśatsāgaropamakoṭikoṭyādisthitir upapanna bhavati.
‘utpādavyayadhrauvyayuktaṃ sat’ iti dravyalakṣaṇam uktaṃ punar apareṇa prakāreṇa dravyalakṣaṇapratipādanārtham āha —
atra mator utpattāv ukta eva samādhiḥ, kathaṃcid bhedopapatter iti.
ke guṇāḥ ke paryāyāḥ? anvayino guṇā vyatirekiṇaḥ paryāyāḥ.
uktaṃ ca — guṇa idi davvavihāṇaṃ davvavikāro hi pajjavo bhaṇido
tehi aṇūṇaṃ davvaṃ ajudapasiddhaṃ have ṇiccaṃ
iti etad uktaṃ bhavati, dravyaṃ dravyāntarād yena viśiṣyate sa guṇaḥ.
tad yathā — jīvaḥ pudgalādibhyo jñānādibhir guṇair viśiṣyate, pudgalādayaś ca rūpādibhiḥ.
tataḥ sāmānyāpekṣayā anvayino jñānādayo jīvasya guṇāḥ pudgalādīnāṃ ca rūpādayaḥ.
ghaṭajñānaṃ paṭajñānaṃ krodho māno gandho varṇas tīvro manda ity evam ādayaḥ.
yadi hi sarvathā samudāyo ’narthāntarabhūta eva syāt sarvābhāvaḥ syāt.
tad yathā — parasparavilakṣaṇānāṃ samudāye sati ekānarthāntarabhāvāt samudāyasya sarvābhāvaḥ parasparato ’rthāntarabhūtatvāt.
yadi idaṃ rūpaṃ tasmād arthāntarabhūtā rasādayaḥ.
yaś ca rasādibhyo ’rthantarabhūtād rūpād anarthāntarabhūtaḥ samudāyaḥ sa kathaṃ rasādibhyo ’rthāntarabhūto na bhavet.
na caikaṃ rūpaṃ samudāyo bhavitum arhati.
samudāyābhāvāc ca tadanarthāntarabhūtānāṃ samudāyinām apy abhāva iti sarvābhāvaḥ.
tasmāt samudāyam icchatā kathaṃcid arthāntarabhāva eṣitavyaḥ.
guṇa idi davvavihāṇaṃ davvavikāro hi pajjavo bhaṇido
tehi aṇūṇaṃ davvaṃ ajudapasiddhaṃ have ṇiccaṃ
uktānāṃ dravyāṇāṃ lakṣaṇanirdeśāt tadviṣaya eva dravyādhyavasāye prasakte anuktadravyasaṃsūcanārtham āha —
dvividhaṃ lakṣaṇam uktam — ‘utpādavyayadhrauvyayuktaṃ sat’ ‘guṇaparyayavad dravyam’ iti ca.
tad yathā — dhrauvyaṃ tāvat kālasya svapratyayaṃ svabhāvavyavasthānāt.
vyayodayau parapratyayau, agurulaghuguṇavṛddhihāny apekṣayā svapratyayau ca.
tathā guṇā api kālasya sādhāraṇāsādhāraṇarūpāḥ santi.
tasmād dviprakāralakṣaṇopetatvād ākāśādivat kālasya dravyatvaṃ siddham.
nanu kim artham ayaṃ kālaḥ pṛthag ucyate.
yatraiva dharmādaya uktās tatraivāyam api vaktavyaḥ ‘ajīvakāyā dharmādharmākāśakālapudgalāḥ’ iti.
naivaṃ śaṅkhyam; tatroddeśe sati kāyatvam asya syāt.
dharmādīnaṃ tāvan mukyapradeśapracaya uktaḥ ‘asaṃkhyeyāḥ pradeśāḥ’ ity evam ādinā.
kālasya punar dvedhāpi pradeśapracayakalpanā nāstīty akāyatvam.
api ca tatra pāṭhe ‘niṣkriyāṇi ca’ ity atra dharmādīnām ākāśāntānāṃ niṣkriyatve pratipādite itareṣāṃ jīvapudgalānāṃ sakriyatvaprāptivat kālasyāpi sakriyatvaṃ syāt.
tan na; ‘ā ākāśād ekadravyāṇi’ ity ekadravyatvam asya syāt.
lokākāśasya yāvantaḥ pradeśās tāvantaḥ kālāṇavo niṣkriyāḥ.
uktaṃ ca — logāgāsapadese ekkekke je ṭṭhiyā hu ekkakkā
logāgāsapadese ekkekke je ṭṭhiyā hu ekkakkā
pariṇāmādigamyasya vyavahārakālasya kiṃ pramānam ity ata idam ucyate —
sāmpratikasyaikasamayikatve ’pi atīta anāgatāś ca samayā anantā iti kṛtvā ‘anantasamayaḥ’ ity ucyate.
athavā mukhyasyaiva kālasya pramāṇāvadhāraraṇārtham idam ucyate.
anantaparyāyavartanāhetutvād eko ’pi kālāṇur ananta ity upacaryate.
samayaḥ punaḥ paramaniruddhaḥ kālāṃśas tatpracayaviśeṣa āvalikādir avagantavyaḥ.
āha guṇaparyayavad dravyam ity uktaṃ tatra ke guṇā ity atrocyate —
tāny api hi kāraṇabhūtaparamāṇudravyāśrayāṇi guṇavanti tu tasmāt ‘nirguṇāḥ’ iti viśeṣaṇāt tāni nivarttitāni bhavanti.
nanu paryāyā api ghaṭasaṃsthānādayo dravyāśrayā nirguṇaś ca, teṣām api guṇatvaṃ prāpnoti.
‘dravyāśrayāḥ’ iti vacanāt ‘nityaṃ dravyam āśritya vartante ye’ te guṇā iti viśeṣāt paryāyā nivartitā bhavanti.
tasya ko ’rtha iti praśne uttaram āha —
athavā guṇā dravyād arthāntarabhūtā iti keṣāṃcid darśanaṃ tat kiṃ bhavato ’bhimatam.
na; ity āha — yady api kathaṃcid vyapadeśādibhedahetvapekṣayā dravyād anye, tathāpi tadavyatirekāt tatpariṇāmāc ca nānye.
yady evaṃ sa ucyatāṃ kaḥ pariṇāma iti.
tanniścayārtham idam ucyate — dharmādīni dravyāṇi yenātmanā bhavanti sa tadbhāvas tattvaṃ pariṇāma iti ākhyāyate.
sa evādimāṃś ca bhavati viśeṣāpekṣayā iti.
idāniṃ tadanantaroddeśabhāgāsravapadārtho vyākhyeya iti tatas tatprasiddhyartham idam ucyate —
kāyavāṅmanasāṃ karma kāyavāṅmanaḥkarma yoga ity ākhyāyate.
tad yathā — vīryāntarāyakṣayopaśamasadbhāve sati audārikādisaptavidhakāyavargaṇānyatamālambanāpekṣa ātmapradeśaparispandaḥ kāyayogaḥ.
kṣaye ’pi trividhavargaṇāpekṣaḥ sayogakevalina ātmapradeśaparispando yogo veditavyaḥ.
prakṛta idānīṃ nirdiśyatām kiṃ lakṣaṇa āsrava ity ucyate.
yathā sarassalilāvāhidvāraṃ tadāsravakāraṇatvād āsrava ity ākhyāyate tathā yogapraṇālikayā ātmanaḥ karma āsravatīti yoga āsrava iti vyapadeśam arhati.
āha, karma dvividhaṃ puṇyaṃ pāpaṃ ceti.
tasya kim aviśeṣeṇa yoga āsravahetur āhosvid asti kaścit prativiśeṣa ity atrocyate —
kaḥ śubho yogaḥ ko vā aśubhaḥ.
yady evam ucyate śubhayoga eva na syāt, śubhayogasyāpi jñānāvaraṇādibandhahetutvābhyupagamāt.
pāti rakṣati ātmānaṃ śubhād iti pāpam.
āha kim ayam āsravaḥ sarvasaṃsāriṇām samānaphalārambhahetur āhosvit kaścid asti prativiśeṣa ity atrocyate —
yathā kaṣāyo naiyagrodhādiḥ śleṣahetus tathā krodhādir apy ātmanaḥ karmaśleṣahetutvāt kaṣāya iva kaṣāya ity ucyate.
sakaṣāyaś cākaṣāyaś ca sakaṣāyākaṣāyau tayoḥ sakaṣāyākaṣāyayoḥ.
īraṇam īryā yogo gatir ity arthaḥ.
yathāsaṃkhyam abhisaṃbandhaḥ sakaṣāyasyātmano mithyādṛṣṭyādeḥ sāṃparāyikasya karmaṇa āsravo bhavati.
akaṣāyasya upaśāntakaṣāyāder īryāpathasya karmaṇa āsravo bhavati.
atra indriyādīnāṃ paṃcādibhir yathāsaṃkhyam abhisaṃbandho veditavyaḥ, indriyāṇi paṃca.
pañcaviṃśatiḥ kriyā ucyante — caityagurupravacanapūjādilakṣaṇā samyaktvavardhanī kriyā samyaktvakriyā.
yāṃ pareṇa nirvartyāṃ kriyāṃ svayaṃ karoti sā svahastakriyā.
yathoktām ājñām āvaśyakādiṣu cāritramohodayāt kartum aśaknuvato ’nyathāprarūpaṇad ājñāvyāpādikī kriyā.
chedanabhedanaviśasanādikriyāparatvam anyena vārambhe kriyamāṇe praharṣaḥ prārambhakriyā.
anyaṃ mithyādarśanakriyākaraṇakāraṇāviṣṭaṃ praśaṃsādibhir dṛḍhayati yathā sādhu karoṣīti sā mithyādarśanakriyā.
etānīndriyādīni kāryakāraṇabhedād bhedam āpadyamānāni sāṃparāyikasya karmaṇa āśravadvārāṇi bhavanti.
atrāha, yogatrayasya sarvātmakāryatvāt sarveṣāṃ saṃsāriṇāṃ sādhāraṇaḥ, tato bandhaphalānubhavanaṃ pratyaviśeṣa ity atrocyate — naitad evam.
yasmāt saty api pratyātmasaṃbhave teṣāṃ jīvapariṇāmebhyo ’nantavikalpebhyo viśeṣo ’bhyanujñāyate katham iti ced ucyate —
ayaṃ prāṇī mayā hantavya iti jñātvā pravṛttir jñātam ity ucyate.
adhikriyante ’sminn arthā ity adhikaraṇaṃ dravyam ity arthaḥ.
bhāvaśabdaḥ pratyekaṃ parisamāpyate — tīvrabhāvo mandabhāva ity ādiḥ.
atrāha, adhikaraṇam uktam, tatsvarūpam anirjñātam atas taducyatām iti.
yady uktalakṣaṇāḥ punarvacanaṃ kiṃ artham? adhikaraṇaviśeṣajñāpanārthaṃ punarvacanaṃ.
jīvājīvā adhikaraṇam ity ayaṃ viśeṣo jñāpayitavya iti.
syād etan mūlapadārthayor dvitvāj jīvājīvāv iti dvivacanaṃ nyāyaprāptam iti.
yena kenacit paryāyeṇa viśiṣṭaṃ dravyam adhikaraṇam, na sāmānyam iti bahuvacanaṃ kṛtam.
ādyaṃ saṃrambhasamārambhārambhayogakṛtakāritānumatakaṣāyaviśeṣais tris tris triś catuś caikaśaḥ
sa pratyekam abhisaṃbadhyate — saṃrambhaviśeṣaḥ samārambhaviśeṣa ity ādi.
ādyaṃ jīvādhikaraṇam etair viśeṣaiḥ ‘bhidyate’ iti vākyaśeṣaḥ.
ete catvāraḥ sujantās tryādiśabdā yathākramam abhisaṃbadhyante — saṃrambhasamārambhārambhās trayaḥ, yogās trayaḥ, kṛtakāritānumatās trayaḥ, kaṣāyāś catvāra iti.
ekaikaṃ tryādīn bhedān nayed ity arthaḥ.

yad yathā — krodhakṛtakāyasaṃrambhaḥ mānakṛtakāyasaṃrambhaḥ māyākṛtakāyasaṃrambhaḥ lobhakṛtakāyasaṃrambhaḥ krodhakāritakāyasaṃrambhaḥ mānakāritakāyasaṃrambhaḥ māyakāritakāyasaṃrambhaḥ lobhakāritakāyasaṃrambhaḥ krodhānumatakāyasaṃrambhaḥ mānānumatakāyasaṃrambhaḥ māyānumatakāyasaṃrambhaḥ lobhānumatakāysaṃrambhaś ceti dvādaśadhā kāyasaṃrambhaḥ.
evaṃ vāgyoge manoyoge ca dvādaśadhā saṃrambhaḥ.
ta ete saṃpiṇḍitāh ṣaṭtriṃśat, tathā samārambhā api ṣaṭtriṃśat, ārambhā api ṣaṭtriṃśat.
ete dvyādibhir yathākramam abhisaṃbadhyante — nirvartanā dvibhedā nikṣepaś caturbhedaḥ saṃyogo dvibhedaḥ nisargas tribheda iti.
paravacanam anarthakam, pūrvasūtre ādyam iti vacanād idam avaśiṣṭārthaṃ bhavatīti.
saṃrambhādibhyo ’nyāni nirvarttanādīni. itarathā hi nirvartanādīnām ātmapariṇāmasadbhāvāj jīvādhikaraṇavikalpā eveti vijñāyeta.
nikṣepaś caturvidhaḥ apratyavekṣitanikṣepādhikaraṇaṃ duḥpramṛṣṭanikṣepādhikaraṇaṃ sahasānikṣepādhikaraṇam anābhoganikṣepādhikaraṇaṃ ceti.
nisargas trividhaḥ — kāyanisargādhikaraṇaṃ vāgnisargādhikaraṇaṃ manonisargādhikaraṇaṃ ceti.
tasmin vaktavye ādyayor jñānadarśanāvaraṇayor āsravabhedapratipattyartham āha —
tattvajñanasya mokṣasādhanasya kīrtane kṛte kasyācid anabhivyāharataḥ antaḥpaiśunyapariṇāmaḥ pradoṣaḥ.
kutaś citkāraṇān nāsti na vedmīty ādi jñānasya vyapalapanaṃ nihnavaḥ.
kutaścit kāraṇād bhāvitam api vijñanaṃ dānārham api yato na dīyate tan mātsaryam.
kāyena vācā ca paraprakāśyajñānasya varjanam āsādanam.
āsādanam eveti cet? sato jñānasya vinayapradānādiguṇakīrtanānuṣṭhānam āsādanam.
upaghātas tu jñānam ajñānam eveti jñānanāśābhiprāyaḥ.
kathaṃ punar aprakṛtayor anirdiṣṭayos tac chabdena parāmarśaḥ kartuṃ śakyaḥ? praśnāpekṣayā.
jñānadarśanāvaraṇayoḥ ka āsrava iti praśne kṛte tadapekṣayā tac chabdo jñānadarśane pratinirdiśati.
etena jñānadarśanavatsu tatsādhaneṣu ca pradoṣādayo yojyāḥ; tannimittatvāt.
ekakāraṇasādhyasya kāryasyānekasya darśanāt tulye ’pi pradoṣādau jñānarśanāvaraṇāsravasiddhiḥ. athavā viṣayabhedād āsravabhedaḥ.
saṃkleśapariṇāmāvalambanaṃ guṇasmaraṇānukīrtanapūrvakaṃ svaparānugrahābhilāṣaviṣayam anukampāpracuraṃ rodanaṃ paridevanam.
nanu ca śokādīnāṃ duḥkhaviśeṣatvād duḥkhagrahaṇam evāstu? satyam evam; tathāpi katipayaviśeṣapratipādanena duḥkhajātyanuvidhānaṃ kriyate.

yathā gaur ity ukte anirjñāte viśeṣe tatpratipādanārthaṃ khaṇḍamuṇḍakṛṣṇaśuklādyupādānaṃ kriyate tathā duḥkhaviṣayāsrvāsaṃkhyeyalokabhedasaṃbhavād duḥkham ity ukte viśeṣānirjñānāt katipayaviśeṣanirdeśena tadviśeṣapratipattiḥ kriyate.
tāny etāni duḥkhādīni krodhādyāveśād ātmasthāni bhavanti parasthāny ubhayasthāni ca.

atra codyate — yadi duḥkhādīny ātmaparobhayasthāny asadvedyāsravanimittāni, kim artham ārhataiḥ keśaluñcanānaśanātapasthānādīni duḥkhanimittāny āsthīyante pareṣu ca pratipādyante iti? naiṣa doṣaḥ — antarańgakrodhādyāveśapūrvakāṇi duḥkhādīny asadvedyāsravanimittānīti viśeṣyoktatvāt.
yathā kasyacid bhiṣajaḥ paramakaruṇāśasya niḥśalyasya saṃyatasyopari gaṇḍaṃ pāṭayato duḥkhahetutve saty api na pāpabandho bāhyanimittamātrād eva bhavati.
evaṃ saṃsāraviṣayamahāduḥkhād udvignasya bhikṣos tannivṛttyupāyaṃ prati samāhitamanaskasya śāstravihite karmaṇi pravartamānasya saṃkleśapariṇāmābhāvād duḥkhanimittatve saty api na pāpabandhaḥ.
tāsu tāsu gatiṣu karmodayavaśād bhavantīti bhūtāni prāṇina ity arthaḥ.
anugrahārdrīkṛtacetasaḥ parapīḍām ātmasthām iva kurvato ’nukampanam anukampā.
sarāgasya saṃyama sarāgo vā saṃyamaḥ sarāgasaṃyamaḥ. ‘ādi’-śabdena saṃyamāsaṃyamākāmanirjarābālatapo ’nurodhaḥ.
atha tadantaroddeśabhājo mohasyāsravahetau vaktavye tadbhedasya darśanamohasyāsravahetupratipādanārtham idam ucyate —
kavalābhyavahārajīvinaḥ kevalina ity evam ādi vacanaṃ kevalinām avarṇavādaḥ.
jinopadiṣṭo dharmo nirguṇas tadupasevino ye te cāsurā bhaviṣyantīty evam ādy abhidhānaṃ dharmāvarṇavādaḥ.
idānīṃ tadanantaranirdiṣṭasyāyuṣa āsravahetau vaktavye ādyasya niyatakālaparipākasyāyuṣaḥ kāraṇapradarśanārtham idam ucyate —
cāritramohakarmaviśeṣasyodayād āvirbhūta ātmanaḥ kuṭilabhāvo māyā nikṛtiḥ tairyagyonasyāyuṣa āsravo veditavyaḥ.
idānīṃ mānuṣasyāyuṣuḥ ko hetur ity atrocyate —
tadvyāsaḥ — vinītasvabhāvaḥ prakṛtibhadratā praguṇavyavahāratā tanukaṣāyatvaṃ maraṇakālāsaṃkleśatādiḥ.
kim etāvān eva mānuṣasyāyuṣa āsrava ity atrocyate —
pṛthagyogakaraṇaṃ kim artham? uttarārtham, devāyuṣa āsravo ’yam api yathā syāt.
kim etad eva dvitīyaṃ mānuṣasyāsravaḥ? na; ity ucyate —
śīlāni ca vratāni ca śīlavratāni tāni vakṣyate.
kiṃ devāyuṣo ’pi bhavati? satyam, bhavati bhogabhūmijāpekṣayā.
atha caturthasyāyuṣaḥ ka āsrava ity atrocyate —
yady evam, pūrvasūtre, ukta āsravavidhir aviśeṣeṇa prasaktaḥ tena sarāgasaṃyamasaṃyamāsaṃyamāv api bhavanavāsyādyāyuṣa āsravau prāpnutaḥ.
naiṣa doṣaḥ; samyaktvābhāve sati tadvyapadeśābhāvāt tadubhayam apy atrāntarbhavati.
āyuṣo ’nantaram uddiṣṭasya nāmna āsravavidhau vaktavye, tatrāśubhānāmna āsravapratipattyartham āha —
yogavakrataivānyathāpravartanam? satyam evam etat — svagatā yogavakratety ucyate.
samyagabhyudayaniḥśreyasārthāsu kriyāsu pravartamānam anyaṃ tadviparītakāyavāṅmanobhir visaṃvādayati maivaṃ kārṣīr evam kurvīti.
atha śubhanāmakarmaṇaḥ ka āsrava ity atra ucyate —

āha kim etāvān eva śubhanāmna āsravavidhir uta kaścid asti prativiśeṣa ity atrocyate — yad idaṃ tīrthakaranāmakarmānantānupamaprabhāvam acintyavibhūtiviśeṣakāraṇaṃ trailokyavijayakaraṃ tasyāsravavidhiviśeṣo ’stīti.

darśanaviśuddhir vinayasampannatā śīlavrateṣv anatīcāro ’bhīkṣṇajñānopayogasaṃvegau śaktitas tyāgatapasī sādhusamādhir vaiyāvṛttyakaraṇam arhadācāryabahuśrutapravacanabhaktir āvaśyakāparihāṇir mārgaprabhāvanā pravacanavatsalatvam iti tīrthakaratvasya
jinena bhagavatārhatparameṣṭhinopadiṣṭe nirgranthalakṣaṇe mokṣavartmani rucir darśanaviśuddhiḥ prāguktalakṣaṇā.
tasyā aṣṭāv aṅgāni niśśaṅkitatvaṃ niḥkāṅkṣitā vicikitsāvirahatā amūḍhadṛṣṭitā upabṛṃhaṇaṃ sthitīkaraṇaṃ vātsalyaṃ prabhāvanaṃ ceti.
samyagjñānādiṣu mokṣamārgeṣu tatsādhaneṣu ca gurvādiṣu svayogyavṛttyā satkāra ādaro vinayas tena saṃpannatā vinayasaṃpannatā.
ahiṃsādiṣu vrateṣu tatpratipālanārtheṣu ca krodhavarjanādiṣu śīleṣu niravadyā vṛttiḥ śīlavrateṣv anatīcāraḥ.
tat trividham — āhāradānam abhayadānaṃ jñādānaṃ ceti.
tacchaktito yathāvidhi prayujyamānaṃ tyāga ity ucyate.
yathā bhāṇḍāgāre dahane samutthite tatpraśamanam anuṣṭhīyate bahūpakāratvāt tathānekavrataśīlasamṛddhasya munes tapasaḥ kutaścit pratyūhe samupasthite tatsaṃdhāraṇaṃ samādhiḥ.
arhadācāryeṣu bahuśruteṣu pravacane ca bhāvaviśuddhiyukto ’nurāgo bhaktiḥ.
tāny etāni ṣodaṣakāraṇāni samyagbhāvyamānāni vyastāni ca tīrthakaranāmakarmāsrvakāraṇāni pratyetavyāni.
idānīṃ nāmāsravābhidhānānantaraṃ gotrāsrave vaktavye sati nīcairgotrasyāsravavidhānārtham idam āha —
tathyasya vātathyasya vā doṣasyodbhāvanaṃ prati icchā nindā.
atrāpi ca yathākramam abhisaṃbandhaḥ — sadguṇocchādanam asadguṇodbhāvanam iti.
kaḥ punar asau viparyayaḥ? ātmanindā, parapraśaṃsā, sadguṇodbhāvanam asadguṇocchādanaṃ ca.
atha gotrānantaram uddiṣṭasyāntarāyasya ka āsrava ity ucyate —
atra codyate — tatpradoṣanihnavādayo jñānadarśanāvaraṇādīnāṃ pratiniyatā āsravahetavo varṇitāḥ, kiṃ te pratiniyatajñānāvaraṇādyāsravahetava eva utāviśeṣeṇeti.
āgame hi sapta karmāṇi āyurvarjyāni pratikṣaṇaṃ yugapad āsravantīty uktam.

athāviśeṣeṇa āsravahetavo viśeṣanirdeśo na yukta iti? atrocyate — yady api tatpradoṣādibhir jñānāvaraṇādīnāṃ sarvāsāṃ karmaprakṛtīnāṃ pradeśabandhaniyamo nāsti, tathāpy anubhāganiyamahetutvena tatpradoṣanihnavādayo vibhājyante.
tadviśeṣapratipattyarthaṃ kaḥ punaḥ śubha ity ukte idam ucyate —
‘pramattayogāt prāṇavyaparopaṇaṃ hiṃsā’ ity evam ādibhiḥ sūtrair hiṃsādayo nirdekṣyante.
tebhyo viramaṇaṃ viratir vratam ity ucyate.
vratam abhisandhikṛto niyamaḥ, idaṃ kartavyam idaṃ na kartavyam iti vā.
nanu ca hiṃsādayaḥ pariṇāmaviśeṣā adhruvāḥ, kathaṃ teṣām apādānatvam ucyate? buddhyapāye dhruvatvavivakṣopapatteḥ.
yathā dharmād viramatīty atra ya eṣa manuṣyaḥ saṃbhinnabuddhiḥ sa paśyati — duṣkaro dharmaḥ, phalaṃ cāsya śraddhāmātragamyam iti sa buddhyā saṃprāpya nivartate.
evam ihāpi ya eva manuṣyaḥ prekṣāpūrvakārī sa paśyati — ya ete hiṃsādayaḥ pariṇāmās te pāpahetavaḥ.
pāpakarmaṇi pravartamānān janān ihaiva rājāno daṇḍayanti paratra ca duḥkham āpnuvantīti sa buddhyā saprāpya nivartate.
‘virati’ śabdaḥ pratyekaṃ parisamāpyate hiṃsāyā viratiḥ anṛtād viratir ity evam ādi.
sarvasāvadyanivṛttilakṣaṇasāmāyikāpekṣayā ekaṃ vrataṃ, tadeva chedopasthāpanāpekṣayā pañcavidham ihocyate.
nanu ca asya vratasyāsravahetutvam anupapannaṃ saṃvarahetuṣv antarbhāvāt.
tatra daśavidhe dharme saṃyame vā vratānām antarbhāva iti? naiṣa doṣaḥ; tatra saṃvaro nivṛttilakṣaṇo vakṣyate.
pravṛttiś cātra dṛśyate; hiṃsānṛtādattādānādiparityāge ahiṃsāsatyavacanadattādānādikriyāpratīteḥ guptyādisaṃvaraparikarmatvāc ca.
vrateṣu hi kṛtaparikarmā sādhuḥ sukhena saṃvaraṃ karotīti tataḥ pṛthaktvenopadeśaḥ kriyate.
nanu ca ṣaṣṭham aṇuvratam asti rātribhojanaviramaṇaṃ tadihopasaṃkhyātavyam? na; bhāvanāsv antarbhāvāt.
deśaś ca sarvaś ca deśasarvau tābhyaṃ deśasarvataḥ.
deśato viratir aṇuvrataṃ sarvato viratir mahāvratam iti dvidhā bhidyate pratyekaṃ vratam.
etāni vratāni bhāvitāni varauṣadhavadyatnavate duḥkhanivṛttinimittāni bhavanti.
kim arthaṃ kathaṃ vā bhāvanaṃ teṣām ity atrocyate —
teṣāṃ vratānāṃ sthirīkaraṇāyaikaikasya vratasya pañca pañca bhāvanā veditavyāḥ.
yady evam ādyasyāhiṃsāvratasya bhāvanāḥ kā ity atrocyate —
vāgguptīḥ manoguptīḥ īryāsamitiḥ ādānānanikṣepaṇasamitiḥ ālokitapānabhojanam ity etāḥ pañcāhiṃsāvratasya bhāvanāḥ.
atha dvitīyasya vratasya kā ity atrocyate —
krodhapratyākhyānaṃ lobhapratyākhyānaṃ bhīrutvapratyākhyānaṃ hāsyapratyākhyānam anivīcībhāṣaṇaṃ cety etāḥ pañca bhāvanā satyavratasya jñeyāḥ.
idānīṃ tṛtīyasya vratasya kā bhāvanā ity atrāha —
athedānīṃ brahmacaryavratasya bhāvanā vaktavyā ity atrāha —
strīrāgakathāśravaṇatyāgaḥ tanmanoharāṅganirīkṣaṇatyāgaḥ pūrvaratānusmaraṇatyāgaḥ vṛṣyeṣṭarasatyāgaḥ svaśarīrasaṃskāratyāgaś ceti caturthavratasya bhāvanāḥ pañca vijñeyāḥ.
atha pañcamavratasya bhāvanā kā ity atrocyate —
pañcānām indriyāṇāṃ sparśanādīnām iṣṭāniṣṭeṣu viṣayeṣūpanipatiteṣu sparśādīṣu rāgavarjanāni pañca ākiṃcanyasya vratasya bhāvanāḥ pratyetavyāḥ.
kiṃcānyadyathāmīṣāṃ vratānāṃ draḍhimārthaṃ bhāvanāḥ pratīyante tadvipaścidbhir iti bhāvanopadeśaḥ, tathā tadarthaṃ tadvirodhiṣv apīty āha —
apāyaś cāvadyaṃ cāpāyāvadye tayor darśanam apāyāvadyadarśanaṃ bhāvayitavyam.

katham iti ced ucyate — hiṃsāyāṃ tāvat, hiṃsro hi nityodvejanīyaḥ satatānubaddhavairaś ca iha ca vadhabandhaparikleśādīn pratilabhate pretya cāśubhāṃ gatiṃ garhitaś ca bhavatīti hiṃsāyā vyuparamaḥ śreyān.

tāthā anṛtavādī aśraddheyo bhavati ihaiva ca jihvācchedādīn pratilabhate mithyābhyākhānaduḥkhitebhyaś ca baddhavairebhyo bahūni vyasanāny avāpnoti pretya cāśubhāṃ gatiṃ garhitaś ca bhavatīti anṛtavacanād uparamaḥ śreyān.
ihaiva cābhighātavadhabandhahastapādakarṇanāsottarauṣṭhachedanabhedanasarvasvaharaṇādīn pratilabhate pretya cāśubhāṃ gatiṃ garhitaś ca bhavatīti steyād vyuparatiḥ śreyasī.

tathā abrahmacarī madavibhramodbhrāntacitto vanagaja iva vāsitāvañcito vivaśo vadhabandhanaparikleśān anubhavati mohābhibhūtatvāc ca kāryākāryānabhijño na kiṃcit kuśalam ācarati parāṅganāliṅganasaṅgakṛtaratiś cehaiva vairānubandhano liṃgacchedanavadhabandhasarvasvaharaṇādīn apāyān prāpnoti pretya cāśubhāṃ gatim aśnute garhitaś ca bhavati ato viratir ātmahitā.

tathā parigrahavān śakunir iva gṛhītamāṃsakhaṇḍo ’nyeṣāṃ tadarthināṃ patattriṇām ihaiva taskarādīnām abhibhavanīyo bhavati tadarjanarakṣaṇaprakṣayakṛtāṃś ca doṣān bahūn avāpnoti na cāsya tṛptir bhavati indhanair ivāgneḥ lobhābhibhūtatvāc ca kāryākāryānapekṣo bhavati pretya cāśubhāṃ gatim āskandate lubhdo ’yam iti garhitaś ca bhavatīti tadviramaṇaṃ śreyaḥ.
asadvedyakarma ca duḥkhakāraṇam iti duḥkhakāraṇe duḥkhakāraṇakāraṇe vā duḥkhopacāraḥ.
tadete duḥkham eveti bhāvanaṃ parātmasākṣikam avagantavyam.
nanu ca tatsarvaṃ na duḥkham eva; viṣayaratisukhasadbhāvāt? na tatsukham; vedanāpratīkāratvāt kacchūkaṇḍūyanavat.
sarvasattveṣu maitrī, guṇādikeṣu pramodaḥ, kliśyamāneṣu kāruṇyam, avineyeṣu mādhyasthyam iti.
evaṃ bhāvayataḥ pūrṇāny ahiṃsādīni vratāni bhavanti.
atra jīvā anādisaṃsāre ’nantakālaṃ nānāyoniṣu duḥkhaṃ bhojaṃ bhojaṃ paryaṭanti.
evam ādi jagatsvabhāvacintanāt saṃsārāt saṃvego bhavati.
kāyasvabhāvaś ca anityatā duḥkhahetutva niḥsāratā aśucitvam iti. evam ādi kāyasvabhāvacintanād viṣayarāganivṛtter vairāgyam upajāyate.
atrāha; uktaṃ bhavatā hiṃsādinivṛttivratam iti, tatra na jānīmaḥ ke hiṃsādayaḥ kriyāviśeṣā ity atrocyate.
yugapad vaktum aśakyatvāt tallakṣaṇanirdeśasya kramaprasaṃge yāsāv ādau coditā saiva tāvad ucyate —
pramattasya yogaḥ pramattayogaḥ, tasmāt pramattayogāt indriyādayo daśaprāṇās teṣāṃ yathāsaṃbhavaṃ vyaparopaṇaṃ viyogakaraṇaṃ hiṃsety abhidhīyate.
‘pramattayogāt’ iti viśeṣaṇaṃ kevalaṃ prāṇavyaparopaṇaṃ nādharmāyeti jñāpanārtham.
uktaṃ ca — viyojayati cāśubhir na ca vadhena saṃyujyate
uktaṃ ca — uccālidamhi pāde iriyāsamidassa ṇiggamaṭṭhāṇe
ṇa hi tassa taṇṇimitto baṃdho suhumo vi desido samae
nanu ca prāṇavyaparopaṇābhāve ’pi pramattayogamātrād eva hiṃseṣyate.
uktaṃ ca — maradu va jiyadu va jīvo ayadācārassa ṇicchidā hiṃsā
tathā coktam — svayam evātmanātmānaṃ hinasty ātmā pramādavān
pūrvaṃ prāṇyantarāṇāṃ tu paścāt syād vā na vā vadhaḥ
ṇa hi tassa taṇṇimitto baṃdho suhumo vi desido samae
maradu va jiyadu va jīvo ayadācārassa ṇicchidā hiṃsā
pūrvaṃ prāṇyantarāṇāṃ tu paścāt syād vā na vā vadhaḥ
tadanantaroddiṣṭam anṛtaṃ kiṃ lakṣaṇam ity atrocyate —
kiṃ punar apraśastam? prāṇipīḍākaraṃ yat tad apraśastaṃ vidyamānārthaviṣayaṃ vā avidyamānārthaviṣayaṃ vā.
athānṛtānantaram uddiṣṭaṃ yat steyaṃ tasya kiṃ lakṣaṇam ity ata āha —
ādānaṃ grahaṇam adattasyādānam adattādānaṃ steyam ity ucyate.
yady evaṃ karmanokarmagrahaṇam api steyaṃ prāpnoti; anyenādattatvāt? naiṣa doṣaḥ, dānādāne yatra saṃbhavatas tatraiva steyavyavahāraḥ.
evam api bhikṣor grāmanagarādiṣu bhramaṇakāle rathyādvārādipraveśād adattādānaṃ prāpnoti? naiṣa doṣaḥ; sāmānyena muktatvāt.
tathā hi — ayaṃ bhikṣuḥ pihitadvārādiṣu na praviśati amuktatvāt.
pramattayogād adattādānaṃ yat tat steyam ity ucyate.
tenaitad uktaṃ bhavati, yatra saṃkleśapariṇāmena pravṛttis tatra steyaṃ bhavati bāhyvastuno grahaṇe cāgrahaṇe ca.
atha caturtham abrahma kiṃ lakṣaṇam ity atrocyate —
strīpuṃsayoś cāritramohodaye sati rāgapariṇāmāviṣṭayoḥ parasparasparśanaṃ prati icchā mithunam.
kutaḥ? loke śāstre ca tathā prasiddeḥ.
loke tāvad āgopālādiprasiddhaṃ strīpuṃsayoḥ rāgapariṇāmanimittaṃ ceṣṭitaṃ maithunam iti.
śāstre ’pi aśvavṛṣabhayor maithuneccchāyām ity evam ādiṣu tad eva gṛhyate.
api ca ‘pramattayogāt’ ity anuvartate tena strīpuṃsamithunaviṣayaṃ ratisukhārtaṃ ceṣṭitaṃ maithunam iti gṛhyate, na sarvam.
ahiṃsādayo guṇā yasmin paripālyamāne bṛṃhanti vṛddhim upayānti tad brahma.
yasmān maithunasevanapravaṇaḥ sthāsnūṃś cariṣṇūn prāṇino hinasti mṛṣāvādam ācaṣṭe adattam ādatte acetanam itaraṃ ca parigṛahaṃ gṛhṇāti.
atha pañcamasya parigrahasya kiṃ lakṣaṇam ity ata āha —
kā mūrcchā? bahyānāṃ gomahiṣamaṇimuktāphalādīnāṃ cetanācetanānām ābyantarāṇāṃ ca rāgādīnām upadhīnām saṃrakṣaṇārjanasaṃskārādilakṣaṇāvyāvṛttir mūrcchā.
nanu ca loke vātādiprakopaviśeṣasya mūrccheti prasiddhir asti tadgrahaṇaṃ kasmān na bhavati? satyam evam etat mūrcchir ayaṃ mohasāmānye vartate.
sāmānyacodanāś ca viśeṣeṣv avatiṣṭhante ity ukte viśeṣe vyavasthitaḥ parigṛhyate; parigrahaprakaraṇāt.
evam api bāhyasya parigrahatvaṃ na prāpnoti; ādhyātmikasya saṃgrahāt? satyam evam etat; pradhānatvād abhyantara eva saṃgṛhītaḥ.

asaty api bāhye mamedam iti saṃkalpabān saparigraha eva bhavati. atha bāhyaḥ parigraho na bhavaty eva, bhavati ca mūrcchākāraṇatvāt yadi mamedam iti saṃkalpaḥ parigrahaḥ; saṃjñānādy api parigrahaḥ prāpnoti, tad api hi mamedam iti saṃkalpyate rāgādipariṇāmavat? naiṣa doṣaḥ; ‘pramattayogāt’ ity anuvartate.
tato jñānadarśanacāritravato ’pramattasya mohābhāvān na mūrcchāstīti niṣparigarahatvaṃ siddham.
kiṃ ca teṣāṃ jñanādīnām aheyatvād ātmasvabhāvatvād aparigrahatvam.
rāgādayaḥ punaḥ karmodayatantrā iti anātmasvabhāvatvād dheyāḥ.
tatas teṣụ saṃkalpaḥ parigraha iti yujyate.
mamedam iti hi sati saṃkalpe saṃrakṣanādayaḥ saṃjāyante.
evam uktena prakāreṇa hiṃsādidoṣadarśino ’hiṃsādiguṇāhitacetasaḥ paramaprayatnasyā hiṃsādīni vratāni yasya santi saḥ —
śarīrānupraveśi kāṇḍādipraharaṇaṃ śalyam iva śalyaṃ, yathā tat prāṇino bādhākaraṃ tathā śārīramānasabādhāhetutvāt karmodayavikāraḥ śalyam ity upacaryate.
tat trividham — māyāśalyaṃ nidānaśalyaṃ mithyādarśanaśalyam iti.
etasmāt trividhāc chalyān niṣkrānto niśśalyo vratī ity ucyate.
atra codyate — śalyābhāvān niḥśalyo vratābhisaṃbandhād vratī, na niśśalyatvād vratī bhavitum arhati.
na hi devadatto daṇḍasaṃbandhāc chatrī bhavatīti.
na hiṃsādyuparatimātravratābhisaṃbandhād vratī bhavaty antareṇa śalyābhāvam.
sati śalyāpagame vratasaṃbandhād vratī vivakṣito yathā bahukṣīraghṛto gomān iti vyapadiśyate.
bahukṣīraghṛtābhāvāt satīṣv api goṣu na gomāṃs tathā saśalyatvāt satsv api vrateṣu na vratī.
pratiśrayārthibhiḥ aṃgyate iti agāraṃ veśma, tad vānagārī.

nanu cātra viparyayo ’pi prāpnoti śūnyāgāradevakulādyāvāsasya muner agāritvam anivṛttaviṣayatṛṣṇasya kutaścit kāraṇād gṛhaṃ vimucya vane vasato ’nagāratvaṃ ca prāpnotīti? naiṣa doṣaḥ; bhāvāgārasya vivakṣitatvāt.
cāritramohodaye saty agārasaṃbandhaṃ pratyanivṛttaḥ pariṇāmo bhāvāgāram ity ucyate.
sa yasyāsty asāv agārī vane vasann api.
gṛhe vasann api tadabhāvād anagāra iti ca bhavati.
nanu cāgāriṇo vratitvaṃ na prāpnoti; asakalavratatvāt? naiṣa doṣaḥ; naigamādinayāpekṣayā agāriṇo ’pi vratitvam upapadyate nagarāvāsavat.
yathā gṛhe apavarake vā vasann api nagarāvāsa ity ucyeta tathā asakalavrato ’pi naigamasaṃgrahavyavahāranayāpekṣayā vratīti vyapadiśyate.
atrāha kiṃ hiṃsādīnām anyatam asmād yaḥ pratinivṛttaḥ sa khalv agārī vratī? naivam.
kiṃ tarhi? paṃcatayyā api virater vaikalyena vivakṣita ity ucyate —
kutas tarhy asau nivṛttaḥ? trasaprāṇivyaparopaṇān nivrattaḥ agārīty ādyam aṇuvratam.
snehamohādivaśād gṛhavināśe grāmavināśe vā kāraṇam ity abhimatād asatyavacanān nivṛtto gṛhīti dvitīyam aṇuvratam.
anyapīḍākaraṃ pārthivabhayādivaśād avaśyaṃ parityaktam api yadadattaṃ tataḥ pratinivṛttādaraḥ śrāvaka iti tṛtīyam aṇuvratam.
upāttāyā anupāttāyāś ca paraṃganāyāḥ saṃgān nivṛttaratir gṛhīti caturtham aṇuvratam.
dhanadhānyakṣetrādīnām icchāvaśāt kṛtaparicchedo gṛhīti paṃcamam aṇuvratam.
§ 702 āha aparityaktāgārasya kim etāvān eva viśeṣa āhosvid asti kaścid anyo ’pīty ata āha —
digviratiḥ deśaviratiḥ anarthadaṇḍaviratir iti etāni trīṇi guṇavratāni; ‘vrata’ śabdasya pratyekam abhisaṃbandhāt.
tathā sāmāyikavrataṃ proṣadhopavāsavrataṃ upabhogaparibhogaparimāṇavrataṃ atithisaṃvibhāgavrataṃ etāni catvāri śikṣāvratāni.
etair vrataiḥ saṃpanno gṛhī viratāvirata ity ucyate.
tad yathā — dikprācyādiḥ tatra prasiddhair abhijñānair avadhiṃ kṛtvā niyamanaṃ digvirativratam.
tatra lābhe saty api pariṇāmasya nivṛtter lobhanirāsaś ca kṛto bhavati.
anarthadaṇḍaḥ paṃcavidhaḥ — apadhyānaṃ pāpopadeśaḥ pramādācaritaṃ hiṃsāpradānaṃ aśubhaśrutir iti.
tatra pareṣāṃ jayaparājayavadhabandhanāṅgacchedaparasvaharaṇādi kathaṃ syād iti manasā cintanam apadhyānam.
tadyathā saṃgataṃ ghṛtaṃ saṃgataṃ tailām ity ucyate ekībhūtam iti gamyate.
ekatvena ayanaṃ gamanaṃ samayaḥ, samaya eva sāmāyikaṃ, samayaḥ prayojanam asyeti vā vigṛhya sāmāyikam.
iyati deśe etāvati kāle ity avadhārite sāmāyike sthitasya mahāvratatvaṃ pūrvavad veditavyam.
mahāvratatvābhāva iti cet? tan na; upacārād rājakule sarvagatacaitrābhidhānavat.
śabdādigrahaṇaṃ prati nivṛttautsukyāni paṃcānīṇdriyāṇy upetya tasmin vasantīty upavāsaḥ.

svaśarīrasaṃskārakāraṇasnānagandhamālyābharaṇādivirahitaḥ śucāv avakāśe sādhunivāse caityālaye svaproṣadhopavāsagṛhe vā dharmakathāśravaṇaśrāvaṇacintanavihitāntaḥkaraṇaḥ sann upavasen nirārambhaḥ śrāvakaḥ.
madhu māṃsaṃ madyaṃ ca sadā parihartavyaṃ trasaghātān nivṛttacetasā.
ketakyarjunapuṣpādīni śṛṅgaveramūlakādīni bahujantuyonisthānāny anantakāyavyapadeśārhāṇi parihartavyāni bahughātālpaphalatvāt.
yānavāhanābharaṇādiṣv etāvad eveṣṭam ato ’nyad aniṣṭam ity aniṣṭān nivartanaṃ kartavyaṃ kālaniyamena yāvaj jīvaṃ vā yathā śakti.
athavā nāsya tithir astīty atithiḥ aniyatakālāgamana ity arthaḥ.
mokṣārtham abhyudyatāyātithaye saṃyamaparāyaṇāya śuddhāya śuddhacetasā niravadyā bhikṣā deyā.
svapariṇāmopāttasyāyuṣa indriyāṇāṃ balānāṃ ca kāraṇavaśāt saṃkṣayo maraṇam.
kāyasya bāhyasyābhyantarāṇāṃ ca kaṣāyāṇāṃ tatkāraṇahāpanakrameṇa samyaglekhanā sallekhanā.
tām māraṇāntikīṃ sallekhanāṃ joṣihtā sevitā gṛhīty abhisaṃbadhyate.
nanu ca vispaṣṭārthaṃ sevitety evaṃ vaktavyam? na; arthaviśeṣopapatteḥ.
yasmād asatyāṃ prītau balān na salllekhanā kāryate.
satyāṃ hi prītau svayam eva karoti.
syān matam ātmavadhaḥ prāpnoti; svābhisandhipūrvakāyurādinivṛtteḥ? naiṣa doṣaḥ; apramattatvāt.
rāgadveṣamohāviṣṭasya hi viṣaśāstrādyupakaraṇaprayogavaśād ātmānaṃ ghnataḥ svaghāto bhavati.
na sallekhanāṃ pratipannasya rāgādayaḥ santi tato nātmavadhadoṣaḥ.
uktaṃ ca — rāgādīṇam aṇuppā ahiṃsagattaṃ ti desidaṃ samaye
tesiṃ ce uppattī hiṃseti jiṇehi ṇiddiṭṭhā
kiṃ ca maraṇasayāniṣṭatvād yathā vaṇijo vividhapaṇyadānādānasaṃcayaparasya svagṛhavināśo ’niṣṭaḥ.
tadvināśakāraṇe ca kutaścid upasthite yathāśakti pariharati.
duṣparihāre ca paṇyavināśo yathā na bhavati tathā yatate.
evaṃ gṛhastho ’pi vrataśīlapaṇyasaṃcaye pravartamānaḥ tadāśrayasya na pātam abhivāṃchati.
duṣparihāre ca yathā svaguṇavināso na bhavati tathā prayatata iti katham ātmavadho bhavet.
atrāha, ‘niḥśalyo vratī’ ity uktaṃ tatra ca tṛtīyaṃ śalyaṃ mithyādarśanam.
tataḥ samyagdṛṣṭinā vratinā niḥśalyena bhavitavyam ity uktam.
ucyate — kasyacin mohanīyāvasthāviśeṣāt kadācid ime bhavaty apavādāḥ —
atha praśaṃsāsaṃstavayoḥ ko viśeṣaḥ? manasā mityādṛṣṭer jñānacāritraguṇodbhāvanaṃ praśaṃsā, bhūtābhūtaguṇodbhāvavacanaṃ saṃstava ity ayam anayor bhedaḥ.
nanu ca samyagdarśanam aṣṭāṅgam uktaṃ tasyāticārair apy aṣṭabhir bhavitavyam.
naiṣa doṣaḥ; vrataśīleṣu paṃca paṃcāticārā ity uttaratra vivakṣuṇācāryeṇa praśaṃsāsaṃstavayor itarān aticārānantarbhāvya paṃcaivāticārā uktāḥ.
kim evaṃ vrataśīleṣv api bhavantīti? om ity uktvā tadaticārasaṃkhyānirdeśārtham āha
vratani ca śīlāni ca vrataśīlāni teṣu vrataśīleṣu.
śīlagrahaṇam anarthakam; vratagrahaṇenaiva siddheḥ? nānarthakam; viśeṣajñāpanārthaṃ vratparirakṣaṇārthaṃ śīlām iti digviratyādīnīha ‘śīla’ grahaṇena gṛhyante.
agāryadhikārād agāriṇo vrataśīleṣu paṃca paṃcāticārā vakṣyamāṇā yathākramaṃ veditavyāḥ.
danḍakaśāvetrādibhir abhighātaḥ prāṇiṇāṃ vadhaḥ, na prāṇavyaparopaṇam; tataḥ prāgevāsya vinivṛttatvāt.
abhyudayaniḥśreyasārtheṣu kriyāviśeṣeṣu anyasyānyathā pravartanam atisaṃdhāpanaṃ vā mityopadeśaḥ.
yat strīpuṃsābhyām ekānte ’nuṣṭhitasya kriyāviśeṣasya prakāśanaṃ tad rahobhyākhyānaṃ veditavyam.
anyenānuktam ananuṣṭhitaṃ yat kiṃcit paraprayogavaśād evaṃ tenoktam anuṣṭhitam iti vaṃcanānimittaṃ lekhanaṃ kūṭalekhakriyā.
hiraṇyāder dravyasya nikṣeptur vismṛtasaṃkhyālpasaṃkhyeyam ādadānasyaivam ity anujñāvacanaṃ nyāsāpahāraḥ.
arthaprakaraṇāṅgavikārabhrūvikṣepādibhiḥ parākūtam upalabhya tadāviṣkaraṇam asūyādinimittaṃ yattatsākāramantrabheda iti kathyate.
muṣṇantaṃ svayam eva vā prayuṅkte ’nyena vā prayojayati prayuktam anumanyate vā yataḥ sa stenaprayogaḥ.
tatra hy alpamūlyalabhyāni mahārghyāṇi dravyāṇīti prayatnaḥ.
etena nyūnenānyasmai deyam adhikenātmano grāhyam ity evam ādi kūṭaprayogo hīnādhikamānonmānam.
yā gaṇikātvena puṃścalītvena vā parapuruṣagamanaśīlā asvāmikā sā aparigṛhītā.
itvarike ca te parigṛhītāparigṛhīte ca itvarikāparigṛhītāparigṛhīte, tayor gamane itvarikāparigṛhītāparigṛhītāgamane.
aṃga prajananaṃ yoniś ca, tato ’nyatra krīḍā anaṅgakrīḍā.
kṣetraṃ ca vāstu ca kṣetravāstu, hiraṇyaṃ ca suvarṇaṃ ca hiraṇyasuvarṇam, dhanaṃ ca dhānyaṃ ca dhanadhānyam, dāsī ca dāsaś ca dāsīdāsam.
kṣetravāstu ca hiraṇyasuvarṇaṃ ca dhanadhānyaṃ ca dāsīdāsaṃ ca kupyaṃ ca kṣetravāstuhiraṇyasuvarṇadhanadhānyadāsīdāsakupyāni.
etāvān eva parigraho mama nānya iti paricchinnāṇupramāṇāt kṣetravāstvādiviṣayād atirekā atilobhavaśāt pramāṇātikramā iti pratyākhyāyante.
uktā vratānām aticārāḥ śīlānām aticārā vakṣyante.
sa samāsatas trividhhaḥ — ūrdhvātikramaḥ adho ’tikramas tiryagatikramaś ceti.
sa eṣo ’tikramaḥ pramādān mohād vyāsaṃgād vā bhavatīty avaseyaḥ.
ātmanā saṃkalpite deśe sthitasya prayojanavaśād yatkiṃcid ānayety ājñāpanam ānayanam.
vyāpārakarān puraṣān pratyabhyutkāsikādikaraṇaṃ śabdānupātaḥ. svavigrahadarśanaṃ rūpānupātaḥ.
tasya duṣṭaṃ praṇidhānaṃ yogaduṣpraṇidhānam — kāyaduṣpraṇidhānaṃ vāgduṣpraṇidhānaṃ manoduṣpraṇidhānam iti.
jantavaḥ santi na santi veti pratyavekṣaṇaṃ cakṣurvyāpāraḥ.
mṛdunopakaraṇena yat kriyate prayojanaṃ tat pramārjitam.
tadubhayaṃ pratiṣedhaviśiṣṭam utsargādibhis tribhir abhisaṃbadhyate — apratyavekṣitāpramārjitotsarga ity evam ādi.
apratyavekṣitāpramārjitasyārhadācāryapūjopakaraṇasya gaṃdhamālyadhūpāder ātmaparidhānādyarthasya ca vastrāder ādānam apratyavekṣitāpramārjitādānam.
saha cittena vartate iti sacittaṃ cetanāvad dravyam.
kathaṃ punar asya sacittādiṣu pravṛttiḥ? pramādasaṃmohābhyām.
etair āhāro viśeṣyate — sacittāhāraḥ saṃbandhāhāraḥ saṃmiśrāhāro ’bhiṣavāhāro duṣpakvāhāra iti.
jīvitaṃ ca maraṇaṃ ca jīvitamaraṇam, jīvitamaraṇasyāśaṃse jīvitamaraṇāśaṃse.
bhogākā–ṅkṣayā niyataṃ dīyate cittaṃ tasmiṃs teneti vā nidānam.
atrāha, uktaṃ bhavatā tīrthakaratvakāraṇakarmāsravanirdeśe ‘śaktitas tyāgatapasī ’ iti, punaś coktaṃ śīlavidhāne ‘atithisaṃvibhāga’ iti.
tasya dānasya lakṣaṇam anirjñātaṃ taducyatām ity ata āha —
atrāha — uktaṃ dānaṃ tat kim aviśiṣṭaphalam āhosvid asti kaścit prativiśeṣa ity ata āha —
tasya pratyekam abhisambandhaḥ kriyate — vidhiviśeṣo dravyaviśeṣo dātṛviseṣaḥ pātraviśeṣa iti.
tasmin vyākhyeye sati pūrvaṃ bandhahetūpanyāsaḥ kriyate; tatpūrvakatvād bandhasyeti —
kva? mithyādarśanaṃ tāvad uktam, ‘tattvārthaśraddhānaṃ samyagdarśanam’ ity atra tatpratipakṣabhūtam, āsravavidhāne ca kriyāsu vyākhyātaṃ mithyādarśanakriyeti.
tatra paropadeśam antareṇa mithyātvakarmodayavaśād yad āvirbhavati tattvārthāśraddhānalakṣaṇaṃ tan naisargikam.
athavā pañcavidhaṃ mithyādarśanam — ekāntamithyādarśanaṃ viparītamithyādarśanaṃ saṃśayamithyādarśanaṃ vainayikamithyādarśanam ajñānikamithyādarśanaṃ ceti.
tatra idam eva ittham eveti dharmidharmayor abhiniveśa ekāntaḥ.
puruṣa evedaṃ sarvam iti vā nitya eva vā anitya eveti.
sagrantho nirgranthaḥ, kevali kavalāhārī, strī sidhyatīty evam ādiḥ viparyayaḥ.
samyagdarśanajñānacāritrāṇi kiṃ mokṣamāragaḥ syād vā na vety antarapakṣāparigrahaḥ saṃśayaḥ.
ṣodaśa kaṣāyā nava nokaṣāyās teṣām īṣadbhedo na bheda iti paṃcaviṃśatiḥ kaṣāyāḥ.
catvāro manoyogaś catvāro vāgyogāḥ pañca kāyayogā iti trayodaśavikalpo yogaḥ.
ta ete pañca bandhahetavaḥ samastā vyastāś ca bhavanti.
tad yathā — mithyādṛṣṭeḥ paṃcāpi samuditā bandhahetavo bhavanti.
idānīṃ bandho vaktavya ity ata āha —
sakaṣāyatvāj jīvaḥ karmaṇo yogyān pudgalān ādatte sa bandhaḥ
amūrtir ahasta ātmā kathaṃ karmādatta iti coditaḥ san ‘jīvaḥ’ ity āha.
jīvanāj jīvaḥ prāṇādhāraṇād āyuḥsaṃbandhān nāyurvirahād iti.
‘karmayogyān’ iti laghunirdeśāt siddhe ‘karmaṇo yogyān’ iti pṛthagvibhaktyuccāraṇaṃ vākyāntarajñāpanārtham.
kiṃ punas tadvākyāntaram? karmaṇo jīvaḥ sakaṣāyo bhavatīty ekaṃ vākyam.
etad uktaṃ bhavati — ‘karmaṇaḥ’ iti hetunirdeśaḥ karmaṇo hetor jīvaḥ sakaṣāyo bhavati, nākarmasya kaṣāyalepo ’sti.
tato jīvakarmaṇor anādisaṃbandha iti uktaṃ bhavati.
tenāmūrto jīvo mūrtena karmaṇā kathaṃ badhyate iti codyam apākṛtaṃ bhavati.
itarathā hi bandhasyādimattve ātyantikīṃ śuddhiṃ dadhataḥ siddhasyeva bandhābhāvaḥ prasajyeta.
dvitīyaṃ vākyaṃ ‘karmaṇo yogyān pudgalān ādatte’ iti.
arthavaśād vibhaktipariṇāma iti pūrvahetusaṃbandham tyaktvā ṣaṣṭhīsaṃbandham upaiti ‘karmaṇo yogyān’ iti.
ato mithyādarśanādyāveśād ārdrīkṛtasyātmanaḥ sarvato yogaviśeṣāt teṣāṃ sūkṣmaikakṣetrāvagāhinām anantānantapradeśānāṃ pudgalānāṃ karmabhāvayogyānām avibhagenopaśleṣo bandha ity ākhyāyate.
yathā bhājanaviśeṣe prakṣiptānāṃ vividharasabījapuṣpaphalānāṃ madirābhāvena pariṇāmas tathā pudgalānām apy ātmani sthitānāṃ yogakaṣāyavaśāt karmabhāvena pariṇāmo veditavyaḥ.
āha kim ayaṃ bandha ekarūpa eva, āhosvit prakārā apy asya santīty ata idam ucyate —
tadevaṃ lakṣaṇaṃ kāryaṃ prakriyate prabhavaty asyā iti prakṛtiḥ.
ta ete prakṛtyādayaś catvāras tasya bandhasya prakārāḥ.
tat pratyekam abhisaṃbadhyate — jñānāvaraṇaṃ darśanāvaraṇam iti.
uccair nīcaiś ca gūyate śabdyata iti vā gotram.
idānīm uttaraprakṛtibandho vaktavya ity ata āha —
dvitīyagrahaṇam iha kartavyaḥ; dvitīya uttaraprakṛtibandha evaṃ vikalpa iti? na kartavyam; pāriśeṣyāt siddheḥ.

‘bheda’ śabdaḥ pañcādibhir yathā kramam abhisaṃbandhyate — pañcabhedaṃ jñānāvaraṇīyaṃ navabhedaṃ darśanāvaraṇīyaṃ dvibhedaṃ vedanīyaṃ aṣṭāviṃśatibhedaṃ mohanīyaṃ caturbhedam āyuḥ dvicatvāriṃśadbhedaṃ nāma dvibhedaṃ gotraṃ paṃcabhedo ’ntarāya iti.
yadi jñānāvaraṇīyaṃ paṃcabhedaṃ tatpratipattir ucyatām ity ata āha —
teṣām āvṛter āvaraṇabhedo bhavatīti paṃcottaraprakṛtayo veditavyāḥ.
atra codyate — abhavyasya manaḥparyayajñānaśaktiḥ kevalajñānaśaktiś ca syād vā na vā.
atha nāsti tatrāvaraṇadvayakalpanā vyartheti? ucyate — ādeśavacanān na doṣaḥ.
yady evaṃ bhavyābhavyavikalpo nopapadyate; ubhayatra tacchaktisadbhāvāt? na śaktibhāvābhāvāpekṣayā bhavyābhavyavikalpa ity ucyate.
samyagdarśanādibhir vyaktir yasya bhaviṣyati sa bhavyaḥ.
yasya tu na bhaviṣyati so ’bhavya iti.
idānīṃ darśanāvaraṇasya vaktavya ity ata āha —
cakṣuracakṣuravadhikevalānām iti darśanāvaraṇāpekṣayā bhedanirdeśaḥ — cakṣurdarśanāvaraṇam acakṣurdarśanāvaraṇam avadhidarśanāvaraṇaṃ kevaladarśanāvaraṇam iti.
yā kriyātmānaṃ pracalayati sā pracalā śokaśramamadādiprabhavā āsīnasyāpi netragātravikriyāsūcikā.
styāyater anekārthatvāt svapnārtha iha gṛhyate, gṛddher api dīptiḥ.
styāne svapne gṛddhyati dīpyate yad udayād ātmā raudraṃ bahukarma karoti sā styānagṛddhiḥ.
iha nidrādibhir darśanāvaraṇaṃ sāmānādhikaraṇyenābhisaṃbadhyate — nidrādarśanāvaraṇam nidrānidrādarśanāvaraṇam ity ādi.
yad udayād devādigatiṣu śarīramānasasukhaprāptis tat sadvedyam.
yat phalaṃ duḥkham anekavidhaṃ tad asadvedyam.
tatra yathāsaṃkhyena saṃbandho bhavati — darśanamohanīyaṃ tribhedham, cāritramohanīyaṃ dvibhedam, akaṣāyavedanīyaṃ navavidham, kaṣāyavedanīyaṃ ṣoḍaśavidham iti.
tatra darśanamohanīyaṃ tribhedham — samyaktvaṃ mithyātvaṃ tadubhayam iti.
tad bandhaṃ pratyekaṃ bhūtvā satkarmāpekṣayā tridhā vyavatiṣṭhate.
tatra yasyodayāt sarvajñapraṇītamārgaparāṅmukhas tattvārthaśraddhānanirutsuko hitāhitavicārāsamartho mithyādṛṣṭir bhavati tan mithyātvam.
tad eva samyaktvaṃ śubhapariṇāmaniruddhasvarasaṃ yad audāsīnyenāvasthitam ātmanaḥ śraddhānaṃ na niruṇaddhi, tad vedayamānaḥ puruṣaḥ samyagdṛṣṭir ity abhidhīyate.
tad eva mithyātvaṃ prakṣālanaviśeṣāt kṣīṇākṣīṇamadaśaktikodravavatsāmiśuddhasvarasaṃ tadubhayam ity ākhyāyate samyaṅmithyātvam iti yāvat.
īṣad arthe nañaḥ prayogād īṣat kaṣāyo ’kaṣāya iti.
yad udayād deśādiṣv autsukyaṃ sā ratiḥ.
yad udayād ātmadoṣasaṃvaraṇaṃ paradoṣāviṣkaraṇaṃ sā jugupsā.
yad udayāt straiṇān bhāvān pratipadyate sa strīvedaḥ.
yad udayān nāpuṃsakān bhāvān upavrajati sa napuṃsakavedaḥ.
teṣām catasro ’vasthāḥ — anantānubandhino ’pratyākhyānāvaraṇāḥ pratyākhyānāvaraṇāḥ saṃjvalanāś ceti.
yadudayād deśaviratiṃ saṃyamāsaṃyamākhyām alpām api kartuṃ na śaknoti te deśapratyākhyānam āvṛṇvanto ’pratyākhyānāvaraṇāḥ krodhamānamāyālobhāḥ.
yadudayād viratiṃ kṛtsnāṃ saṃyamākhyāṃ na śaknoti kartuṃ te kṛtsnaṃ pratyākhyānam āvṛṇvantaḥ pratyākhyānāvaraṇāḥ krodhamānamāyālobhāḥ.
saṃyamena sahāvasthānād ekībhūya jvalanti saṃyamo vā jvalaty eṣu satsv apīti saṃjvalanāḥ krodhamānamāyālobhāḥ.
ta ete samuditāḥ santaḥ ṣoḍaśa kaṣāyā bhavanti.
narakeṣu bhavaṃ nārakam āyuḥ, tiragyoniṣu bhavaṃ tairyagyonam, mānuṣeṣu bhavaṃ mānuṣam, deveṣu bhavaṃ daivam iti.
tadanantaram uddiṣṭaṃ yan nāmakarma tad uttaraprakṛtinirṇayārtham āha —
yad udayātmā bhavāntaraṃ gacchati sā gatiḥ.
sā carturvidhā — narakagatis tiryaggatir manuṣyagatir devagatiś ceti.
yan nimitta ātmano nārako bhāvas tan narakagatināma.
tatpañcavidham — ekendriyajātināma dvīndriyajātināma trīndriyajātināma caturindriyajātināma pañcendriyajātināma ceti.
yad udayād ātmā ekendriya iti śabdyate tad ekendriyajātināma.
yad udayād ātmanaḥ śarīranirvṛttis tac charīranāma.
tat pañcavidham — audārikaśarīranāma vaikriyikaśarīranāma āhārakaśarīranāma taijasaśarīranāma kārmaṇaśarīranāma ceti.
tat trividham — audārikaśarīrāṅgopāṅganāma vaikriyikaśarīrāṅgopāṅganāma āhārakaśarīrāṅgopāṅganāma ceti.
tajjātināmodayāpekṣaṃ cakṣurādīnāṃ sthānaṃ pramāṇaṃ ca nirvartayati.
śarīranamakarmodayavaśād upāttānāṃ pudgalānām anyonyapradeśasaṃśleṣaṇaṃ yato bhavati tad bandhananāma.
yadudayād audārikādiśarīrāṇāṃ vivaravirahitānyo ’nyapradeśānupraveśena ekatvāpādanaṃ bhavati satsaṃghātanāma.
yad udayād audārikādisarīrākṛtinirvṛttir bhavati tat saṃsthānanāma.
tat ṣoḍhā vibhajyate — samacaturasrasaṃsthānanāma nyagrodhaparimaṇḍalasaṃsthānanāma svātisaṃsthānanāma kubjasaṃsthānanāma vāmanasaṃsthānanāma huṇḍasaṃsthānanāma ceti.
tat ṣaḍvidham — vajrarṣabhanārācasaṃhanananāma vajranārācasaṃhanananāma nārācasaṃhanananāma ardhanārācasaṃhanananāma kīlikāsaṃhanananāma asaṃprāptāsṛpāṭikāsaṃhanananāma ceti.
tad aṣṭavidham — karkaśanāma mṛdunāma gurunāma laghunāma snigdhanāma rūkṣanāma śītanāma uṣṇanāma ceti.
tat pañcavidham — tiktanāma kaṭukanāma kaṣāyanāma āmlanāma madhuranāma ceti.
tat paṃcavidham — kṛṣṇavarṇanāma nīlavarṇanāma raktavarṇanāma hāridravaṛnanāma śuklavarṇanāma ceti.
tac caturvidham — narakagatiprāyogyānupūrvyanāma tiryaggatiprāyogyānupūrvyanāma manuṣyagatiprāyogyānupūrvyanāma devagatiprāyogyānupūrvyanāma ceti.
yasyodayād ayaḥpiṇḍavad gurutvān nādhaḥ patati na cārkatūlavallaghutvād ūrdhvaṃ gacchati tad gurulaghunāma.
yasyodayāt svayaṃkṛtodbandhanamaruprapatanādinimitta upaghāto bhavati tad upaghātanāma.
śarīranāmakarmodayān nirvartyamānaṃ śarīram ekātmopabhogakāraṇaṃ yato bhavati tat pratyekaśarīranāma.
bahūnām ātmanām upabhogahetutvena sādhāraṇaṃ śarīraṃ yato bhavati tat sādhāraṇaśarīranāma.
tat ṣaḍvidham — āhāraparyāptināma śarīraparyāptināma indriyaparyāptināma prāṇāpanaparyāptināma bhāṣāparyāptināma manaḥparyāptināma ceti.
yasyodayāl lokapūjiteṣu kuleṣu janma tac uccairgotram.
yadudayād garhiteṣu kuleṣu janma tan nīcairgotram.
antarāyāpekṣayā bhedanirdeśaḥ kriyate — dānasyāntarāyo lobhasyāntarāya ity ādi.
yadudayād dātukāmo ’pi na prayacchati, labdhukāmo ’pi na labhate, bhoktum icchann api na bhuṅkte, upabhoktum abhivāñchann api nopabhuṅkte, utsahitukāmo ’pi notsahate ta ete pañcāntarāyasya bhedāḥ.
sā sthitir dvividhā — utkṛṣṭā jaghanyā ca.
tatra yāsāṃ karmaprakṛtīṇām utkṛṣṭā sthitiḥ samānā tannirdeśārtham ucyate —
āditas tisṛṇām antarāyasya ca triṃśatsāgaropamakoṭīkoṭyaḥ parā sthitiḥ
madhye ’nte vā tisṛṇām grahaṇaṃ mābhūd iti ‘āditaḥ’ ity ucyate.
etad uktaṃ bhavati — jñānāvaraṇadarśanāvaraṇavedanīyāntarāyāṇām utkṛṣṭā sthitis triṃśatsāgaropamakoṭīkoṭya iti.
sā kasya bhavati? mithyādṛṣṭeḥ saṃjñinaḥ paṃcendriyasya paryaptikasya.
iyam api parā sthitir mithyādṛṣṭeḥ saṃjñinaḥ paṃcendriyasya paryāptakasyāvaseyā.
iyam api utkṛṣṭā sthitir mithyādṛṣṭeḥ saṃjñipaṃcendriyaparyāptakasya.
tatra samānajaghanyasthitīḥ paṃca prakṛtīr avasthāpya tisṛṇāṃ jaghanyasthitipratipattyarthaṃ sūtradvayam upanasyate laghvartham —
jñānadarśanāvaraṇāntarāyāṇāṃ jaghanyā sthitiḥ sūkṣmasāṃparāye, mohanīyasya anivṛttibādarasāṃparāye.
jñānāvaraṇādīnām athānubhavaḥ kiṃ lakṣaṇa ity ata āha —
śubhapariṇāmānāṃ prakarṣabhāvāc chubhaprakṛtīnāṃ prakṛṣṭo ’nubhavaḥ aśubhaprakṛtīnāṃ nikṛṣṭaḥ.
aśubhapariṇāmānāṃ prakarṣabhāvād aśubhaprakṛtīnāṃ prakṛṣṭo ’nubhavaḥ śubhaprakṛtīnāṃ nikṛṣṭaḥ.
sa evaṃ pratyayavaśād upātto ’nubhavo dvividhā pravartate svamukhena paramukhena ca.
na hi narakāyurmukhena tiryagāyurmanuṣyāyur vā vipacyate.
nāpi darśanamohaś cāritramohamukhena, cāritramoho vā darśanamohamukhena.
idaṃ tu na vijānīmaḥ kim ayam prasaṃkhyāto ’prasaṃkhyātaḥ? ity atrocyate prasaṃkhyāto ’nubhūyata iti brūmahe.
jñānāvaraṇasya phalaṃ jñānābhāvo darśanāvaraṇasyāpi phalaṃ darśanaśaktyuparodha ity evam ādy anvarthasaṃjñānirdeśāt sarvāsāṃ karmaprakṛtīnāṃ savikalpānām anubhavasaṃpratyayo jāyate.
āha, yadi vipāko ’nubhavaḥ pratijñāyate, tatkarmānubhūtaṃ sat, kim ābharaṇavadavatiṣṭhate āhosvin niṣpītasāraṃ pracyavate? ity atrocyate —
pīḍānugrahāv ātmane pradāyābhyavahṛṭaudanādivikāravatpūrvasthitikṣayād avasthānābhāvāt karmaṇo nivṛttir nirjarā.

tatra caturgatāv anekajātiviśeṣāvaghūrṇite saṃsāramahārṇave ciraṃ paribhramataḥ śubhāśubhasya karmaṇaḥ krameṇa paripākakālaprāptasyānubhavodayāvalisroto ’nupravaviṣṭasyārabdhaphalasya yā nivṛttiḥ sā vipākajā nirjarā.
yatkarmāprāptavipākakālam aupakramikakriyāviśeṣasāmarthyād anudīrṇaṃ balād udīryodayāvaliṃ praveśya vedyate āmrapanasādipākavat sā avipākajā nirjarā.
‘tapasā nirjarā ca’ iti vakṣyate tataś ca bhavati anyataś ceti sūtrārtho yojitaḥ.
kim artham iha nirjarānirdeśaḥ kriyate, saṃvarāt parā nirdeṣṭavyā uddeśavat? laghvartham iha vacanam.
tatra hi pāṭhe ‘vipāko ’nubhavaḥ’ iti punar anuvādaḥ kartavyaḥ syāt.
tasmiṃś ca vaktavye sati ime nirdeṣṭavyāḥ — kiṃ hetavaḥ kadā kutaḥ kiṃ svabhāvāḥ kasmin kiṃ parimāṇaś ceti? tadartham idaṃ krameṇa parigṛhītapraśnāpekṣabhedaṃ sūtraṃ praṇīyate —
nāmapratyayāḥ sarvato yogaviśeṣāt sūkṣmaikakṣetrāvagāhasthitāḥ sarvātmapradeśeṣv anantānantapradeśāḥ
nāmnaḥ pratyayā nāmapratyayāh ‘nāma’ iti sarvāḥ karmaprakṛtayo ’bhidhīyante; ‘sa yathānāma’ iti vacanāt.
sarveṣu bhaveṣu sarvataḥ ‘dṛśyante anyato ’pi’ iti tasi kṛte sarvataḥ.
ekaikasya hi jīvasyātikrāntā anantā bhavā āgāminaḥ saṃkhyeyā asaṃkhyeyā anantānantā vā bhavantīti.
yogaviśeṣān nimittāt karmabhāvena pudgalā ādīyanta iti nimittaviśeṣanirdeśaḥ kṛto bhavati.
‘sūkṣma’ ādigrahaṇaṃ karmagrahaṇayogyapudgalasvabhāvānuvartanārtham, grahaṇayogyāḥ pudgalāḥ sūkṣmā na sthūlā iti.
‘sthitāḥ’ iti vacanaṃ kriyāntaranivṛttyartham, sthitā na gacchanta iti.
‘sarvātmapradeśeṣu’ iti vacanam ādhāranirdeśārthaṃ naikapradeśādiṣu karmapradeśā vartante.
kva tarhi? ūrdhvam adhas tiryak ca sarveṣv ātmapradeśeṣu vyāpya sthitā iti.
‘anantānantapradeśa’ vacanaṃ parimāṇāntaravyapohārtham, na saṃkhyeyā na cāsaṃkhyeyā nāpy anantā iti.

te khalu pudgalaskandhā abhavyānantaguṇāḥ siddhānantabhāgapramitapradeśā ghanāṅgulasyāsaṃkhyeyabhāgakṣetrāvagāhina ekadvitricatuḥsaṃkhyeyasamayasthitikāḥ pañcavarṇapañcarasa-dvigandha-catuḥsparśasvabhāvā aṣṭavidhakarmaprakṛtiyogyā yogavaśād ātmanātmasāt kriyante.
āha, bandhapadārthāntaraṃ puṇyapāpopasaṃkhyānaṃ coditaṃ tadbandhe ’ntarbhūtam iti pratyākhyātam.
tatredaṃ vaktavyaṃ ko ’tra puṇyabandhaḥ kaḥ pāpabandha iti.
taduttaraiḥ pratyekam abhisaṃbadhyate śubham āyuḥ śubhaṃ nāma śubhaṃ gotram iti.
śubhāyus tritayaṃ tiryagāyur manuṣyāyur devāyur iti.

tad yathā — manuṣyagatir devagatiḥ paṃcendriyajāti paṃca śarīrāṇi trīṇy aṅgopāṅgāni samacaturasrasaṃsthānaṃ vajrarṣabhanārācasaṃhananaṃ praśastavarṇarasagandhasparśā manuṣyadevagatyānupūrvyadvayam agurulaghuparaghātocchvāsātapodyotapraśastavihāyogatayas trasabādaraparyāptipratyekaśarīrasthiraśubhasubhagasusvarādeyayaśaḥkīrtayo nirmāṇaṃ tīrthakaranāma ceti.
asmat puṇyasaṃjñikarmaprakṛtisamūhād anyat karma ‘pāpam’ ity ucyate.

tad yathā — jñānāvaraṇasya prakṛtayaḥ paṃca darśanāvaraṇasya nava mohanīyasya ṣaḍviṃśatiḥ paṃcāntarāyasya narakagatitiryaggatī catasro jātayaḥ paṃca saṃsthānāni paṃca saṃhananānyapraśastavarṇarasagandhasparśā narakagatitiryaggatyānupūrvyadvayam upaghātāpraśastavihāyogatisthāvarasūkṣmāparyāptisādhāraṇaśarīrāsthirāśubhadurbhagaduḥsvarānādeyāyaśaḥkīrtayaś ceti nāmakṛtayaś catustriṃśat.
idānīṃ tadantaroddeśabhājaḥ saṃvarasya nirdeśaḥ prāptakāla ity ata idam āha —
idaṃ vicāryate — kasmin guṇasthāne kasya saṃvara iti? atra ucyate — mithyādarśanakarmodayavaśīkṛta ātmā mithyādṛṣṭiḥ.
tatra mithyādarśanaprādhānyena yatkarma āsravati tannirodhāc cheṣe sāsādanasamyagdṛṣṭyādau tatsaṃvaro bhavati.

tad yathā — nidrānidrāpracalāpracalāstyānagṛddhyanantānubandhikrodhamānamāyālobhastrīvedatiryagāyustiryaggaticatuḥ-saṃsthānacatuḥsaṃhananatiryaggatiprāyogyānupūrvyodyotāpraśastavihāyogatidurbhagaduḥsvarānādeyanīcairgotrasaṃjñikānāṃ pañcaviṃśatiprakṛtīnām anantānubandhikaṣāyodayakṛtāsaṃyamapradhānāsravāṇām ekendriyādayaḥ sāsādanasamyagdṛṣṭyantā bandhakāḥ.
pratyākhyānāvaraṇakrodhamānamāyālobhānāṃ catasṛṇāṃ prakṛtīnāṃ pratyākhyānakaṣāyodayakāraṇāsaṃyamāsravāṇām ekendriyaprabhṛtayaḥ saṃyatāsaṃyatāvasānā bandhakāḥ.
pramādenopanītasya karmaṇaḥ pramattasaṃyatād ūrdhvaṃ tadabhāvān nirodhaḥ pratyetavyaḥ.
devāyurbandhārambhasya pramāda eva hetur apramādo ’pi tat pratyāsannaḥ.
kaṣāya evāsravo yasya karmaṇo na pramādādiḥ tasya tannirodhe nirāso ’vaseyaḥ.
sa ca kaṣāyaḥ pramādādivirahitas tīvramadhyamajaghanyabhāvena triṣu guṇasthāneṣu vyavasthitaḥ.
tatrāpūrvakaraṇasyādau saṃkhyeyabhāge dve karmaprakṛtī nidrāpracale badhyete.

tata ūrdhvaṃ saṃkhyeyabhāge triṃśat prakṛtayo devagatipañcendriyajātivaikriyikāhārakataijasakārmaṇaśarīrasamacaturasrasaṃsthānavaikriyikāhārakaśarīrāṃgopāṃgavarṇagandharasasparśadevagatiprāyogyānupūrvyāgurulaghūpaghātaparaghātocchvāsapraśastavihāyogatitrasabādaraparyāptapratyekaśarīrasthiraśubhasubhagasusvarādeyanirmāṇatīrthakarākhyā badhyante.
tasyaiva caramasamaye catasraḥ prakṛtayo hāsyaratibhayajugupsāsaṃjñā bandham upayānti.
tā etās tīvrakaṣāyāsravās tadabhāvān nirddiṣṭād bhāgād ūrdhvaṃ saṃvriyante.
anivṛttibādarasāṃparāyasyādisamayād ārabhya saṃkhyeyeṣu bhāgeṣu puṃvedakrodhasaṃjvalanau badhyete.
tata ūrdhvaṃ śeṣeṣu saṃkhyeyeṣu bhāgeṣu mānasaṃjvalanamāyāsaṃjvalanau bandham upagacchataḥ.
tā etāḥ prakṛtayo madhyamakaṣāyāsravās tadabhāve nirdiṣṭasya bhāgasyopariṣṭāt saṃvaram āpnuvanti.
pañcānāṃ jñānāvaraṇānāṃ caturṇāṃ darśanāvaraṇānāṃ yaśaḥkīrter uccairgotrasya pañcānām antarāyāṇāṃ ca mandakaṣāyāsravāṇāṃ sūkṣmasāṃparāyo bandhakaḥ.
yataḥ saṃsārakāraṇād ātmano gopanaṃ bhavati sā guptiḥ.
saṃvaro ’dhikṛto ’pi ‘sa’ iti tacchabdena parāmṛśyate guptyādibhiḥ sākṣāt saṃbandhanārthaḥ.
sa eṣa saṃvaro guptyādibhir eva nānyenopāyeneti.
tena tīrthābhiṣekadīkṣāśīrṣopahāradevatārādhananādayo nivartitā bhavanti; rāgadveṣamohopāttasya karmaṇo ’nyathā nivṛttyabhāvāt.
tapo dharme ’ntarbhūtam api pṛthagucyate ubhayasādhanatvakhyāpanārthaṃ saṃvaraṃ prati prādhānyapratipādanārthaṃ ca.
nanu ca tapo ’bhudayāṃgam iṣtaṃ devendrādisthānaprāptihetutvābhyupagamāt, tat kathaṃ nirjarāṃgaṃ syād iti? naiṣa doṣaḥ; ekasyānekakāryadarśanād agnivat.
yathāgnir eko ’pi vikledanabhasmāṃgārādiprayojana upalabhyate tathā tapo ’bhudayakarmakṣayahetur ity atra ko virodhaḥ.
saṃvarahetuṣv ādāv uddiṣṭāyā gupteḥ svarūpapratipattyartham āha —
tasmāt samyagviśeṣaṇaviśiṣṭāt saṃkleśāprādurbhāvaparātkāyādiyoganirodhe sati tannimittaṃ karma nāsravatīti saṃvaraprasiddhir avagantavyā.
sā tritayī kāyaguptir vāgguptir manoguptir iti.
samyagīryā samyagbhāṣā samyageṣaṇā samyagādānanikṣepau samyagutsarga iti.
sā etāḥ pañca samitayo viditajīvasthānādividher muneḥ prāṇipīḍāparihārābhyupāyā veditavyāḥ.
kim artham idam ucyate? ādyaṃ pravṛttinigrahārtham, tatrāsamarthānāṃ pravṛttyupāyadarśanārtham dvitīyam.
idaṃ punar daśāvidhadharmākhyānaṃ samitiṣu pravartamānasya pramādaparihārārthaṃ veditavyam.
śarīrasthitihetumārgaṇārthaṃ parakulāny upagacchato bhikṣor duṣṭajanākrośaprahasanāvajñātāḍanaśarīravyāpādanādīnāṃ saṃnidhāne kāluṣyānupattiḥ kṣamā.
satsu praśasteṣu janeṣu sādhu vacanaṃ satyam ity ucyate.

nanu caitad bhāṣāsamitāv antarbhavati? naiṣa doṣaḥ; samitau pravartamāno muniḥ sādhuṣv asādhuṣu ca bhāṣāvyavahāraṃ kurvan hitaṃ mitaṃ ca brūyāt anyathā rāgād anarthadaṇḍadoṣaḥ syād iti vāksamitir ity arthaḥ.
iha punaḥ saṃtaḥ pravrajitās tadbhaktā vā teṣu sādhu satyaṃ jñānacāritraśikṣaṇādiṣu bahvapi kartavyam ity anujñāyate dharmopabṛṃhaṇārtham.
upātteṣv api śarīrādiṣu saṃskārāpohāya mamedam ity abhisandhinivṛttir ākiṃcanyam.
nāsya kiṃcanāstīty akiṃcanaḥ tasya bhāvaḥ karma vā ākiṃcanyam.
tatra kasmāt kṣamādīn ayam avalambate nānyathā pravartata ity ucyate.
imāni śarīrendriyaviṣayopabhogadravyāṇi samudayarūpāṇi jalabudbudvadanavasthitasvabhāvāni garbhādiṣv avasthāviśeṣeṣu sadupalabhyamānasaṃyogaviparyayāṇi, mohād atrājño nityatāṃ manyate.
na kiṃcit saṃsāre samuditaṃ dhruvam asti ātmano jñānadarśanopayogasvabhāvād anyad iti cintanam anityatānuprekṣā.
evaṃ hy asya bhavyasya cintayatas teṣv abhiṣv aṅgābhāvād bhuktojjhitagandhamālyādiṣv iva viyogakāle ’pi vinipāto notpadyate.
yathā — mṛgaśāvasyaikānte balavatā kṣudhitenāmiṣaiṣiṇā vyāghreṇābhibhūtasya na kiṃcic charaṇam asti, tathā janmajarāmṛtyuvyādhiprabhṛtivyasanamadhye paribhramato jantoḥ śaraṇaṃ na vidyate.
paripuṣtam api śarīraṃ bhojanaṃ prati sahāyībhavati na vyasanopanipāte.
yatnena saṃcitā arthā api na bhavāntaram anugacchanti.
bāndhavāḥ samuditāś ca rujā parītaṃ na paripālayanti.
asti cet sucarito dharmo vyasanamahārṇave taraṇopāyayo bhavati.
suhṛdartho ’py anapāyī, nānyakiṃcic charaṇam iti bhāvanā aśaraṇānuprekṣā.
evaṃ hy asyādhyavasyato nityam aśaraṇo ’smīti bhṛśam udvignasya sāṃsārikeṣu bhāveṣu mamatvavigamo bhavati.
tasminn anekayonikulakoṭibahuśatasahasrasaṃkaṭe saṃsāre paribhraman jīvaḥ karmayantrapreritaḥ pitā bhūtvā bhrātā putraḥ pautraś ca bhavati.
mātā bhūtvā bhaginī bhāryā duhitā ca bhavati.
athavā kiṃ bahunā, svayam ātmanaḥ putro bhavatīty evam ādi saṃsārasvabhāvacintanaṃ saṃsārānuprekṣā.
evaṃ hy asya bhāvayataḥ saṃsāraduḥkhabhayād udvignasya tato nirvedo bhavati.
janmajarāmaraṇāvṛttimahāduḥkhānubhavanaṃ prati eka evāhaṃ na kaścin me svaḥ paro vā vidyate.
na me kaścit svajanaḥ parajano vā vyādhijarāmaraṇādīni duḥkhāny apaharati.
dharma eva me sahāyaḥ sadā anapāyīti cintanam ekatvānuprekṣā.
evaṃ hy asya bhāvayataḥ svajaneṣu prītyanubandho na bhavati.
tad yathā — bandhaṃ pratyekatve saty api lakṣaṇabhedād anyo ’ham aindriyakaṃ śarīram atīndriyo ’ham ajñaṃ śarīraṃ jño ’ham anityaṃ śarīraṃ nityo ’ham ādy antavaccharīram anādyananto ’ham.
bahuni me śarīraśatasahasrāṇy atītāni saṃsāre paribhramataḥ.
sa evāham anyas tebhya ity evaṃ me kim aṅga, punarbāhyebhyaḥ parigrahebhyaḥ ity evaṃ hy asya manaḥ samādadhānasya śarīrādiṣu sprhā notpadyate.
tatas tattvajñānabhāvanāpūrvake vairāgyaprakarṣe sati ātyantikasya mokṣasukhasyāvāptir bhavati.
śarīram idam atyantāśuciyoni śukraśonitāśucisaṃvardhitam avaskaravadaśucibhājanaṃ tvaṅmātrapracchāditam atipūtirasaniṣyandisrotobilam aṅgāravadātmabhāvam āśritam apy āśvevāpādayati.
snānānulepanadhūpapragharṣavāsamālyādibhir api na śakyam aśucitvam apahartum asya.
samyagdarśanādi punarbhāvyamānaṃ jīvasyātyantikīṃ śuddhim āvirbhāvayatīti tattvato bhāvanam aśucitavānuprekṣā.
evam hy asya saṃsmarataḥ śarīranirvedo bhavati.

tad yathā — āsravā ihāmutrāpāyayuktā mahānadīsrotovegatīkṣṇā indriyakaṣāyā vratādayaḥ. tatrendriyāṇi tāvat sparśanādīni vanagajavāyasapannagapataṅgahariṇādīn vyavasanārṇavam avagāhayanti tathā kaṣādayo ’pīha vadhabandhāpayaśaḥparikleśādīn janayanti.
amutra ca nānāgatiṣu bahuvidhaduḥkhaprajvalitāsu paribhramayantīty evam āsravadoṣānucintanam āsravānuprekṣā.
evaṃ hy asya cintayataḥ kṣamādiṣu śreyas tv abuddhir na pracyavate.
sarva ete āsravadoṣāḥ kūrmavatsaṃvṛtātmano na bhavanti.

yathā mahārṇave nāvo vivarapidhāne ’sati kramāt sratajalābhiplave sati tadāśrayāṇāṃ vināśo ’vaśyaṃbhāvī, chidrapidhāne ca nirupadravam abhilaṣitadeśāntaraprāpaṇaṃ, tathā karmāgamadvārasaṃvaraṇe sati nāsti śreyaḥpratibandha iti saṃvaraguṇānucintanaṃ saṃvarānuprekṣā.
evaṃ hy asya cintayataḥ saṃvare nityodyuktatā bhavati.
tatra narakādiṣu karmaphalavipākajā abuddhipūrvā sā akuśalānubandhā.
pariṣahajaye kṛte kuśalamūlā sā śubhānubandhā niranubandhā ceti.
evaṃ hy asyānusmarataḥ karmanirjarāyai pravṛttir bhavati.
lokasaṃsthānādividhir vyākhyātaḥ samantād anantasyālokākāśasya bahumadhyadeśabhāvino lokasya saṃsthānādividhir vyākhyātaḥ.
evaṃ sarvaloko nirantaraṃ nicitaḥ sthāvarair atas tatra trasatā vālukāsamudre patitā vajrasikatākaṇikeva durlabhā.
tatra ca vikalendriyāṇāṃ bhūyiṣṭhatvāt pañcendriyatā guṇeṣu kṛtajñateva kṛcchralabhyā.
tatra ca tiryaṃkṣu paśumṛgapakṣisarīsṛpādiṣu bahuṣu satsu manuṣyabhāvaś catuṣpathe ratnarāśir iva durāsadaḥ.
tatpracyave ca punas tadutpattir dagdhatarupudgalatadbhāvopapattivad durlabhā.
sarveṣv api teṣu labdheṣu saddharmapratilambho yadi na syād vyarthaṃ janma vadanam iva dṛṣṭivikalam.
tam evaṃ kṛcchalabhyaṃ dharmam avāpya viṣayasukhe rañjanaṃ bhasmārthacandanadahanam iva viphalam.
tasmin sati bodhilābhaḥ phalavān bhavatīti cintanaṃ bodhidurlabhānuprekṣā.
evaṃ hy asya bhāvayato bodhiṃ prāpya pramādo na kadācid api bhavati.
asyālābhād anādisaṃsāre jīvāḥ paribhramanti duṣkarmavipākajaṃ duḥkham anubhavantaḥ.
asya punaḥ pratilambhe vividhābhudayaprāptipūrvikā niḥśreyasopalabdir niyateti cintanaṃ dharmasvākhyātatvānuprekṣā.
evaṃ hy asya cintayato dharmānurāgāt sadā pratiyatno bhavati.
evam anityatvādyanuprekṣāsaṃnidhāne uttamakṣamādidhāraṇān mahān saṃvaro bhavati.
anuprekṣā hi bhāvayann uttamakṣmādīṃś ca pratipālayati parīṣahāṃś ca jetum utsahate.
ke punas te pariṣahāḥ kim arthaṃ vā te sahyanta itīdam āha —

kṣutpipāsādisahanaṃ kurvantaḥ jinopadiṣṭān mārgād apracyavamānās tanmārgaparikramaṇaparicayena karmāgamadvāraṃ saṃvṛṇvanta aupakramikaṃ karmaphalam anubhavantaḥ krameṇa nirjīrṇakarmāṇo mokṣam āpnuvanti.

tad yathā — bhikṣor niravadyāhāragaveṣiṇas tadalābhe īṣallābhe ca anivṛttavedanasyākāle adeśe ca bhikṣāṃ prati nivṛtteccchasyāvaśyakaparihāṇiṃ manāg apy asahamānasya svādhyāyadhyānabhāvanāparasya bahukṛtvaḥ svakṛtaparakṛtānaśanāvam audaryasya nīrasāhārasya saṃtaptabhrāṣṭrapatitajalabindukatipayavatsahasā pariśuṣkapānasyodīrṇakṣudvedanasyāpi sato bhikṣālābhād alābham adhikaguṇaṃ manyamānasya kṣudbādhāṃ pratyacintanaṃ kṣudvijayaḥ.

jalasnānāvagāhanapariṣekaparityāginaḥ patatrivadaniyatāsanāvasathasyātilavaṇasnigdharūkṣaviruddhāhāragraiṣmātapapittajvarānaśanādibhir udīrṇāṃ śarīrendriyonmāthinīṃ pipāsāṃ pratyanādriyamāṇapratīkārasya pipāsānalaśikhāṃ dhṛtinavamṛdghaṭapūritaśītalasugandhisamādhivāriṇā praśamayataḥ pipāsāsahanaṃ praśasyate.

parityaktapracchādanasya pakṣivadanavadhāritālayasya vṛkṣamūlapathiśilātalādiṣu himānīpatanaśītalānilasaṃpāte tatpratikāraprāptiṃ prati nivṛttecchasya pūrvānubhūtaśītapratikārahetuvastūnām asmarato jñānabhāvanāgarbhāgāre vasataḥ śītavedanāsahanaṃ parikīrtyate.

nivāte nirjale grīṣmaravikiraṇapariśuṣkapatitaparṇavyapetacchāyātaruṇyaṭavyantare yadṛcchayopanipatitasyānaśanādyabhyantarasādhanotpāditadāhasya davāgnidāhaparuṣavātātapajanitagalatāluśoṣasya tatpratīkārahetūn bahūn anubhūtān acintayataḥ prāṇipīḍāparihārāvahitacetasaś cāritrarakṣaṇam uṣṇasahanam ity upavarṇyate.
yathā kākebhyo rakṣyatāṃ sarpiḥ iti upaghātakopalakṣaṇaṃ kākagrahaṇaṃ, tena daṃśamaśakamakṣikāpiśukaputtikāmatkuṇakīṭapipīlikāvṛścikādayo gṛhyante.
tatkṛtāṃ bādhāmapratīkārāṃ sahamānasya teṣāṃ bādhāṃ tridhāpyakurvāṇasya nirvāṇaprāptimātrasaṃkalpaprāvaraṇasya tadvedanāsahanaṃ daṃśamaśakapariṣahakṣamety ucyate.

jātarūpavanniṣkalaṃkajātarūpadhāraṇamaśakyaprārthanīyaṃ yācanarakṣaṇahiṃsanādidoṣavinirmuktaṃ niṣparigrahatvān nirvāṇaprāptiṃ pratyekaṃ sādhanam ananyabādhanaṃ nāgnyaṃ bibhrato manovikriyāviplutivirahāt strīrūpāṇy atyantāśucikuṇaparūpeṇa bhāvayato rātrindivaṃ brahmacaryam akhaṇḍam ātiṣṭhamānasyācelavratadhāraṇam anavadyam avagantavyam.

saṃyatasyendriyeṣṭaviṣayasaṃbandhaṃ prati nirutsakasya gītanṛtyavāditrādivirahiteṣu śūnyāgāradevakulatarukoṭaraśilāguhādiṣu svādhāyadhyānabhāvanāratim āskandato dṛṣṭaśrutānubhūtaratismaraṇatatkathāśravaṇakāmaśarapraveśanirvivarahṛdayasya prāṇiṣu sadā sadayasyāratipariṣahajayo ’vaseyaḥ.

ekānteṣv ārāmabhavanādipradeśeṣu navayauvanamadavibhramamadirāpānapramattāsu pramadāsu bādhamānāsu kūrmavatsaṃvṛtendriyavikārasya lalitasmitamṛdukathitasavilāsavīkṣaṇaprahasanamadamantharagamanamanmathaśaravyāpāraviphalīkaraṇasya strībādhāpariṣahanam avagantavyam.

dīrghakālam uṣitagurukulabrahmacaryasyādhigatabandhamokṣapadārthatattvasya saṃyamāyatanabhaktihetor deśāntarātither guruṇābhyanujñātasya pavanavanniḥsaṃgatām aṅgīkurvato bahuśo ’naśanāvamaudaryavṛttiparisaṃkhyānarasaparityāgādibādhāpariklāntakāyasya deśakālapramāṇāpetam adhvagamanaṃ saṃyamavirodhi pariharato nirākṛtapādāvaraṇasya paruṣaśarkarākaṇṭakādivyadhanajātacaraṇakhedasyāpi sataḥ pūrvocitayānavāhanādigamanam asmarato yathākālam āvaśyakāparihāṇimāskandataś caryāpariṣahasahanam avaseyam.
