smaśānodyānaśūnyāyatanagiriguhāgahvarādiṣv anabhyastapūrveṣu nivasata ādityaprakāśasvendriyajñānaparīkṣitapradeśe kṛtaniyamakriyasya niṣadyāṃ niyamitakālām āsthitavataḥ siṃhavyāghrādivividhabhīṣaṇadhvaniśravanān nivṛttabhayasya caturvidhopasargasahanād apracyutamokṣamārgasya vīrāsanotkuṭikādyāsanād avicalitavigrahasya tatkṛtabādhān sahanaṃ niṣadyāpariṣahavijaya iti niścīyate.

svādhyāyadhyānādhvaśramaparikheditasya mauhūrtikīṃ kharaviṣam apracuraśarkarākapālasaṃkaṭātiśītoṣṇeṣu bhūmipradeśeṣu nidrām anubhavato yathākṛtaikaparśvadaṇḍāyitādiśāyinaḥ prāṇibādhāparihārāya patitadāruvad vyapagatāsuvadaparivartamānasya jñānabhāvanāvahitacetaso ’nuṣṭhitavyantarādivividhopasargād apy acalitavigrahasyāniyamitakālāṃ tatkṛtabādhāṃ kṣamamāṇasya śayyā pariṣahakṣamā kathyate.

mithyādarśanodṛiktāmarṣaparuṣāvajñānindāsabhyavacanāni krodhāgniśikhāpravardhanāni niśṛṇvato ’pi tadartheṣv asamāhitacetasaḥ sahasā tatpratīkāraṃ kartum api śaknuvataḥ pāpakarmavipākam abhicintayatas tāny ākarṇya tapaścaraṇabhāvanāparasya kaṣāyaviṣalavamātrasyāpy anavakāśam ātmahṛdayaṃ kurvata ākrośapariṣahasahanam avadhāryate.

niśitaviśasanamuśalamudgarādripraharaṇatāḍanādibhir vyāpādyamānaśarīrasya vyāpādakeṣu manāg api manovikāram akurvato mama purākṛtaduṣkarmaphalam idam ime varākāḥ kiṃ kurvanti, śarīram idaṃ jalabudbudvadviśaraṇasvabhāvaṃ vyasanakāraṇam etair bābādhyate, saṃjñānadarśanacāritrāṇi mama na kenacid upahanyante iti cintayato vāsitakṣaṇacandanānulepanasamadarśino vadhapariṣahakṣamā manyate.

bāhyābhyantaratapo ’nuṣṭhānaparasya tadbhāvanāvaśena nissārīkṛtamūrteḥ paṭutapanatāpaniṣpītasārataror iva virahitacchāyasya tvagasthiśirājālamātratanuyantrasya prāṇātyaye saty apy āhārabasatibheṣajādīni dīnābhidhānamukhavaivarṇyāṅgasaṃjñādibhir ayācamānasya bhikṣākāle ’pi vidyududyotavad durupalakṣyamūrter yācanāpariṣahasahanam avasīyate.

vāyuvadasaṅgād anekadeśacāriṇo ’bhupagataikakālasaṃbhojanasya vācaṃyamasya tatsamitasya vā sakṛtsvatanudarśanamātratantrasya pāṇipuṭamātrapātrasya bahuṣu divaseṣu bahuṣu ca gṛheṣu bhikṣām anavāpyāpy asaṃkliṣṭacetaso dātṛviśeṣaparīkṣānirutsukasya lābhād apy alābho me paramaṃ tapa iti saṃtuṣṭasyālābhavijayo ’vaseyaḥ.

sarvāśucinidhānam idam anityam aparitrāṇam iti śarīre niḥsaṃkalpatvād vigatasaṃskārasya guṇaratnabhāṇḍasaṃcayapravardhanasaṃrakṣaṇasaṃdhāraṇakāraṇatvād abhyupagatasthitividhānasyākṣamrakṣaṇavad vraṇānulepanavad vā bahūpakāram āhāram abhupagacchato viruddhāhārapānasevanavaiṣamyajanitavātādivikārarogasya yugapad anekaśatasaṃkhyavyādhiprakope saty api tadvaśavartitāṃ vijahato jallauṣadhiprāptyādyanekatapoviśeṣarddhiyoge saty api śarīranisspṛhatvāt tatpratikārānapekṣiṇo rogapariṣahasahanam avagantavyam.

tena śuṣkatṛṇaparuṣaśarkarākaṇṭakaniśitamṛttikāśūlādivyadhanakṛtapādavedanāprāptau satyāṃ tatrāpraṇihitatacetasaś caryāśayyāniṣadyāsu prāṇipīḍāparihāre nityam apramattacetasas tṛṇādisparśabādhāpariṣahavijayo veditavyaḥ.

apkāyikajantupīḍāparihārāyāmaraṇād asnānavratadhāriṇaḥ paṭur avikiraṇapratāpajanitaprasvedāktapavanānītapāṃsunicayasya sidhmakacchūdadrūdīrṇakaṇḍūyāyām utpannāyām api kaṇḍūyanavimardanasaṃghaṭṭanavivarjitamūrtheḥ svagatamalopacayaparagatamalāpacayayor asaṃkalpitamanasaḥ sajjñānacāritravimalasalilaprakṣālanena karmamalapaṃkanirākaraṇāya nityam udyatamater malapīḍāsahanam ākhyāyate.
puraskāro nāma kriyārambhādiṣv agrataḥ karaṇam āmaṃtraṇaṃ vā, tatrānādaro mayi kriyate.

ciroṣitabrahmacaryasya mahātapasvinaḥ svaparasamayanirṇajñasya bahukṛtvaḥ paravādivijayinaḥ praṇāmabhaktisaṃbrahmāsanapradānādīni me na kaścit karoti. mithyādṛṣṭaya evātīva bhaktim antaḥ kiṃcid ajānantam api sarvajñasaṃbhāvanayā saṃmānya svasamayaprabhāvanaṃ kurvanti.

vyantarādayaḥ purā atyugratapasāṃ pratyagrapūjāṃ nirvartayantīti mithyā śrutir yadi na syād idānīṃ kasmān mādṛśāṃ na kurvantīti duṣpraṇidhānavirahitacittasya satkārapuraskārapariṣahavijaya iti vijñāyate.
aṅgapūrvaprakīrṇakaviśāradasya śabdanyāyādhyātmanipuṇasya mama purastāditare bhāskaraprabhābhibhūtakhadyotodyotavannitarāṃ nāvabhāsanta iti vijñānamadanirāsaḥ prajñāpariṣahajayaḥ pratyetavyaḥ.

ajño ’yaṃ na vetti paśusama ity evam ādy adhikeṣpavacanaṃ sahamānasya paramaduścaratapo ’nuṣṭhāyino nityam apramattacetaso me ’dyāpi jñānātiśayo notpadyata iti anabhisaṃdadhato ’jñānapariṣahajayo ’vagantavyaḥ.
mahopavāsādyanuṣṭhāyināṃ prātihāryaviśeṣāḥ prādur abhūvann iti pralāpamātram anarthikeyaṃ pravrajyā.
viphalaṃ vrataparipālanam ity evam asamādadhānasya darśanaviśuddhiyogād adarśanapariṣahasahanam avasātavyam.
evaṃ pariṣahān asaṃkalpopasthitān sahamānasyāsaṃkliṣṭacetaso rāgādipariṇāmāsravanirodhān mahān saṃvaro bhavati.
āha, kim ime pariṣahāḥ sarve saṃsāramahāṭavīm atikramitum abhyudyatam abhidravanti uta kaścit prativiśeṣa ity atrocyate — amī vyākhyātalakṣaṇāḥ kṣudādayaś cāritrāntarāṇi prati bhājyāh.
‘caturdaśa’ iti vacanād anyeṣāṃ pariṣahāṇām abhāvo veditavyaḥ.
āha yuktaṃ tāvad vītarāgachadmasthe mohanīyābhāvāt tatkṛtavakṣyamāṇāṣṭapariṣahābhāvāc caturdaśaniyamavacanam.
sūkṣmasāṃparāye tu mohodayasadbhāvāt ‘caturdaśa’ iti niyamo nopapadyata iti? tad ayuktam; sanmātratvāt.
tatra hi kevalo lobhasaṃjvalanakaṣāyodayaḥ so ’py atisūkṣmaḥ.
tato vītarāgachadmasthakalpatvāt ‘caturdaśa’ iti niyamas tatrāpi yujyate.
nanu mohodayasahāyābhāvān mandodayayatvāc ca kṣudādivedanābhāvāt tatsahanakṛtapariṣahavyapadeśo na yuktim avatarati.
tan na? kiṃ kāraṇam. śaktimatrasya vivakṣitatvāt.
āha, yadi śarīravaty ātmani pariṣahasaṃnidhānaṃ pratijñāyate atha bhavati utpannakevalajñāne karmacatuṣṭayaphalānubhavanavaśavartini kiyanta upanipatantīty atrocyate.
nirastaghātikarmacatuṣṭaye jine vedanīyasadbhāvāt tadāsrayā ekādaśapariṣahāḥ saṃti.

nanu ca mohanīyodayasahāyābhāvāt kṣudādivedanābhāve pariṣahavyapadeśo na yuktaḥ? satyam evam etat — vedanābhāve ’pi dravyakarmasadbhāvāpekṣayā pariṣahopacāraḥ kriyate, niravaśeṣanirastajñānātiśaye cintānirodhābhāve ’pi tatphalakarma nirharaṇaphalāpekṣayā dhyānopacāravat.
athavā — ekādaśa jine ‘na saṃti’ iti vākyaśeṣaḥ kalpanīyaḥ, sopaskāratvāt sūtrāṇām.
kalpyo hi vākyaśeṣo vākyaṃ ca vaktary adhīnam ity upagamāt.
āha, yadi sūkṣmasāṃparāyādiṣu vyastāḥ pariṣahāḥ atha samastāḥ tāḥ kveti —
bādaraḥ sāṃparāyo yasya sa bādarasāṃparāya iti.
kasmin punaś cāritre sarveṣāṃ saṃbhavaḥ? sāmāyikacchedopasthāpanaparihāraviśuddhisaṃyameṣu pratyekaṃ sarveṣāṃ saṃbhavaḥ.
āha, gṛhītam etat pariṣahāṇāṃ sthānaviśeṣāvadhāraṇaṃ, idaṃ tu na vidmaḥ kasyāḥ prakṛteḥ kaḥ kārya ity atrocyate —

kim atrāyuktam? jñānāvaraṇe satyajñānapariṣaha upapadyate, prajñāpariṣahaḥ punas tadapāye bhavatīti kathaṃ jñānāvaraṇe syāt? ity atrocyate — kṣāyopaśamikī prajñā anyasmin jñānāvaraṇe sati madaṃ janayati na sakalāvaraṇakṣaye iti jñānāvaraṇe satīty upapadyate.
āha, yady ādye mohanīyabhede ekaḥ pariṣahaḥ atha dvitīyasmin kati bhavantīty atrocyate —
tebhyo ’nye śeṣāḥ vedanīye sati ‘bhavanti’ iti vākyaśeṣaḥ.
§ 851 āha, vyākhyātanimittalakṣaṇavikalpāḥ pratyātmani prādurbhavantaḥ kati yugapad avatiṣṭhanta ity atrocyate —
tena ekonaviṃśatir api kvacit yugapat saṃbavatīty avagamyate.
tat katham? iti ced ucyate — śītoṣṇapariṣahayor ekaḥ śayyāniṣadyācaryāṇāṃ cānyatama eva bhavati ekasminn ātmani.
tattrayāṇām apagame yugapad ekātmanītareṣāṃ saṃbhavād ekonaviṃśativikalpā boddhavyāḥ.
nanu prajñājñānayor api virodhād yugapad asaṃbhavaḥ? śrutajñānāpekṣayā prajñāpariṣahaḥ avadhijñānādyabhāvāpekṣayā ajñānapariṣaha iti nāsti virodhaḥ.
saṃvarahetuś cāritrasaṃjño vaktavya iti tadbhedapradarśanārtham ucyate —

atra codyate — daśavidhe dharme saṃyama uktaḥ sa eva cāritram iti punar grahaṇam anarthakam iti? nānarthahakam; dharme ’ntarbhūtam api cāritram ante gṛhyate mokṣaprāpteḥ sakṣātkāraṇam iti jñāpanārtham.
mohanīyasya niravaśeṣasyopaśamāt kṣayāc ca ātmasvabhāvāvasthāpekṣālakṣaṇaṃ athākhyātacāritram ity ākhyāyate.
pūrvacāritrānuṣṭhāyibhir ākhyātaṃ na tatprāptaṃ prāṅmohakṣayopaśamābhyām ity athākhyātam.
tadanantaram uddiṣṭaṃ yat ‘tapasā nirjarā ca’ iti tasyedānīṃ tapaso vidhānaṃ kartavyam ity atrocyate.
bhikṣārthino muner ekāgārādiviṣayaḥ saṃkalpaḥ cintāvarodho vṛttiparisaṃkhyānam āśānivṛttyartham avagantavyam.
śūnyāgārādiṣu vivikteṣu jantupīḍāvirahiteṣu saṃyatasya śayyāsanam ābādhātyayabrahmacaryasvādhyāyadhyānādiprasiddhyarthaṃ kartavyam iti paṃcamaṃ tapaḥ.
ātapasthānaṃ vṛkṣamūlanivāso nirāvaraṇaśayanaṃ bahuvidhapratimāsthānam ity evam ādiḥ kāyakleśaḥ tat ṣaṣṭaṃ tapaḥ.
pariṣahasyāsya ca ko viśeṣaḥ? yadṛcchayopanipatitaḥ pariṣahaḥ.
bāhyatvam asya kutaḥ? bāhyadravyāpekṣatvāt parapratyakṣatvāc ca bāhyatvam.
‘yathākramam’ iti vacanān navabhedaṃ prāyaścittam, vinayaś caturvidhaḥ, vaiyāvṛttyaṃ daśavidham, svādhyāyaḥ pañcavidhaḥ, dvibhedo vyutsarga ity abhisaṃbadyate.
‘prāgdhyānāt’ iti vacanaṃ dhyānasya bahuvaktavyatvāt paścād vakṣyata iti.
mokṣārthaṃ śāstram upetya tasmād adhīyata ity upādhyāyaḥ.
teṣāṃ vyādhipariṣahamithyātvādyupanipāte kāyaceṣṭayā dravyāntareṇa vā tatpratīkāro vaiyāvṛttyaṃ samādhyādhānavicikitsābhāvapravacanavātsalyādyabhivyaktyartham.
sa eṣa pañcavidhaḥ svādhyāyaḥ kim arthaḥ? prajñātiśayaḥ praśastādhyavasāyaḥ pramasaṃvegas tapovṛddhir aticāraviśuddhir ity evam ādy arthaḥ.
krodhādir ātmabhāvo ’bhyantaropadhiḥ kāyatyāgaś ca niyatakālo yāvaj jīvaṃ vābhyantaropadhityāga ity ucyate.
yad bahuvaktavyaṃ dhyānam iti pṛthagvyavasthāpitaṃ tasyedānīṃ bhedābhidhānaṃ prāptakālam.
ādyaṃ tritayaṃ saṃhananam uttamaṃ vajrarṣabhanārācasaṃhananaṃ vajranārācasaṃhananaṃ nārācasaṃhananam iti.
tat tritayam api dhvānasya sādhanaṃ bhavati. mokṣasya tu ādyam eva.
taduttamaṃ saṃhananaṃ yasya so ’yam uttamasaṃhananaḥ, tasyottamasaṃhananasyeti.
nānārthāvalambanena cintā parispandavatī, tasyā anyāśeṣamukhebyo vyāvartya ekasminn agre niyama ekāgracintānirodha ity ucyate.

cintāyā nirodho yadi dhyānaṃ, nirodhaś cābhāvaḥ, tena dhyānam asatkharaviṣāṇavatsyāt? naiṣa doṣaḥ; anyacintānivṛttyapekṣayāsad iti cocyate, svaviṣayākārapravṛtteḥ sad iti ca; abhāvasya bhāvāntaravād hetvaṅgatvādibhir abhāvasya vastudharmatvasiddheś ca.
athavā nāyaṃ bhāvasādhanaḥ, nirodhanaṃ nirodha iti.
cintā cāsau nirodhaś ca cintānirodha iti.
etad uktaṃ bhavati — jñānam evāparispandāgniśikhāvadavabhāsamānaṃ dhyānam iti.
ṛtaṃ duḥkhaṃ, ardanam ārtivā, tatra bhavam ārtam.
rudraḥ krūrāśayas tasya karma tatra bhavaṃ vā raudram.
§ 875 kiṃ punas tad iti ced ucyate —
‘pare mokṣahetū’ iti vacanāt pūrve ārtaraudre saṃsārahetū ity uktam bhavati.
amanojñam apriyaṃ viṣakaṇṭakaśatruśastrādi, tadbādhākaraṇatvād ‘amanojñam’ ity ucyate.
tasya saṃprayoge, sa kathaṃ nāma me na syād iti saṃkalpaś cintāprabandhaḥ smṛtisamanvāhāraḥ prathaman ārtam ity ākhyāyate.
tenaitad uktam bhavati — manojñasyeṣṭasya svaputradāradhanāder viprayoge tatsaṃprayogāya saṃkalpaś cintāprabandho dvitīyam ārtam avagantavyam.

‘vedanā’ śabdaḥ sukhe duḥkhe ca vartamāno ’pi ārtasya prakṛtatvād duḥkhavedanāyāṃ pravartate, tasyā vātādivikārajanitavedanāyā upanipāte tasyā apāyaḥ katham nāma me syād iti saṃkalpaś cintāprabandhas tṛtīyam ārtam ucyate.
bhogākāṅṣāturyasyānāgataviṣayaprāptiṃ prati manaḥpraṇidhānaṃ saṃkalpaś cintāprabandhas turīyam ārtaṃ nidānam ity ucyate.
tadetac caturvidham ārtam kiṃ svāmikam iti ced ucyate —
tatrāviratadeśaviratānāṃ caturvidham apy ārtaṃ bhavati; asaṃyamapariṇāmopetatvāt.
pramattasaṃyatānāṃ tu nidānavarjyam anyad ārtatrayaṃ pramādodayodrekāt kadācit syāt.
tāni raudradhyānotpatter nimittī bhavantīti hetunirdeśo vijñāyate.
aviratasya bhavatu raudradhyānaṃ, deśaviratasya katham? tasyāpi hiṃsādyāveśād vittādisaṃrakṣaṇatantratvāc ca kadācid bhavitum arhati.
saṃyatasya tu na bhavaty eva; tadārambhe saṃyamapracyuteḥ.
tatrādyasya mokṣahetor dhyānasya bhedasvarūpasvāminirdeśaḥ kartavya ity ata āha —
sa pratyekaṃ saṃbadhyate — ājñāvicayāya smṛtisamanvāhāraḥ ity ādi.

tad yathā — upadeṣṭur abhāvān mandabuddhitvāt karmodayāt sūkṣmatvāc ca padārthanāṃ hetudṛṣṭāntoparame sati sarvajñapraṇītam āgamaṃ pramāṇī kṛtya ittham evedaṃ nānyathāvādino jināḥ iti gahanapadārthaśraddhānād arthāvadhāraṇam ājñāvicayaḥ.

athavā — svayaṃ viditapadārthatattvasya sataḥ paraṃ prati pipādayiṣoḥ svasiddhāntāvirodhena tattvasamarthanārthaṃ tarkanayapramāṇayojanaparaḥ smṛtisamanvāhāraḥ sarvajñājñāprakāśanārthatvād ājñāvicaya ity ucyate.
jātyandhavanmityhyādṛṣṭayaḥ sarvajñapraṇītamārgād vimukhā mokṣārtinaḥ samyaṅmārgāparijñānāt sudūram evāpayantīti sanmārgāpāyacintanam apāyavicayaḥ.
athavā — mithyādarśanajñānacāritrebhyaḥ kathaṃ nama ime prāṇino ’peyur iti smṛtisamanvāhāro ’pāyavicayaḥ.
tasmād anapetaṃ dharmyaṃ dhyānaṃ caturvikalpam avaseyam.
vakṣyamāṇeṣu śukladhyānavikalpeṣu ādye śukladhyāne pūrvavido bhavataḥ śrutakevalina ity arthāḥ.
tatra vyākhyānato viśeṣapratipattiḥ iti śreṇyārohaṇāt prāgdharmyaṃ, śreṇyoḥ śukle iti vyākhyāyate.
prakṣīṇasakalajñānāvaraṇasya kevalinaḥ sayogasyāyogasya ca pare uttare śukladhyāne bhavataḥ.
pṛthaktvavitarkam ekatvavitarkaṃ sūkṣmakriyāpratipāti vyuparatakriyānivarti ceti caturvidhaṃ śukladhyānam.
uktaiś caturbhiḥ śukladhyānavikalpais triyogādīnāṃ caturṇāṃ yathāsaṃkhyenābhisaṃbandho veditavyaḥ.
triyogasya pṛthaktvavitarkam, triṣu yogeṣv ekayogasyaikatvavitarkam, kāyayogasya sūkṣmakriyāpratipāti, ayogasya vyutparatakriyānivartīti.
vitarkaś ca vīcāraś ca vitarkavīcārau, saha vitarkavīcārābhyāṃ varteta iti savitarkavīcāre.
pūrvayor yad dvitīyaṃ tad avīcāraṃ pratyetavyam.
etad uktaṃ bhavati — ādyaṃ savitarkaṃ savīcāraṃ ca bhavati.
atha vitarkavīcārayoḥ kaḥ prativiśeṣa ity atrocyate —
viśeṣeṇa tarkaṇam ūhanaṃ vitarkaḥ śrutajñānam ity arthaḥ.
dravyaṃ vihāya paryāyam upaiti paryāyaṃ tyaktvā dravyam ity arthasaṃkrāntiḥ.
ekaṃ śrutavacanam upādāya vacanāntaram ālambate tad api vihāyānyad iti vyañjanasaṃkrāntiḥ.
kāyayogaṃ tyaktvā yogāntaraṃ gṛhṇāti yogāntaraṃ ca tyaktvā kāyayogam iti yogasaṃkrāntiḥ.
tad etat sāmānyaviśeṣanirdiṣṭaṃ caturvidhaṃ dharmyaṃ śuklaṃ ca pūvoditaguptyādibahuprakāropāyaṃ saṃsāranivṛttaye munir dhyātum arhati kṛtaparikarmā.

tatra dravyaparamāṇuṃ bhāvaparamāṇuṃ vā dhyāyan nāhitavitarkasāmarthyaḥ arthavyaṃjane kāyavācasī ca pṛthaktvena saṃkrāmatā manasāparyaptibālotsāhavadavyavasthitenāniśitenāpi śastreṇa cirāt taruṃ chindann iva mohaprakṛtīr upaśamayan kṣapayaṃś ca pṛthaktvavitarkavīcāradhyānabhāgbhavati.

sa eva punaḥ samūlatūlaṃ mohanīyaṃ nirdidhakṣann anantaguṇaviśuddhiyogaviśeṣam āśritya bahutarāṇāṃ jñānāvaraṇasahāyībhūtānāṃ prakṛtīnāṃ bandhaṃ nirundhan sthiti hrāsakṣayau ca kurvan śrutajñānopayogo nivṛttārthavyaṃjanayogasaṃkrāntiḥ avicalitamanāḥ kṣīṇakaṣāyo vaiḍūryamaṇir iva nirupalepo dhyātvā punar na nivartata ity uktam ekatvavitarkam.

evam ekatvavitarkaśukladhyānavaiśvānaranirdagdhavātikarmendhanaḥ prajvalitakevalajñānagabhastimaṇḍalo meghapañjaranirodhanirgata iva gharmaraśmir vā bhāsamāno bhagavāṃs tīrthakara itaro vā kevalī lokeśvarāṇām abhigamanīyo ’rcanīyaś cotkarṣeṇāyuṣaḥ pūvakoṭīṃ deśonāṃ viharati.
sa yadāntarmuhūrtaśeṣāyuṣkas tattulyasthitivedyanāmagotraś ca bhavati tadā sarvaṃ vāṅmanasayogaṃ bādarakāyayogaṃ ca parihāpya sukṣmakāyayogālambanaḥ sukṣmakriyāpratipātidhyānam āskanditum arahatīti.

yadā punar antarmuhūrtaśeṣāyuṣkas tato ’dhikasthitiśeṣakarmatrayo bhavati sayogī tadātmopayogātiśayasya sāmāyikasahāyasya viśiṣṭakaraṇasya mahāsaṃvarasya laghukarmaparipācanasyāśeṣakarmareṇupariśātanaśaktisvābhāvyād daṇḍakapāṭaprataralokapūraṇāni svātmapradeśavisarpaṇataś caturbhiḥ samayaiḥ kṛtvā punar api tāvadbhir eva samayaiḥ samupahṛtapradeśavisaraṇaḥ samīkṛtasthitiśeṣakarmacatuṣṭayaḥ pūrvaśarīrapramāṇo bhūtvā sūkṣmakāyayogena sūkṣmakriyāpratipāti dhyānaṃ dhyāyati.

tasmin samucchinnakriyānivartini dhyāne sarvabandhāsravanirodhasarvaśeṣakarmaśātanasāmarthyopapatter ayogikevalinaḥ saṃpūrṇayathākhyātacāritrajñānadarśanaṃ sarvasaṃsāraduḥkhajālapariṣvaṅgocchedajananaṃ sākṣān mokṣakāraṇam upajāyate.
sa punar ayogakevalī bhagavāṃs tadā dhyānātiśayāgninirdagdhasarvamalakalaṃkabandhano nirastakiṭṭadhātupāṣāṇajātyakanakavallabdhātmā parinirvāti.
tadetad dvividhaṃ tapo ’bhinavakarmāsravanirodhahetutvāt saṃvarakāraṇaṃ prāktanakarmarajovidhūnananimittatvān nirjarāhetur api bhavati.
atrāha samyagdṛṣṭayaḥ kiṃ sarve samanirjarā āhosvit kaścid asti prativiśeṣa ity atrocyate —
tad yathā — bhavyaḥ paṃcedndriyasaṃjñī paryāptakā pūrvoktakālalabdhyādisahāyaḥ pariṇāmaviśuddhyā vardhamānaḥ krameṇāpūrvakaraṇādisopānapaṅktyotplavamāno bahutarakarmanirjaro bhavati.
sa eva punaḥ prathamasamyaktvaprāptinimittasaṃnidhāne sati samyagdṛṣṭir bhavann asaṃkhyeyaguṇanirjaro bhavati.
sa eva punaś cāritramohakarmavikalpāpratyākhyānāvaraṇakṣayopaśamanimittapariṇāmaprāptikāle viśuddhiprakarṣayogāt śrāvako bhavan tato ’saṃkhyeyaguṇanirjaro bhavati.
sa eva punaḥ pratyātyākhyānāvaraṇakṣayopaśamakāraṇapariṇāmaviśuddhiyogād viratavyapadeśabhāk san tato ’saṃkhyeyaguṇanirjaro bhavati.
sa eva punar anantānubandhikrodhamānamāyālobhānāṃ viyojanaparo bhavati yadā tadā pariṇāmaviśuddhiprakarṣayogāt tato ’saṃkhyeyaguṇanirjaro bhavati.
sa eva punar darśanamohaprakṛtitrayatṛṇanicayaṃ nirdidhakṣan pariṇāmaviśuddhyatiśayayogād darśanamohakṣapakavyapadeśabhāk pūvoktād asaṃkhyeyaguṇanirjaro bhavati.
evaṃ saḥ kṣāyikasamyagdṛṣṭir bhūtvā śreṇyārohanābhimukhaś cāritramohopaśamaṃ prati vyāpriyamāṇo viśuddhiprakarṣayogād upaśamakavyapadeśam anubhavan pūrvoktād asaṃkhyeyaguṇanirjaro bhavati.
sa eva punar aśeṣacāritramohopaśamanimittasaṃnidhāne pariprāprāptopaśāntakaṣāyavyapadeśaḥ pūrvoktād asaṃkhyeyaguṇanirjaro bhavati.
sa eva punaś cāritramohakṣapaṇaṃ pratyabhimukhaḥ pariṇāmaviśuddhyā varddhamānaḥ kṣapakavyapadeśam anubhavan pūrvoktād asaṃkhyeyaguṇanirjaro bhavati.
sa yadā niḥśeṣacāritramohakṣapaṇakāraṇapariṇāmābhimukhaḥ kṣīṇakaṣāyavyapadeśam āskandan pūrvoktād asaṃkhyeyaguṇanirjaro bhavati.
sa eva dvitīyaśukladhyānānalanirdagdhaghātikarmanicayaḥ san jinavyapadeśabhāk pūrvoktād asaṃkhyeyaguṇanirjaro bhavati.
āha, samyagdarśanasaṃnidhāne ’pi yady asaṃkhyeyaguṇanirjaratavāt parasparato na sāmyam esāṃ kiṃ tarhi śravakavad amī viratādayo guṇabhedān na nirgranthatām arhantīti? ucyate, naitad evam.
yasmād guṇabhedād anyo ’nyaviśeṣe ’pi naigamādinayavyāpārāt sarve ’pi hi bhavanti —
uttaraguṇabhāvanāpetamanaso vrateṣv api kvacit kadācit paripūrṇatām apariprāpnuvanto ’viśuddhapulākasādṛśyāt pulākā ity ucyante.
nairgranthyaṃ prati sthitā akhaṇḍitavratāḥ śarīropakaraṇavibhūṣānuvartino ’viviktaparivārā mohaśabalayuktā bakuśāh.
cāritrapariṇāmasya prakarṣāprakarṣabhede saty api naigamasaṃgrahādinayāpekṣayā sarve ’pi te nirgranthā ity ucyante.
te ete pulākādayaḥ saṃyamādibhir aṣṭabhir anuyogaiḥ sādhyā vyākheyāḥ.
tad yathā — pulākabakuśapratisevanākuśīlā dvayoḥ saṃyamayoḥ sāmāyikacchedopasthāpanayor vartante.
kaṣāyakuśīlā dvayoḥ saṃyamayoḥ parihāraviśuddhisūkṣamasāmparāyayoḥ pūrvayoś ca.
pratisevanā — pañcānāṃ mūlaguṇanāṃ rātribhojanavarjanasya ca parābhiyogād balād anyatamaṃ pratisevamānaḥ pulāko bhavati.
pratisevanākuśīlo mūlaguṇān avirādhayann uttaraguṇeṣu kāṃcid virādhanāṃ pratisevate.
tīrtham iti sarve sarveṣāṃ tīrthakarāṇāṃ tīrtheṣu bhavanti.
bhāvaliṅgaṃ pratītya sarve paṃca nirgranthā liṃgino bhavanti.
leśyāḥ — pulākasyottarās tisraḥ bakuśapratisevanākuśīlayoḥ ṣaḍ api.
tataḥ kaṣāyakuśīlapratisevanākuśīlabakuśā yugapad asaṃkhyeyāni sthānāni gacchanti.
tato ’py asaṃkhyeyāni sthānāni gatvā pratisevanākuśīlo vyucchidyate.
tato ’py asaṃkhyeyāni sthānāni gatvā kaṣāyakuśīlo vyucchidyate.
ata ūrdhvam ekaṃ sthānaṃ gatvā snātako nirvāṇaṃ prāpnotīty eteṣāṃ saṃyamalabdhir anantaguṇā bhavati.
āha, ante nirdiṣṭasya mokṣasyedānīṃ svarūpābhidhānaṃ prāptakālam iti.
katham? ekasya ‘kṣaya’ śabdasyākaraṇād vibhaktyantaranirdeśasya cābhāvāt ‘ca’ śabdasya cāprayogāl laghu sūtraṃ bhavati ‘mohajñānadarśanāvaraṇāntarāyakṣayāt kevalam’ iti.
satyam etat, kṣayakramapratipādanārtho vākyabhedena nirdeśaḥ kriyate.
prāgeva mohaṃ kṣayam upanīyāntarmuhūrtaṃ kṣīṇakaṣāyavyapadeśam avāpya tato yugapaj jñānadarśanāvaraṇāntarāyāṇāṃ kṣayam kṛtvā kevalam avāpnoti iti.
tatkṣayo hetuḥ kevalotpatter iti hetulakṣaṇo vibhaktinirdeśaḥ kṛtaḥ.

kathaṃ prageva mohaḥ kṣayam upanīyate iti ced ucyate — bhavyaḥ samyagdṛṣṭiḥ pariṇāmaviśuddhyā vardhamāno ’saṃyatasamyagdṛṣṭisaṃyatāsaṃyatapramattāpramattaguṇasthāneṣu kasmiṃs cin mohasya sapta prakṛtīḥ kṣayam upanīya kṣāyikasamyagdṛṣṭir bhūtvā kṣapakaśreṇyārohanābhimukho ’dhaḥpravṛttakaraṇam apramattasthāne pratipādyāpūrvakaraṇaprayogeṇāpūrvakaraṇakṣapakaguṇasthānavyapadeśam anubhūya tatrābhinavaśubhābhisandhitanūkṛtapāpaprakṛtisthityanubhāgo vivardhitaśubhakarmānubhavo ’nivṛttikaraṇaprāptyānivṛttibādarasāṃparāyakṣapakaguṇasthānam adhiruhya tatra kaṣāyāṣṭakaṃ naṣṭaṃ kṛtvā napuṃsakavedanāśaṃ samāpādya strīvedam unmūlya nokakaṣāyaṣaṭkaṃ puṃvede prakṣipya kṣapayitvā puṃvedaṃ krodhasaṃjvalane, krodhasaṃjvalanaṃ mānasaṃjvalane, mānasaṃjvalanaṃ māyāsaṃjvalane, māyāsaṃjvalanaṃ ca lobhasaṃjvalane krameṇa bādarakṛṣṭivibhāgena vilayam upanīya lobhasaṃjvalanaṃ tanūkṛtya sūkṣmasāmparāyakṣapakatvam anubhūya niravaśeṣaṃ mohanīyaṃ nirmūlakaṣāyaṃ kaṣitvā kṣīṇakaṣāyatām adhiruhyāvatāritamohanīyabhāra upāntyaprathame samaye nidrāpracale pralayam upanīya pañcānāṃ jñānāvaraṇānāṃ caturṇām darśanāvaraṇānāṃ pañcānām antarāyāṇāṃ cāntam ante samupanīya tadanantraṃ jñānadarśanasvabhāvaṃ kevalaparyāyam apratarkyavibhūtiviśeṣam avāpnoti.
āha kasmād dhetor mokṣaḥ kiṃ lakṣaṇaś cety atrocyate —
tato bhavasthitihetusamīkṛtaśeṣakarmāvasthasya yugapad ātyantikaḥ kṛtsnakarmavipramokṣo mokṣaḥ pratyetavyaḥ.
tatra caramadehasya nārakatiryagdevāyuṣām abhāvo na yatnasādhyaḥ, asattvāt.
yatnasādhya ita ūrdhvam ucyate — asaṃyatasamyagdṛṣṭyādiṣu caturṣu guṇasthāneṣu kasmiṃś cit saptaprakṛtikṣayaḥ kriyate.
tataḥ paraṃ tatraiva kaṣāyāṣṭakaṃ naṣṭaṃ kriyate.
napuṃsakavedaḥ strīvedaś ca krameṇa tatraiva kṣayam upayāti.
tataḥ puṃvedasaṃjvalanakrodhamānamāyāḥ krameṇa tatraivātyantikaṃ dvaṃsam āskandanti.
paṃcānāṃ jñānāvaraṇānāṃ caturṇāṃ darśanāvaraṇānāṃ paṃcānām antarāyāṇāṃ ca tasyaivāntyasamaye prakṣayo bhavati.

anyataravedanīyamanuṣyāyurmanuṣyagatipañcendriyajātimanuṣyagatiprāyogyānupūrvītrasabādaraparyāptakasubhagādeyayaśaḥkīrtitīrthakaranāmoccairgotrasaṃjñikānāṃ trayodaśānāṃ prakṛtīnām ayogakevalinaś caramasamaye vyucchedo bhavati.
āha, kim āsāṃ paudgalikīnām eva dravyakarmaprakṛtīnāṃ nirāsān mokṣo ’vasīyate uta bhāvakarmaṇo ’pīty atrocyate —
tena pāriṇāmikeṣu bhavyatvasyaupaśamikādīnāṃ ca bhāvānām abhāvān mokṣo bhavatīty abhyupagamyate.
āha, yady apavargo bhāvoparateḥ pratijñāyate, nanu aupaśamikādibhāvanivṛttivatsarvakṣāyikabhāvanivṛttivyapadeśo muktasya prāpnotīti.
syād etat evaṃ yadi viśeṣo nocyate.
asty atra viśeṣa ity apavādavidhānārtham idam ucyate —

yadi catvāra evāvaśiṣyante, anantavīryādīnāṃ nivṛttiḥ prāpnoti? naiṣa doṣaḥ, jñānadarśanāvinābhāvitvād anantavīryādīnām aviśeṣaḥ, anantasāmarthyahīnasyānantāvabodhavṛttyabhāvāj jñānamayatvāc ca sukhasyeti.
anākaratvān muktānām abhāva ity cen na; atītānantaraśarīrākāratvāt.
syān mataṃ, yadi śarīrānuvidhāyī jīvaḥ, tadabhāvāt svābhāvikalokākāśapradeśaparimāṇatvāt tāvad visarpaṇaṃ prāpnotīti.
yadi kāraṇābhāvān na saṃharaṇaṃ na visarpaṇaṃ tarhi gamanakāraṇābhāvād ūrdhvagamanam api na prāpnoti adhastiryaggamanābhāvāt, tato yatra muktas tatraivāvasthānaṃ prāpnotīty.
anupadiṣṭahetukam idam ūrdhvagamanaṃ katham adhyavasātum śakyam ity atrocyate —
āha, hetvarthaḥ puṣkalo ’pi dṛṣṭāntasamarthanam antareṇābhipretārthasādhanāya nālam ity atrocyate —
pūrvasūtre vihitānāṃ hetūnām atroktānāṃ dṛṣṭāntānāṃ ca yathāsaṃkhyam abhisaṃbandho bhavati.
uparante ’pi tasmin pūrvaprayogād ā saṃskārakṣayād bhramati.
evaṃ bhavasthenātmanāpavargaprāptaye bahuśo yatpraṇidhānaṃ tadabhāve ’pi tadāveśapūrvakaṃ muktasya gamanam avasīyate.

yathā mṛttikālepajanitagauravam alābudravyaṃ jale ’dhaḥpatitaṃ jalakledaviśliṣṭamṛttikābandhanaṃ laghu sadūrdhvam eva gacchati tathā karmabhārākrāntivaśīkṛta ātmā tadāveśavaśāt saṃsāre aniyamena gacchati.
yathā bījakośabandhacchedāt eraṇḍabījasya gatir dṛṣṭā tathā manuṣyādibhavaprāpakagatijātināmādisakalakarmabandhacchedān muktasya ūrdhvagatir avasīyate.
yathā tiryakplavanasvabhāvasamīraṇasaṃbandhanirutsukā pradīpaśikhā svabhāvād utpatati tathā muktātmāpi nānagativikārakāraṇakarmanirvāraṇe saty ūrdhvagatisvabhāvād ūrdhvam evārohati.
āha, yadi mukta ūrdhvagatisvabhāvo lokāntād ūrdhvam api kasmān notpatatīty atrocyate —
gatyupagrahakāraṇabhūto dharmāstikāyo nopary astīty aloke gamanābhāvaḥ.
āha, amī parinivṛttā gatijātyādibhedakāraṇābhāvād atītabhedavyavahārā eveti.
kṣetrādibhir dvādaśābhir anuyogaiḥ siddhāḥ sadhyā vikalpyā ity arthaḥ, pratyutpannabhūtānugrahatantranayadvayavivakṣāvaśāt.
tad yathā — kṣetreṇa tāvat kasmin kṣetre sidhyanti? pratyutpannagrāhinayāpekṣayā siddhikṣtre svapradeśe ākāśapradeśe vā siddhir bhavati.
bhūtagrāhinayāpekṣayā janma prati pañcadaśasu karmabhūmiṣu, saṃharaṇaṃ prati mānuṣyakṣetre siddhiḥ.
kālena kasmin kāle siddhiḥ? pratyutpannanayāpekṣayā ekasamaye siddhyan siddho bhavati.
viśeṣeṇāvarsarpiṇyāṃ suṣamaduḥṣamāyā antye bhāge duḥṣamasuṣamāyāṃ ca jātaḥ sidhyati.
na tu duḥṣamāyāṃ jāto duḥṣamāyāṃ sidhyati.
saṃharaṇataḥ sarvasmin kāle utsarpiṇyām avasarpiṇyāṃ ca sidhyati.
gatyā kasyāṃ gatau siddhiḥ? siddhigatau manuṣyagatau vā.
liṃgena kena siddhiḥ? avedatvena tribhyo vā vedebhyaḥ siddhir bhāvito na dravyataḥ.
itare dvividhāḥ sati tīrthakare siddhā asati ceti.
jñānena kena? ekena dvitricaturbhiś ca jñānaviśeṣaiḥ siddhiḥ.
kim antaram? sidhyatāṃ siddhānām anantaraṃ jaghanyena dvau samayau utkarṣeṇāṣṭau.
tad yathā — pratyutpannanayāpekṣayā siddhikṣetre sidhyantīti nāsty alpabahutvam.
bhūtapūrvanayāpekṣayā tu cintyate, kṣetrasiddhā dvividhā — janmataḥ saṃharaṇataś ca.
kṣetrāṇāṃ vibhāgaḥ karmabhūmir akarmabhūmiḥ samudro dvīpa ūrdhvam adhas tiryag iti.
evaṃ kālādivibhāge ’pi yathā gamam alpabahutvaṃ veditavyam.
sarvārthasiddhir iti sadbhir upāttanāmā tattvārthavṛttir aniśaṃ manasā pradhāryā
tattvārthavṛttim uditāṃ viditārthatattvāḥ śṛṇvanti ye paripaṭhanti ca dharmabhaktyā
haste kṛtaṃ paramasiddhisukhāmṛtaṃ tair martyāmareśvarasukheṣu kim asti vācyam
sarvārthasiddhir iti sadbhir upāttanāmā tattvārthavṛttir aniśaṃ manasā pradhāryā || 1
tattvārthavṛttim uditāṃ viditārthatattvāḥ śṛṇvanti ye paripaṭhanti ca dharmabhaktyā
haste kṛtaṃ paramasiddhisukhāmṛtaṃ tair martyāmareśvarasukheṣu kim asti vācyam ||2

Based on the [Digambara] edition by Phūlcandra Śāstrī: Srīmadācāryapūjyapādavirācitā sarvārthasiddhiḥ [with a Hindi translation, not included] Delhi: Bhāratīya Jñānapīṭha (fifth edition, 1991).
A note is indicated by a superscript asterisk () in a § (almost always at the end of a sentence):
